name: BurningPath.shiftRankEmbedding_val
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.gammaScale_mem_orderedSimplex
proof:
:= by
  have hqR : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := by positivity
  constructor
  · intro i
    constructor
    · exact div_nonneg (by positivity) hqR
    · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast z.2.2 i) hqR
  · intro i j hij
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast z.2.1 hij) hqR

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_scale
statement:
private theorem realL1Dist_scale {k : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (x y : Fin k → ℝ) :
    realL1Dist (fun i ↦ a * x i) (fun i ↦ a * y i) =
      a * realL1Dist x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [realL1Dist, realL1Dist, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg ha]

name: BurningPath.natDist_cast_eq_abs_sub
statement:
private theorem natDist_cast_eq_abs_sub (a b : ℕ) :
    ((Nat.dist a b : ℕ) : ℝ) = |(a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with h | h
  · have habR : (a : ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast h
    rw [Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le h, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr habR)]
    norm_num [Nat.cast_sub h]
  · have hbaR : (b : ℝ) ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast h
    rw [Nat.dist_comm, Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le h, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hbaR)]
    norm_num [Nat.cast_sub h]

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_natCast_eq_gammaL1Dist
statement:
private theorem realL1Dist_natCast_eq_gammaL1Dist {N k : ℕ}
    (z w : Gamma N k) :
    realL1Dist (fun i ↦ (z.1 i : ℝ)) (fun i ↦ (w.1 i : ℝ)) =
      gammaL1Dist z w
proof:
:= by
  rw [realL1Dist, gammaL1Dist, Nat.cast_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact (natDist_cast_eq_abs_sub (z.1 i) (w.1 i)).symm

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_floorScaledPoint_le
statement:
private theorem realL1Dist_floorScaledPoint_le {k : ℕ} {a : ℝ}
    {x : Fin k → ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) :
    realL1Dist (fun i ↦ a * x i)
      (fun i ↦ (floorScaledPoint a x i : ℝ)) ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [realL1Dist]
  calc
    (∑ i, |a * x i - (floorScaledPoint a x i : ℝ)|) ≤
        ∑ _i : Fin k, (1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ a * x i := mul_nonneg ha (hx i)
      have hfloor : (floorScaledPoint a x i : ℝ) ≤ a * x i :=
        Nat.floor_le hnonneg
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hfloor)]
      have hlt := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (a * x i)
      change a * x i < (floorScaledPoint a x i : ℝ) + 1 at hlt
      linarith
    _ = k := by simp

name: BurningPath.simplexFloor_error_le
statement:
private theorem simplexFloor_error_le {N k q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (x : Fin k → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ orderedSimplex k ((N : ℝ) / q)) :
    realL1Dist (fun i ↦ (q : ℝ) * x i)
      (fun i ↦ ((simplexFloorToGamma hq x hx).1 i : ℝ)) ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  exact realL1Dist_floorScaledPoint_le (by positivity) fun i ↦ (hx.1 i).1

name: BurningPath.simplexFloorToGridGamma_apply
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem simplexFloorToGridGamma_apply {k D : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (x : Fin k → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ orderedSimplex k L) (i : Fin k) :
    (simplexFloorToGridGamma (D := D) x hx).1 i = floorScaledPoint D x i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.gridGammaScale_mem_orderedSimplex
proof:
:= by
  have hDR : 0 < (D : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
  constructor
  · intro i
    constructor
    · exact div_nonneg (by positivity) hDR.le
    · have hfloor : (⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ) * L :=
        Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hDR.le hL)
      have hz : (z.1 i : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ) * L :=
        (by exact_mod_cast z.2.2 i : (z.1 i : ℝ) ≤ ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊).trans hfloor
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hDR).2
      simpa [mul_comm] using hz
  · intro i j hij
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast z.2.1 hij) hDR.le

name: BurningPath.gridFloor_error_le
statement:
private theorem gridFloor_error_le {k D : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (x : Fin k → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ orderedSimplex k L) :
    realL1Dist x (gammaScale D (simplexFloorToGridGamma (D := D) x hx)) ≤
      (k : ℝ) / D
proof:
:= by
  have hDR : 0 < (D : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hDR).2
  calc
    realL1Dist x (gammaScale D (simplexFloorToGridGamma (D := D) x hx)) * D =
        D * realL1Dist x (gammaScale D (simplexFloorToGridGamma (D := D) x hx)) := by
      ring
    _ = realL1Dist (fun i ↦ (D : ℝ) * x i)
        (fun i ↦
          (D : ℝ) * gammaScale D (simplexFloorToGridGamma (D := D) x hx) i) :=
      (realL1Dist_scale D hDR.le _ _).symm
    _ = realL1Dist (fun i ↦ (D : ℝ) * x i)
        (fun i ↦ (floorScaledPoint D x i : ℝ)) := by
      congr 1
      funext i
      simp only [gammaScale, simplexFloorToGridGamma_apply]
      field_simp
    _ ≤ k :=
      realL1Dist_floorScaledPoint_le hDR.le fun i ↦ (hx.1 i).1

name: BurningPath.exists_simplexRankedCover
statement:
theorem exists_simplexRankedCover {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∃ q, 1 ≤ q ∧ HasSimplexRankedCover k L q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := 2 * k
  let gridN := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
  letI : Fintype (Gamma gridN k) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let M := Fintype.card (Gamma gridN k)
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := Fintype.card_pos
  have hD : 1 ≤ D := by
    dsimp [D]
    omega
  let enumerate : Gamma gridN k ≃ Fin M := Fintype.equivFin _
  let e : Fin M ↪ Fin (M + M) := Fin.natAddEmb M
  let gridCenters : Fin M → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    fun i ↦ gammaScale D (enumerate.symm i)
  let fullCenters : Fin (M + M) → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    Function.extend e gridCenters (fun _ ↦ 0)
  have hfull : ∀ i, fullCenters (e i) = gridCenters i := by
    intro i
    exact e.injective.extend_apply gridCenters (fun _ ↦ 0) i
  refine ⟨M + M, by omega, fullCenters, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hi
      rw [hfull]
      exact gridGammaScale_mem_orderedSimplex hD hL (enumerate.symm j)
    · change Function.extend e gridCenters (fun _ ↦ 0) i ∈ orderedSimplex k L
      rw [Function.extend_apply' gridCenters (fun _ ↦ 0) i]
      · exact zero_mem_orderedSimplex hL
      · simpa only [Set.mem_range] using hi
  · intro x hx
    let z : Gamma gridN k := simplexFloorToGridGamma x hx
    let i : Fin M := enumerate z
    refine ⟨e i, ?_⟩
    rw [hfull]
    have hcenter : gridCenters i = gammaScale D z := by
      simp [gridCenters, i, z]
    rw [hcenter]
    have hhalf :
        realL1Dist x (gammaScale D z) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
      calc
        realL1Dist x (gammaScale D z) ≤ (k : ℝ) / D :=
          gridFloor_error_le hD x hx
        _ = (1 : ℝ) / 2 := by
          have hkR : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
          simp only [D, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
          field_simp
    exact hhalf.trans (by
      have he : (e i).1 = M + i.1 := rfl
      rw [he]
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num) (by positivity)]
      norm_num
      exact_mod_cast (show M + M ≤ (M + i.1) * 2 by omega))

name: BurningPath.SimpleGraph.IsRankedCover.toGammaRankedCover
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcover ((configurationEquivGamma hk).symm z)
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  have hdist :
      pathConfigurationDist ((configurationEquivGamma hk).symm z) (centers r) ≤ r.1 := by
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_closedBall,
      pathTokenGraph_edist_eq_pathConfigurationDist] at hr
    exact_mod_cast hr
  rw [gammaL1Dist_eq_pathConfigurationDist hk]
  simpa using hdist

name: BurningPath.IsGammaRankedCover.toPathTokenRankedCover
proof:
:= by
  intro A
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcover (configurationEquivGamma hk A)
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_closedBall,
    pathTokenGraph_edist_eq_pathConfigurationDist]
  have hdist :
      pathConfigurationDist A ((configurationEquivGamma hk).symm (centers r)) ≤ r.1 := by
    rw [pathConfigurationDist_eq_gammaL1Dist hk]
    simpa using hr
  exact_mod_cast hdist

name: BurningPath.IsGammaRankedCover.toSimplexRankedCover_add
statement:
theorem IsGammaRankedCover.toSimplexRankedCover_add {N k t : ℕ}
    {centers : Fin t → Gamma N k} (hcover : IsGammaRankedCover centers)
    (hq : 1 ≤ t + k) :
    HasSimplexRankedCover k
      ((N : ℝ) / ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ)) (t + k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := shiftRankEmbedding t k
  let scaledCenters : Fin t → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    fun r ↦ gammaScale (t + k) (centers r)
  let fullCenters : Fin (t + k) → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    Function.extend e scaledCenters (fun _ ↦ 0)
  have hfull : ∀ r, fullCenters (e r) = scaledCenters r := by
    intro r
    exact e.injective.extend_apply scaledCenters (fun _ ↦ 0) r
  refine ⟨fullCenters, ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hi
      rw [hfull]
      simpa [scaledCenters, Nat.cast_add] using
        gammaScale_mem_orderedSimplex hq (centers r)
    · change Function.extend e scaledCenters (fun _ ↦ 0) i ∈
        orderedSimplex k ((N : ℝ) / ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ))
      rw [Function.extend_apply' scaledCenters (fun _ ↦ 0) i]
      · exact zero_mem_orderedSimplex (div_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity))
      · simpa only [Set.mem_range] using hi
  · intro x hx
    let z := simplexFloorToGamma hq x hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcover z
    refine ⟨e r, ?_⟩
    rw [hfull]
    have hqR : 0 < ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have hscaled :
        realL1Dist (fun i ↦ ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) * x i)
            (fun i ↦ (centers r).1 i) ≤ ((k + r.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      calc
        realL1Dist (fun i ↦ ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) * x i)
            (fun i ↦ ((centers r).1 i : ℝ)) ≤
            realL1Dist (fun i ↦ ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) * x i)
              (fun i ↦ ((z.1 i : ℕ) : ℝ)) +
                realL1Dist (fun i ↦ ((z.1 i : ℕ) : ℝ))
                  (fun i ↦ ((centers r).1 i : ℝ)) :=
          realL1Dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ ≤ (k : ℝ) + (r.1 : ℝ) := by
          apply add_le_add
          · exact simplexFloor_error_le hq x hx
          · rw [realL1Dist_natCast_eq_gammaL1Dist]
            exact_mod_cast hr
        _ = ((k + r.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
    change realL1Dist x (gammaScale (t + k) (centers r)) ≤
      (((e r).1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ)
    rw [shiftRankEmbedding_val]
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hqR).2
    calc
      realL1Dist x (gammaScale (t + k) (centers r)) * ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            realL1Dist x (gammaScale (t + k) (centers r)) := by ring
      _ = realL1Dist (fun i ↦ ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) * x i)
          (fun i ↦ ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) * gammaScale (t + k) (centers r) i) :=
        (realL1Dist_scale ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) hqR.le _ _).symm
      _ = realL1Dist (fun i ↦ ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) * x i)
          (fun i ↦ ((centers r).1 i : ℝ)) := by
        congr 1
        funext i
        dsimp [gammaScale]
        field_simp
      _ ≤ ((k + r.1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := hscaled
      _ = ((r.1 + k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [Nat.add_comm]

name: BurningPath.IsL1NormalizedRankedCover.toGammaRankedCover_add
statement:
theorem IsL1NormalizedRankedCover.toGammaRankedCover_add {N k q : ℕ}
    {centers : Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ)}
    (hcover :
      IsL1NormalizedRankedCover (orderedSimplex k ((N : ℝ) / q)) centers)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∃ discreteCenters : Fin (q + k) → Gamma N k,
      IsGammaRankedCover discreteCenters
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := shiftRankEmbedding q k
  let oldCenters : Fin q → Gamma N k := fun i ↦
    simplexFloorToGamma hq (centers i) (hcover.1 i)
  let discreteCenters : Fin (q + k) → Gamma N k :=
    Function.extend e oldCenters (fun _ ↦ Classical.choice (gammaNonempty N k))
  have hfull : ∀ i, discreteCenters (e i) = oldCenters i := by
    intro i
    exact e.injective.extend_apply oldCenters
      (fun _ ↦ Classical.choice (gammaNonempty N k)) i
  refine ⟨discreteCenters, ?_⟩
  intro z
  have hz : gammaScale q z ∈ orderedSimplex k ((N : ℝ) / q) :=
    gammaScale_mem_orderedSimplex hq z
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover.2 (gammaScale q z) hz
  refine ⟨e i, ?_⟩
  rw [hfull]
  have hqR : 0 < (q : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hscaledCover :
      realL1Dist (fun j ↦ (z.1 j : ℝ))
          (fun j ↦ (q : ℝ) * centers i j) ≤ (i.1 : ℝ) := by
    calc
      realL1Dist (fun j ↦ (z.1 j : ℝ))
          (fun j ↦ (q : ℝ) * centers i j) =
          realL1Dist (fun j ↦ (q : ℝ) * gammaScale q z j)
            (fun j ↦ (q : ℝ) * centers i j) := by
        congr 1
        funext j
        dsimp [gammaScale]
        field_simp
      _ = (q : ℝ) * realL1Dist (gammaScale q z) (centers i) :=
        realL1Dist_scale q hqR.le _ _
      _ ≤ (i.1 : ℝ) := by
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi hqR.le
        calc
          (q : ℝ) * realL1Dist (gammaScale q z) (centers i) ≤
              (q : ℝ) * ((i.1 : ℝ) / q) := hmul
          _ = (i.1 : ℝ) := by field_simp
  have hfloor :
      realL1Dist (fun j ↦ (q : ℝ) * centers i j)
          (fun j ↦ ((oldCenters i).1 j : ℝ)) ≤ k := by
    exact realL1Dist_floorScaledPoint_le hqR.le fun j ↦ (hcover.1 i).1 j |>.1
  have htotal :
      realL1Dist (fun j ↦ (z.1 j : ℝ))
          (fun j ↦ ((oldCenters i).1 j : ℝ)) ≤ (i.1 : ℝ) + k := by
    calc
      realL1Dist (fun j ↦ (z.1 j : ℝ))
          (fun j ↦ ((oldCenters i).1 j : ℝ)) ≤
          realL1Dist (fun j ↦ (z.1 j : ℝ))
            (fun j ↦ (q : ℝ) * centers i j) +
              realL1Dist (fun j ↦ (q : ℝ) * centers i j)
                (fun j ↦ ((oldCenters i).1 j : ℝ)) :=
        realL1Dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ (i.1 : ℝ) + k := add_le_add hscaledCover hfloor
  rw [realL1Dist_natCast_eq_gammaL1Dist] at htotal
  rw [shiftRankEmbedding_val]
  exact_mod_cast htotal

name: BurningPath.simplexCoverNumber_le_add_of_pathTokenBurningNumber_le
statement:
theorem simplexCoverNumber_le_add_of_pathTokenBurningNumber_le
    {n k t : ℕ} (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hkt : k < t)
    (hburn : pathTokenBurningNumber n k hkn ≤ t) :
    simplexCoverNumber k
      (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ t + k
proof:
:= by
  letI := nonempty_configuration_of_le (Fin n) (by simpa using hkn)
  change (pathTokenGraph n k).burningNumber ≤ t at hburn
  have hlength := (pathTokenGraph n k).burningNumber_spec.mono hburn
  obtain ⟨centers, hcover⟩ := hlength.2
  have hgamma :
      IsGammaRankedCover
        (fun r ↦ configurationEquivGamma hkn (centers r)) :=
    SimpleGraph.IsRankedCover.toGammaRankedCover hkn hcover
  have hk : 1 ≤ k := (by omega : 1 ≤ 2).trans hk2
  have ht : 1 ≤ t := hk.trans hkt.le
  have hq : 1 ≤ t + k := ht.trans (Nat.le_add_right t k)
  apply simplexCoverNumber_min
  exact ⟨hq, hgamma.toSimplexRankedCover_add hq⟩

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningNumber_le_of_simplexCoverNumber_le_sub
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurningNumber_le_of_simplexCoverNumber_le_sub
    {n k t : ℕ} (hk2 : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (hkt : k < t)
    (hcoverNumber :
      simplexCoverNumber k
        (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((t - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ t - k) :
    pathTokenBurningNumber n k hkn ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 1 ≤ k := hk2.trans' (by omega)
  have hq : 1 ≤ t - k := by omega
  have hL : 0 ≤ (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((t - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by positivity
  have hexists :
      ∃ q, 1 ≤ q ∧
        HasSimplexRankedCover k
          (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((t - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) q :=
    exists_simplexRankedCover hk hL
  have hspec := simplexCoverNumber_spec hexists
  have hcover :
      HasSimplexRankedCover k
        (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((t - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) (t - k) :=
    hspec.2.mono hL hspec.1 hcoverNumber
  obtain ⟨centers, hcenters⟩ := hcover
  obtain ⟨discreteCenters, hdiscrete⟩ :=
    hcenters.toGammaRankedCover_add hq
  letI := nonempty_configuration_of_le (Fin n) (by simpa using hkn)
  change (pathTokenGraph n k).burningNumber ≤ t
  have hlength :
      (pathTokenGraph n k).IsBurningLength ((t - k) + k) := by
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨_, hdiscrete.toPathTokenRankedCover hkn⟩
  exact ((pathTokenGraph n k).burningNumber_min hlength).trans (by omega)

name: BurningPath.coordinateOffset_coordinateTranslate

name: BurningPath.coordinateTranslate_coordinateOffset
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateTranslate_coordinateOffset (c p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    coordinateTranslate c (coordinateOffset c p) = p
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [coordinateOffset, coordinateTranslate]

name: BurningPath.coordinateOffset_injective
statement:
theorem coordinateOffset_injective (c : ℤ × ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (coordinateOffset c)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p₁, p₂⟩ ⟨q₁, q₂⟩ hpq
  simp only [coordinateOffset, Prod.mk.injEq] at hpq ⊢
  omega

name: BurningPath.coordinateOffset_mem_parityOffsetSquare
statement:
theorem coordinateOffset_mem_parityOffsetSquare {N r : ℕ} {σ : ℤ} {c p : ℤ × ℤ}
    (hc : c ∈ parityTriangle N σ) (hp : p ∈ parityTriangle N σ)
    (hsquare : p ∈ centeredCoordinateSquare c r) :
    coordinateOffset c p ∈ parityOffsetSquare r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact hsquare
  · have hpar : p.1 - p.2 ≡ c.1 - c.2 [ZMOD 2] :=
      hp.2.2.2.trans hc.2.2.2.symm
    change p.1 - c.1 ≡ p.2 - c.2 [ZMOD 2]
    rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd] at hpar ⊢
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hpar
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    omega

name: BurningPath.parityOffsetSquare_finite
statement: theorem parityOffsetSquare_finite (r : ℕ) : (parityOffsetSquare r).Finite
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (latticeBall 2 r) := (latticeBall_finite 2 r).fintype
  letI : Fintype (parityOffsetSquare r) :=
    Fintype.ofEquiv (latticeBall 2 r) (latticeBallTwoEquivParityOffsetSquare r)
  exact Set.toFinite _

name: BurningPath.twoTokenBallRegion_ncard_le
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn (coordinateOffset c) ?_ ?_
    (parityOffsetSquare_finite r)
  · intro p hp
    exact coordinateOffset_mem_parityOffsetSquare hc hp.1 hp.2
  · exact (coordinateOffset_injective c).injOn

name: BurningPath.twoTokenBallRegion_ncard_le_quadratic
proof:
:= by
  rw [← parityOffsetSquare_ncard r]
  exact twoTokenBallRegion_ncard_le hc

name: BurningPath.twoToken_closedBall_ncard_le_quadratic_via_phi
statement:
theorem twoToken_closedBall_ncard_le_quadratic_via_phi {n r : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) (C : Configuration (Fin n) 2) :
    ((pathTokenGraph n 2).closedBall C r).ncard ≤ 2 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [twoToken_closedBall_ncard_eq_ballRegion_ncard hn σ hσ C]
  apply twoTokenBallRegion_ncard_le_quadratic
  exact
    twoTokenPhi_mem_parityTriangle hn σ hσ
      (twoConfigurationEquivTwoPathPoint n C)

name: BurningPath.twoTokenBallRegion_ncard_eq_quadratic_of_fits
proof:
:= by
  have hbij :
      Set.BijOn (coordinateOffset c) (twoTokenBallRegion N σ c r)
        (parityOffsetSquare r) := by
    refine ⟨?_, (coordinateOffset_injective c).injOn, ?_⟩
    · intro p hp
      exact coordinateOffset_mem_parityOffsetSquare hc hp.1 hp.2
    · intro d hd
      refine ⟨coordinateTranslate c d, ?_, coordinateOffset_coordinateTranslate c d⟩
      constructor
      · exact hfits d hd
      · simpa [centeredCoordinateSquare, coordinateTranslate] using hd.1
  rw [hbij.ncard_eq, parityOffsetSquare_ncard]

name: BurningPath.twoToken_closedBall_ncard_eq_quadratic_of_fits
statement:
theorem twoToken_closedBall_ncard_eq_quadratic_of_fits {n r : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) (C : Configuration (Fin n) 2)
    (hfits :
      ParityOffsetSquareFits (n - 2) σ (twoConfigurationPhi C) r) :
    ((pathTokenGraph n 2).closedBall C r).ncard = 2 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [twoToken_closedBall_ncard_eq_ballRegion_ncard hn σ hσ C]
  apply twoTokenBallRegion_ncard_eq_quadratic_of_fits
  · exact
      twoTokenPhi_mem_parityTriangle hn σ hσ
        (twoConfigurationEquivTwoPathPoint n C)
  · exact hfits

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem realL1Dist_self {k : ℕ} (x : Fin k → ℝ) :
    realL1Dist x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [realL1Dist]

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_nonneg
statement:
theorem realL1Dist_nonneg {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ realL1Dist x y
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_comm
statement:
theorem realL1Dist_comm {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → ℝ) :
    realL1Dist x y = realL1Dist y x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realL1Dist, abs_sub_comm]

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_triangle
statement:
theorem realL1Dist_triangle {k : ℕ} (x y z : Fin k → ℝ) :
    realL1Dist x z ≤ realL1Dist x y + realL1Dist y z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realL1Dist, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  calc
    |x i - z i| = |(x i - y i) + (y i - z i)| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |x i - y i| + |y i - z i| := abs_add_le _ _

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem realL1Dist_eq_zero_iff {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → ℝ) :
    realL1Dist x y = 0 ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext i
    have hi :=
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ abs_nonneg _).mp h i (Finset.mem_univ i)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp hi)
  · rintro rfl
    exact realL1Dist_self x

name: BurningPath.orderedSimplex_subset_cube
statement:
theorem orderedSimplex_subset_cube (k : ℕ) (L : ℝ) :
    orderedSimplex k L ⊆ realCube k L
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx ↦ hx.1

name: BurningPath.zero_mem_realCube
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_mem_realCube {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    (0 : Fin k → ℝ) ∈ realCube k L
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  simp [hL]

name: BurningPath.zero_mem_orderedSimplex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_mem_orderedSimplex {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    (0 : Fin k → ℝ) ∈ orderedSimplex k L
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨fun i ↦ by simp [hL], monotone_const⟩

name: BurningPath.IsL1NormalizedRankedCover.reindex
statement:
theorem IsL1NormalizedRankedCover.reindex {k q₀ q : ℕ} {S : Set (Fin k → ℝ)}
    {centers : Fin q₀ → (Fin k → ℝ)} (hcover : IsL1NormalizedRankedCover S centers)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (e : Fin q₀ ↪ Fin q)
    (hradius : ∀ i, (i.1 : ℝ) / q₀ ≤ ((e i).1 : ℝ) / q) :
    ∃ fullCenters : Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ),
      IsL1NormalizedRankedCover S fullCenters ∧ ∀ i, fullCenters (e i) = centers i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨defaultCenter, hdefaultCenter⟩ := hS
  let fullCenters : Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    Function.extend e centers (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter)
  have hfull : ∀ i, fullCenters (e i) = centers i := by
    intro i
    exact e.injective.extend_apply centers (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter) i
  refine ⟨fullCenters, ?_, hfull⟩
  constructor
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hi
      rw [hfull]
      exact hcover.1 j
    · change Function.extend e centers (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter) i ∈ S
      rw [Function.extend_apply' centers (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter) i]
      · exact hdefaultCenter
      · simpa only [Set.mem_range] using hi
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover.2 x hx
    refine ⟨e i, ?_⟩
    rw [hfull]
    exact hi.trans (hradius i)

name: BurningPath.IsL1NormalizedRankedCover.pad
statement:
theorem IsL1NormalizedRankedCover.pad {k q₀ q : ℕ} {S : Set (Fin k → ℝ)}
    {centers : Fin q₀ → (Fin k → ℝ)} (hcover : IsL1NormalizedRankedCover S centers)
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q) :
    ∃ fullCenters : Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ),
      IsL1NormalizedRankedCover S fullCenters ∧
        ∀ i, fullCenters (rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀ i) = centers i
proof:
:= by
  exact hcover.reindex hS (rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀)
    (rankPaddingEmbedding_normalized_le hq₀ hqq₀)

name: BurningPath.cubeCoverNumber_spec
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_mem h

name: BurningPath.cubeCoverNumber_min
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_le hq

name: BurningPath.simplexCoverNumber_spec
statement:
theorem simplexCoverNumber_spec {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (h : ∃ q, 1 ≤ q ∧ HasSimplexRankedCover k L q) :
    1 ≤ simplexCoverNumber k L ∧
      HasSimplexRankedCover k L (simplexCoverNumber k L)
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_mem h

name: BurningPath.simplexCoverNumber_min
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_le hq

name: BurningPath.HasCubeRankedCover.mono
statement:
theorem HasCubeRankedCover.mono {k q₀ q : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q) (hcover : HasCubeRankedCover k L q₀) :
    HasCubeRankedCover k L q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨centers, hcenters⟩ := hcover
  obtain ⟨fullCenters, hfull, _⟩ :=
    hcenters.pad ⟨0, zero_mem_realCube hL⟩ hq₀ hqq₀
  exact ⟨fullCenters, hfull⟩

name: BurningPath.HasSimplexRankedCover.mono
statement:
theorem HasSimplexRankedCover.mono {k q₀ q : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q) (hcover : HasSimplexRankedCover k L q₀) :
    HasSimplexRankedCover k L q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨centers, hcenters⟩ := hcover
  obtain ⟨fullCenters, hfull, _⟩ :=
    hcenters.pad ⟨0, zero_mem_orderedSimplex hL⟩ hq₀ hqq₀
  exact ⟨fullCenters, hfull⟩

name: BurningPath.asymptoticBlockLength_spec
statement:
theorem asymptoticBlockLength_spec (k n : ℕ) :
    idealBlockLength k n ≤ (asymptoticBlockLength k n : ℝ) ∧
      (asymptoticBlockLength k n : ℝ) < idealBlockLength k n + 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Nat.le_ceil _
  · simpa [asymptoticBlockLength] using
      (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show 0 ≤ idealBlockLength k n by
        rw [idealBlockLength]
        positivity))

name: BurningPath.factorialRoot_pos
statement: theorem factorialRoot_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < factorialRoot k
proof:
:= by
  rw [factorialRoot]
  apply Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
  positivity

name: BurningPath.idealBlockLength_eq_scale_div
statement:
theorem idealBlockLength_eq_scale_div (k n : ℕ) :
    idealBlockLength k n = pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n / factorialRoot k
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealBlockLength, pathTokenAsymptoticScale, factorialRoot,
    Real.div_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)]

name: BurningPath.idealBlockLength_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem idealBlockLength_pow (k n : ℕ) :
    idealBlockLength k n ^ (k + 1) = (n : ℝ) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [idealBlockLength] using
    (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow
      (x := (n : ℝ) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) (n := k + 1)
      (by positivity) (by omega))

name: BurningPath.idealBlockLength_pos
statement:
theorem idealBlockLength_pos {k n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    0 < idealBlockLength k n
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealBlockLength]
  apply Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
  positivity

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenAsymptoticScale_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_pathTokenAsymptoticScale_atTop (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    Tendsto (pathTokenAsymptoticScale k) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : 0 < (k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  apply (tendsto_congr' <| Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
    pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow k n).mpr
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using
    (tendsto_rpow_atTop hexp).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop

name: BurningPath.tendsto_idealBlockLength_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_idealBlockLength_atTop (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    Tendsto (idealBlockLength k) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [show idealBlockLength k = fun n ↦
      pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n / factorialRoot k by
    funext n
    exact idealBlockLength_eq_scale_div k n]
  exact (tendsto_pathTokenAsymptoticScale_atTop k hk).atTop_div_const
    (factorialRoot_pos k)

name: BurningPath.blockAspect_nonneg
statement: theorem blockAspect_nonneg (k n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ blockAspect k n
proof:
:= by
  exact div_nonneg (by positivity) (by rw [idealBlockLength]; positivity)

name: BurningPath.blockAspect_pow
statement:
theorem blockAspect_pow {k n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    blockAspect k n ^ k = (k.factorial : ℝ) * idealBlockLength k n
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 < idealBlockLength k n := idealBlockLength_pos hn
  have hxpow := idealBlockLength_pow k n
  have hnPow :
      (n : ℝ) ^ k = (k.factorial : ℝ) * idealBlockLength k n ^ (k + 1) := by
    calc
      (n : ℝ) ^ k = idealBlockLength k n ^ (k + 1) * (k.factorial : ℝ) :=
        ((eq_div_iff (by positivity : (k.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0)).mp hxpow).symm
      _ = (k.factorial : ℝ) * idealBlockLength k n ^ (k + 1) := by ring
  rw [blockAspect, div_pow, hnPow, pow_succ]
  field_simp [hx.ne']

name: BurningPath.tendsto_blockAspect_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_blockAspect_atTop (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    Tendsto (blockAspect k) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_atTop.2
  intro M
  by_cases hM : M ≤ 0
  · exact Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦ hM.trans (blockAspect_nonneg k n)
  · have hMpos : 0 < M := lt_of_not_ge hM
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := hMpos.le
    have hK : 0 < (k.factorial : ℝ) := by positivity
    filter_upwards [
        (tendsto_idealBlockLength_atTop k hk).eventually_ge_atTop
          (M ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)),
        eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hnlarge hn
    apply (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (n := k) hM0 (blockAspect_nonneg k n) hk.ne').mp
    rw [blockAspect_pow hn]
    simpa [mul_comm] using (div_le_iff₀ hK).mp hnlarge

name: BurningPath.tendsto_upperEnvelopeFactor
statement:
theorem tendsto_upperEnvelopeFactor (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    Tendsto (upperEnvelopeFactor k) atTop (𝓝 (generalUpperConstant k))
proof:
:= by
  have hzero :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (k + 1 : ℝ) / blockAspect k n) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    (tendsto_blockAspect_atTop k hk).const_div_atTop (k + 1 : ℝ)
  have hone :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ 1 + (k + 1 : ℝ) / blockAspect k n) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.add hzero
  have hpow := hone.pow k
  have hadd :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (1 + (k + 1 : ℝ) / blockAspect k n) ^ k + k) atTop
        (𝓝 (k + 1 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa [add_comm] using hpow.add_const (k : ℝ)
  change Tendsto
    (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((1 + (k + 1 : ℝ) / blockAspect k n) ^ k + k) /
      factorialRoot k) atTop (𝓝 ((k + 1 : ℝ) / factorialRoot k))
  simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hadd.div_const (factorialRoot k)

name: BurningPath.ceilDiv_le_div_add_one
statement:
theorem ceilDiv_le_div_add_one (n s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    n ⌈/⌉ s ≤ n / s + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ceilDiv_le_iff_le_mul hs]
  calc
    n = s * (n / s) + n % s := (Nat.div_add_mod n s).symm
    _ ≤ s * (n / s) + s := Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.mod_lt n hs)) _
    _ = s * (n / s + 1) := by ring

name: BurningPath.cast_div_le_div
statement:
theorem cast_div_le_div (n s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    ((n / s : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) / (s : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hs)).2
  exact_mod_cast Nat.div_mul_le_self n s

name: BurningPath.one_le_asymptoticBlockLength
statement:
theorem one_le_asymptoticBlockLength {k n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    1 ≤ asymptoticBlockLength k n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [asymptoticBlockLength] using
    (Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (idealBlockLength_pos (k := k) hn))

name: BurningPath.cast_pred_asymptoticBlockLength_lt_ideal
statement:
theorem cast_pred_asymptoticBlockLength_lt_ideal {k n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ((asymptoticBlockLength k n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < idealBlockLength k n
proof:
:= by
  have hs := one_le_asymptoticBlockLength (k := k) hn
  have hceil :
      (asymptoticBlockLength k n : ℝ) < idealBlockLength k n + 1 := by
    simpa [asymptoticBlockLength] using
      (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show 0 ≤ idealBlockLength k n by
        rw [idealBlockLength]
        positivity))
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hs]
  norm_num at hceil ⊢
  linarith

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningRatio_le_upperEnvelopeFactor
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurningRatio_le_upperEnvelopeFactor {k n : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (hkn : k ≤ n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≤ upperEnvelopeFactor k n
proof:
:= by
  let x := idealBlockLength k n
  let s := asymptoticBlockLength k n
  let m := n ⌈/⌉ s
  let A := blockAspect k n
  let S := pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n
  let D := factorialRoot k
  let K : ℝ := k.factorial
  have hx : 0 < x := idealBlockLength_pos hn
  have hs : 1 ≤ s := one_le_asymptoticBlockLength hn
  have hspos : 0 < s := by omega
  have hS : 0 < S := pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos hn
  have hD : 0 < D := factorialRoot_pos k
  have hK : 0 < K := by positivity
  have hxs : x ≤ (s : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [x, s, asymptoticBlockLength]
    exact Nat.le_ceil _
  have hmNat : m ≤ n / s + 1 := ceilDiv_le_div_add_one n s hspos
  have hm : (m : ℝ) ≤ A + 1 := by
    have hdivCast : ((n / s : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) / (s : ℝ) :=
      cast_div_le_div n s hspos
    have hdiv : (n : ℝ) / (s : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) / x :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hx hxs
    have hmCast : (m : ℝ) ≤ ((n / s + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hmNat
    push_cast at hmCast
    dsimp [A, blockAspect]
    linarith
  have hinput : ((m + k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ A + (k + 1 : ℝ) := by
    have hsub : m + k - 1 ≤ m + k := Nat.sub_le _ _
    have hsubCast : ((m + k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ ((m + k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hsub
    push_cast at hsubCast
    linarith
  have hchoose :
      ((m + k - 1).choose k : ℝ) ≤ (A + (k + 1 : ℝ)) ^ k / K := by
    calc
      ((m + k - 1).choose k : ℝ) ≤ ((m + k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k / K := by
        simpa [K] using (Nat.choose_le_pow_div k (m + k - 1) :
          ((m + k - 1).choose k : ℝ) ≤
            ((m + k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ))
      _ ≤ (A + (k + 1 : ℝ)) ^ k / K := by
        gcongr
  have hradius : ((k * (s - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) * x := by
    have hpred := (cast_pred_asymptoticBlockLength_lt_ideal (k := k) hn).le
    simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpred (show 0 ≤ (k : ℝ) by positivity)
  have hburnNat : pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n ≤ blockUpperBound n k s := by
    rw [pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_eq hkn]
    exact pathTokenBurningNumber_le_blockUpperBound hkn hs
  have hburn :
      (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ≤
        (A + (k + 1 : ℝ)) ^ k / K + (k : ℝ) * x := by
    calc
      (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ≤ (blockUpperBound n k s : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hburnNat
      _ = ((m + k - 1).choose k : ℝ) + (k * (s - 1) : ℕ) := by
        simp [blockUpperBound, m]
      _ ≤ (A + (k + 1 : ℝ)) ^ k / K + (k : ℝ) * x :=
        add_le_add hchoose hradius
  have hA : 0 < A := by
    dsimp [A, blockAspect]
    positivity
  have hApow : A ^ k = K * x := by
    simpa [A, K, x] using blockAspect_pow (k := k) hn
  have hxS : x = S / D := by
    simpa [x, S, D] using idealBlockLength_eq_scale_div k n
  have hfactor :
      ((A + (k + 1 : ℝ)) ^ k / K + (k : ℝ) * x) / S =
        ((1 + (k + 1 : ℝ) / A) ^ k + k) / D := by
    have hsum : A + (k + 1 : ℝ) = A * (1 + (k + 1 : ℝ) / A) := by
      field_simp [hA.ne']
    rw [hsum, mul_pow, hApow, hxS]
    field_simp [hS.ne', hD.ne', hK.ne']
  change (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) / S ≤
    ((1 + (k + 1 : ℝ) / A) ^ k + k) / D
  calc
    (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) / S ≤
        ((A + (k + 1 : ℝ)) ^ k / K + (k : ℝ) * x) / S :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hburn hS.le
    _ = ((1 + (k + 1 : ℝ) / A) ^ k + k) / D := hfactor

name: BurningPath.eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant_add
statement:
theorem eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant_add
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≤ generalUpperConstant k + ε
proof:
:= by
  have henv := (tendsto_upperEnvelopeFactor k hk).eventually
    (Iio_mem_nhds (lt_add_of_pos_right (generalUpperConstant k) hε))
  filter_upwards [henv, eventually_ge_atTop k, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hkn hnpos
  exact (pathTokenBurningRatio_le_upperEnvelopeFactor hk hkn hnpos).trans hn.le

name: BurningPath.limsup_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant
statement:
theorem limsup_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    limsup (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop ≤ generalUpperConstant k
proof:
:= by
  have hcob :
      atTop.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (pathTokenBurningRatio k) :=
    isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le atTop (pathTokenBurningRatio_nonneg k)
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε
  exact limsup_le_of_le hcob
    (eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant_add k hk hε)

name: BurningPath.generalUpperAsymptotic_eventually
statement:
theorem generalUpperAsymptotic_eventually (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
          (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)) ≤
        (k + 1 : ℝ) / (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ + ε
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow, pathTokenBurningRatio,
    generalUpperConstant, factorialRoot] using
    eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant_add k (by omega) hε

name: BurningPath.generalUpperAsymptotic_limsup
statement:
theorem generalUpperAsymptotic_limsup (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    limsup
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
          (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)))
        atTop ≤
      (k + 1 : ℝ) / (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow]
  change limsup (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop ≤ generalUpperConstant k
  exact limsup_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant k (by omega)

name: BurningPath.squareToTriangleCoordinates_triangleToSquareCoordinates

proof:

name: BurningPath.squareToTriangleCoordinates_mem_iff
statement:
theorem squareToTriangleCoordinates_mem_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (p : ℤ × ℤ) :
    squareToTriangleCoordinates n p ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) n ↔
      p ∈ parityLattice n
proof:
:= by
  have hncast : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) - 2 := by omega
  simp only [squareToTriangleCoordinates, parityTriangle, parityLattice, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
    hncast]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hY0, hYN, habs, hpar⟩
    rw [abs_le] at habs
    constructor
    · rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd] at hpar ⊢
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hpar
      refine ⟨a - n, ?_⟩
      omega
    constructor
    · omega
    constructor <;> omega
  · rintro ⟨hpar, hv, huv, hsum⟩
    constructor
    · omega
    constructor
    · omega
    constructor
    · rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> omega
    · rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd] at hpar ⊢
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hpar
      refine ⟨a + n, ?_⟩
      omega

name: BurningPath.twoTokenSquareCoordinates_mem
statement:
theorem twoTokenSquareCoordinates_mem {n : ℕ} (p : TwoPathPoint n) :
    twoTokenSquareCoordinates p ∈ parityLattice n
proof:
:= by
  rcases p.2 with ⟨hx, hxy, hy⟩
  simp only [twoTokenSquareCoordinates, parityLattice, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · exact add_modEq_sub_two p.1.1 p.1.2
  constructor
  · omega
  constructor <;> omega

name: BurningPath.twoTokenPhi_mem_parityTriangle
statement:
theorem twoTokenPhi_mem_parityTriangle {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) (p : TwoPathPoint n) :
    twoTokenPhi p ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) σ
proof:
:= by
  rcases p.2 with ⟨hx, hxy, hy⟩
  have hncast : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) - 2 := by omega
  simp only [twoTokenPhi, parityTriangle, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hncast]
  constructor
  · omega
  constructor
  · omega
  constructor
  · rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> omega
  · rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd] at hσ ⊢
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hσ
    refine ⟨a + ((n : ℤ) - p.1.1), ?_⟩
    omega

name: BurningPath.even_twoTokenPhiInverse_first
statement:
theorem even_twoTokenPhiInverse_first {n : ℕ} (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) {p : ℤ × ℤ} (hp : p ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) σ) :
    Even (p.1 - p.2 + n)
proof:
:= by
  have hpar : p.1 - p.2 ≡ σ [ZMOD 2] := hp.2.2.2
  rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd] at hσ hpar
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hσ
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hpar
  refine ⟨σ - a - b, ?_⟩
  omega

name: BurningPath.even_twoTokenPhiInverse_second
statement:
theorem even_twoTokenPhiInverse_second {n : ℕ} (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) {p : ℤ × ℤ} (hp : p ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) σ) :
    Even (p.1 + p.2 + n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := even_twoTokenPhiInverse_first σ hσ hp
  refine ⟨a + p.2 + 1, ?_⟩
  omega

name: BurningPath.twoTokenPhiInverse_first_mul_two
statement:
theorem twoTokenPhiInverse_first_mul_two {n : ℕ} (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) {p : ℤ × ℤ} (hp : p ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) σ) :
    (twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates n p).1 * 2 = p.1 - p.2 + n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates, mul_comm] using
    Int.ediv_two_mul_two_of_even (even_twoTokenPhiInverse_first σ hσ hp)

name: BurningPath.twoTokenPhiInverse_second_mul_two
statement:
theorem twoTokenPhiInverse_second_mul_two {n : ℕ} (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) {p : ℤ × ℤ} (hp : p ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) σ) :
    (twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates n p).2 * 2 = p.1 + p.2 + n + 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates, mul_comm] using
    Int.ediv_two_mul_two_of_even (even_twoTokenPhiInverse_second σ hσ hp)

name: BurningPath.parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint_val {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) (p : {z // z ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) σ}) :
    (parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint hn σ hσ p).1 = twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates n p.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint_twoTokenPhi
statement:
theorem parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint_twoTokenPhi {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) (p : TwoPathPoint n) :
    parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint hn σ hσ
        ⟨twoTokenPhi p, twoTokenPhi_mem_parityTriangle hn σ hσ p⟩ = p
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint_val]
  apply Prod.ext
  · simp only [twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates, twoTokenPhi]
    rw [show
      p.1.1 + p.1.2 - ((n : ℤ) + 1) - (p.1.2 - p.1.1 - 1) + n =
        2 * p.1.1 by omega]
    exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)
  · simp only [twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates, twoTokenPhi]
    rw [show
      p.1.1 + p.1.2 - ((n : ℤ) + 1) + (p.1.2 - p.1.1 - 1) + n + 2 =
        2 * p.1.2 by omega]
    exact Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)

name: BurningPath.twoTokenPhi_parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint
statement:
theorem twoTokenPhi_parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) (p : {z // z ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) σ}) :
    twoTokenPhi (parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint hn σ hσ p) = p.1
proof:
:= by
  have hx := twoTokenPhiInverse_first_mul_two σ hσ p.2
  have hy := twoTokenPhiInverse_second_mul_two σ hσ p.2
  rw [show
    twoTokenPhi (parityTriangleToTwoPathPoint hn σ hσ p) =
      ((twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates n p.1).1 +
          (twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates n p.1).2 - (n + 1),
        (twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates n p.1).2 -
          (twoTokenPhiInverseCoordinates n p.1).1 - 1) by rfl]
  apply Prod.ext <;> simp only
  · omega
  · omega

name: BurningPath.twoTokenSquareCoordinates_isometry
statement:
theorem twoTokenSquareCoordinates_isometry {n : ℕ} (p q : TwoPathPoint n) :
    max
        ((twoTokenSquareCoordinates p).1 - (twoTokenSquareCoordinates q).1).natAbs
        ((twoTokenSquareCoordinates p).2 - (twoTokenSquareCoordinates q).2).natAbs =
      (p.1.1 - q.1.1).natAbs + (p.1.2 - q.1.2).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  exact max_natAbs_sumDiff_sub_sumDiff p.1.1 p.1.2 q.1.1 q.1.2

name: BurningPath.twoTokenPhi_isometry
statement:
theorem twoTokenPhi_isometry {n : ℕ} (p q : TwoPathPoint n) :
    max ((twoTokenPhi p).1 - (twoTokenPhi q).1).natAbs
        ((twoTokenPhi p).2 - (twoTokenPhi q).2).natAbs =
      (p.1.1 - q.1.1).natAbs + (p.1.2 - q.1.2).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twoTokenPhi]
  rw [show
    p.1.1 + p.1.2 - (n + 1) - (q.1.1 + q.1.2 - (n + 1)) =
      (p.1.1 + p.1.2) - (q.1.1 + q.1.2) by omega]
  rw [show
    p.1.2 - p.1.1 - 1 - (q.1.2 - q.1.1 - 1) =
      (p.1.2 - p.1.1) - (q.1.2 - q.1.1) by omega]
  exact max_natAbs_sumDiff_sub_sumDiff p.1.1 p.1.2 q.1.1 q.1.2

name: SimpleGraph.card_le_sum_ball_bound
statement:
theorem card_le_sum_ball_bound [Fintype V] {G : SimpleGraph V} {t : ℕ}
    {centers : Fin t → V} (hcover : G.IsRankedCover centers) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hball : ∀ c r, (G.closedBall c r).ncard ≤ f r) :
    Fintype.card V ≤ ∑ r : Fin t, f r.1
proof:
:= by
  let covered : Set V := ⋃ r : Fin t, G.closedBall (centers r) r.1
  have huniv : (Set.univ : Set V) ⊆ covered := by
    intro v _
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcover v
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨r, hr⟩
  calc
    Fintype.card V = (Set.univ : Set V).ncard := by simp
    _ ≤ covered.ncard := Set.ncard_mono huniv
    _ ≤ ∑ r : Fin t, (G.closedBall (centers r) r.1).ncard := by
      simpa [covered] using
        (Finset.univ.set_ncard_biUnion_le fun r : Fin t ↦ G.closedBall (centers r) r.1)
    _ ≤ ∑ r : Fin t, f r.1 := Finset.sum_le_sum fun r _ ↦ hball (centers r) r.1

name: BurningPath.shelfPotential_update_identity

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_permuteCoordinates
statement:
theorem realL1Dist_permuteCoordinates {k : ℕ}
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (x c : Fin k → ℝ) :
    realL1Dist x (permuteCoordinates σ c) =
      realL1Dist (x ∘ σ) c
proof:
:= by
  unfold realL1Dist
  calc
    ∑ i, |x i - permuteCoordinates σ c i| =
        ∑ i, |x (σ i) - permuteCoordinates σ c (σ i)| := by
      symm
      exact
        (Equiv.sum_comp σ
          (fun i : Fin k ↦ |x i - permuteCoordinates σ c i|))
    _ = ∑ i, |(x ∘ σ) i - c i| := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp [permuteCoordinates]

name: BurningPath.comp_sort_mem_orderedSimplex
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i
    exact hx (Tuple.sort x i)
  · exact Tuple.monotone_sort x

name: BurningPath.HasSimplexRankedCover.toCubePermutationCover
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨baseCenters, hbaseLegal, hbaseCover⟩ := hcover
  let Perm := Equiv.Perm (Fin k)
  let M := Fintype.card Perm
  let permEquiv : Perm ≃ Fin M := Fintype.equivFin Perm
  let centers : Fin M → Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    fun a j ↦ permuteCoordinates (permEquiv.symm a) (baseCenters j)
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := Fintype.card_pos
  have hlegal : ∀ a j, centers a j ∈ realCube k L := by
    intro a j i
    exact (hbaseLegal j).1 ((permEquiv.symm a).symm i)
  have hpoint :
      ∀ x ∈ realCube k L, ∃ a : Fin M, ∃ j : Fin q,
        realL1Dist x (centers a j) ≤ (j.val : ℝ) / q := by
    intro x hx
    let σ := Tuple.sort x
    let y := x ∘ σ
    have hy : y ∈ orderedSimplex k L := comp_sort_mem_orderedSimplex hx
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hbaseCover y hy
    let a := permEquiv σ
    refine ⟨a, j, ?_⟩
    have hdist :=
      realL1Dist_permuteCoordinates σ x (baseCenters j)
    simpa [centers, a, y, σ] using hdist.trans_le hj
  have hinterleaved :
      HasL1NormalizedRankedCover (realCube k L) (M * q) :=
    hasL1NormalizedRankedCover_interleave hM hq centers hlegal hpoint
  simpa [HasCubeRankedCover, M, Perm, Fintype.card_perm] using hinterleaved

name: BurningPath.cubeCoverNumber_le_factorial_mul_simplexCoverNumber
statement:
theorem cubeCoverNumber_le_factorial_mul_simplexCoverNumber
    {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    cubeCoverNumber k L ≤ Nat.factorial k * simplexCoverNumber k L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hq, hcover⟩ :=
    simplexCoverNumber_spec (exists_simplexRankedCover hk hL)
  apply cubeCoverNumber_min
  exact
    ⟨Nat.mul_pos (Nat.factorial_pos k) hq,
      hcover.toCubePermutationCover hq⟩

name: BurningPath.cubeDensity_le_simplexDensity
statement:
theorem cubeDensity_le_simplexDensity {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hL : 0 < L) :
    cubeCoverDensityAt k L ≤
      (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) /
        (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k)
proof:
:= by
  have hnum :=
    cubeCoverNumber_le_factorial_mul_simplexCoverNumber hk hL.le
  unfold cubeCoverDensityAt
  have hLpow : 0 < L ^ k := pow_pos hL k
  have hkfac : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.factorial k := by positivity
  calc
    (cubeCoverNumber k L : ℝ) / L ^ k ≤
        ((Nat.factorial k * simplexCoverNumber k L : ℕ) : ℝ) / L ^ k := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hnum) hLpow.le
    _ = (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) /
        (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) := by
      push_cast
      field_simp

name: BurningPath.mem_parityOffsetSquare
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_parityOffsetSquare {r : ℕ} {p : ℤ × ℤ} :
    p ∈ parityOffsetSquare r ↔
      max p.1.natAbs p.2.natAbs ≤ r ∧ p.1 ≡ p.2 [ZMOD 2]

name: BurningPath.even_sub_of_modEq_two
statement:
private theorem even_sub_of_modEq_two {u v : ℤ} (h : u ≡ v [ZMOD 2]) :
    Even (u - v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [even_iff_two_dvd]
  simpa only [neg_sub] using (dvd_neg.mpr h.dvd)

name: BurningPath.even_add_of_modEq_two
statement:

name: BurningPath.parityOffsetSquareInverseCoordinates_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem parityOffsetSquareInverseCoordinates_add {r : ℕ} (p : parityOffsetSquare r) :
    (parityOffsetSquareInverseCoordinates p.1).1 +
        (parityOffsetSquareInverseCoordinates p.1).2 =
      p.1.1
proof:
:= by
  have hx :=
    Int.ediv_two_mul_two_of_even (even_sub_of_modEq_two p.2.2)
  have hy :=
    Int.ediv_two_mul_two_of_even (even_add_of_modEq_two p.2.2)

name: BurningPath.parityOffsetSquareInverseCoordinates_sub

    (parityOffsetSquareInverseCoordinates p.1).2 -
        (parityOffsetSquareInverseCoordinates p.1).1 =
      p.1.2
proof:
:= by
  have hx :=
    Int.ediv_two_mul_two_of_even (even_sub_of_modEq_two p.2.2)
  have hy :=
    Int.ediv_two_mul_two_of_even (even_add_of_modEq_two p.2.2)
  simp only [parityOffsetSquareInverseCoordinates] at hx hy ⊢

name: BurningPath.latticeBallPolynomial_two
statement:
theorem latticeBallPolynomial_two (r : ℕ) :
    latticeBallPolynomial 2 r = 2 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [latticeBallPolynomial, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero,
    Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.choose_one_right, Nat.choose_self, pow_zero, pow_one, one_mul]
  rw [Nat.choose_two_right]
  cases r with
  | zero => norm_num
  | succ r =>
      simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one]
      have heven : Even ((r + 1) * r) := by
        simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, mul_comm] using Nat.even_mul_pred_self (r + 1)
      have hdiv := Nat.div_mul_cancel heven.two_dvd
      nlinarith

name: BurningPath.parityOffsetSquare_ncard
statement:
theorem parityOffsetSquare_ncard (r : ℕ) :
    (parityOffsetSquare r).ncard = 2 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r + 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (latticeBall 2 r) := (latticeBall_finite 2 r).fintype
  letI : Fintype (parityOffsetSquare r) :=
    Fintype.ofEquiv (latticeBall 2 r) (latticeBallTwoEquivParityOffsetSquare r)
  calc
    (parityOffsetSquare r).ncard = Fintype.card (parityOffsetSquare r) := by
      rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
      simp
    _ = Fintype.card (latticeBall 2 r) :=
      Fintype.card_congr (latticeBallTwoEquivParityOffsetSquare r).symm
    _ = (latticeBall 2 r).ncard := by
      rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
      simp
    _ = latticeBallPolynomial 2 r := latticeBall_ncard 2 r
    _ = 2 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r + 1 := latticeBallPolynomial_two r

name: BurningPath.eventually_density_power_lower
statement:
theorem eventually_density_power_lower (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ((cubeBulkDensity k - η) / Nat.factorial k) *
          ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k ≤
        ((pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n + k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (k + 1),
      (tendsto_pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_atTop k (by omega)).eventually_gt_atTop k]
      with n hn ht
  have hkn : k ≤ n := by omega
  let t := pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n
  let L := ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hkt : k < t := ht
  have hden : 0 < ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hnum : 0 < ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < n - k by omega)
  have hL : 0 < L := div_pos hnum hden
  have hcomparison :
      simplexCoverNumber k L ≤ t + k := by
    dsimp [L, t]
    apply simplexCoverNumber_le_add_of_pathTokenBurningNumber_le hk hkn hkt
    simp [t, pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_eq hkn]
  have hlower := simplexCoverNumber_lower hk hη hL
  have hcomparisonReal :
      (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) ≤ ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcomparison
  have hchain :
      (cubeBulkDensity k - η) *
          (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
        ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
    hlower.trans hcomparisonReal
  calc
    ((cubeBulkDensity k - η) / Nat.factorial k) *
          ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k =
        ((cubeBulkDensity k - η) *
            (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k)) *
          ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k := by
      dsimp [L]
      rw [div_pow]
      field_simp [hden.ne']
    _ ≤ ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hchain (by positivity)
    _ = ((t + k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ]
      ring

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shiftedNatRatio
statement:
theorem tendsto_shiftedNatRatio (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ))
        atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    have hlimit :
        Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ 1 - (k : ℝ) / (n : ℝ))
          atTop (𝓝 1) := by
      convert tendsto_const_nhds.sub
        (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (k : ℝ)) using 1
      all_goals norm_num
    apply hlimit.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop k, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hkn hn
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hkn]
    field_simp
  exact hbase

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shiftedNatPowerRatio
statement:
theorem tendsto_shiftedNatPowerRatio (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k / (n : ℝ) ^ k)
      atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := tendsto_shiftedNatRatio k
  simpa only [div_pow, one_pow] using hbase.pow k

name: BurningPath.tendsto_dimension_div_pathTokenScale
statement:
theorem tendsto_dimension_div_pathTokenScale (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (k : ℝ) / pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop (tendsto_pathTokenAsymptoticScale_atTop k hk)

name: BurningPath.pathTokenCandidateWidth_spec
statement:
theorem pathTokenCandidateWidth_spec {k : ℕ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (n : ℕ) :
    c * pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n ≤
        (pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n : ℝ) ∧
      (pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n : ℝ) <
        c * pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n + 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Nat.le_ceil _
  · rw [pathTokenCandidateWidth]
    apply Nat.ceil_lt_add_one
    exact mul_nonneg hc (pathTokenAsymptoticScale_nonneg k n)

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_atTop {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto (pathTokenCandidateWidth k c) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have htarget :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ c * pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)
        atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_pathTokenAsymptoticScale_atTop k hk).const_mul_atTop hc
  convert tendsto_nat_ceil_atTop.comp htarget using 1
  funext n
  rfl

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_div_scale
statement:
theorem tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_div_scale {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n : ℝ) /
          pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)
      atTop (𝓝 c)
proof:
:= by
  have herror :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ c + 1 / pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)
        atTop (𝓝 c) := by
    simpa only [add_zero] using tendsto_const_nhds.add
      (tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
        (tendsto_pathTokenAsymptoticScale_atTop k hk))
  apply
    tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le'
      tendsto_const_nhds herror
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
    have hscale := pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos (k := k) hn
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hscale).2 (pathTokenCandidateWidth_spec hc.le n).1
  · filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
    have hscale := pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos (k := k) hn
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hscale).2
    calc
      (pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n : ℝ) ≤
          c * pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n + 1 :=
        (pathTokenCandidateWidth_spec hc.le n).2.le
      _ = (c + 1 / pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n) *
          pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n := by
        field_simp

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_sub_div_scale
statement:
theorem tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_sub_div_scale {k : ℕ}
    (hk : 0 < k) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        ((pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) /
          pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)
      atTop (𝓝 c)
proof:
:= by
  have hlimit :=
    (tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_div_scale hk hc).sub
      (tendsto_dimension_div_pathTokenScale k hk)
  have hlimit' :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n : ℝ) /
              pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n -
            (k : ℝ) / pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)
        atTop (𝓝 c) := by
    simpa using hlimit
  apply hlimit'.congr'
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_atTop hk hc).eventually_ge_atTop k]
      with n hn
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hn, sub_div]

name: BurningPath.natCast_div_pathTokenScale_eq_rpow
proof:
:= by
  have hnReal : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by positivity
  rw [pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow]
  have h :=
    (Real.rpow_sub hnReal (1 : ℝ)
      ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ))).symm
  rw [Real.rpow_one] at h
  have hexp :
      (1 : ℝ) - (k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ) =
        (1 : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hexp] at h
  exact h

name: BurningPath.tendsto_natCast_div_pathTokenScale_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_natCast_div_pathTokenScale_atTop (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) / pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)
      atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : 0 < (1 : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have h :=
    (tendsto_rpow_atTop hexp).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
  exact (natCast_div_pathTokenScale_eq_rpow hn).symm

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenCandidateSimplexSide_atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hnumerator :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) *
            ((n : ℝ) / pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n))
        atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_shiftedNatRatio k).pos_mul_atTop zero_lt_one
      (tendsto_natCast_div_pathTokenScale_atTop k)
  have hdenominator :=
    tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_sub_div_scale hk hc
  have hinverse :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (((pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) /
            pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)⁻¹)
        atTop (𝓝 c⁻¹) :=
    hdenominator.inv₀ hc.ne'
  have hproduct :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          ((((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) *
              ((n : ℝ) / pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)) *
            ((((pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) /
              pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n)⁻¹))
        atTop atTop :=
    hnumerator.atTop_mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hc) hinverse
  apply hproduct.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0,
      (tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_atTop hk hc).eventually_gt_atTop k]
      with n hn ht
  rw [pathTokenCandidateSimplexSide]
  have hscale := (pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos (k := k) hn).ne'
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have ht0 :
      (((pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (show pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n - k ≠ 0 by omega)
  field_simp

name: BurningPath.eventually_constant_le_pathTokenBurningRatio_of_lt_limit
statement:
theorem eventually_constant_le_pathTokenBurningRatio_of_lt_limit
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : c < pathTokenLimitConstant k) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c ≤ pathTokenBurningRatio k n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc0 : 0 ≤ c
  · let c' := (c + pathTokenLimitConstant k) / 2
    have hcc' : c < c' := by
      dsimp [c']
      linarith
    have hc'C : c' < pathTokenLimitConstant k := by
      dsimp [c']
      linarith
    have hc'0 : 0 ≤ c' := hc0.trans hcc'.le
    have hpower :
        c' ^ (k + 1) <
          cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k := by
      rw [← pathTokenLimitConstant_pow hk]
      exact
        (pow_lt_pow_iff_left₀ hc'0 (pathTokenLimitConstant_pos hk).le
          (by omega)).2 hc'C
    let d :=
      (c' ^ (k + 1) +
        cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k) / 2
    have hc'd : c' ^ (k + 1) < d := by
      dsimp [d]
      linarith
    have hdC : d < cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k := by
      dsimp [d]
      linarith
    let η := cubeBulkDensity k - d * Nat.factorial k
    have hη : 0 < η := by
      dsimp [η]
      have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.factorial k := by positivity
      apply sub_pos.mpr
      exact (lt_div_iff₀ hfac).mp hdC
    have hcoefficient :
        (cubeBulkDensity k - η) / Nat.factorial k = d := by
      dsimp [η]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hratio :
        Tendsto
          (fun n : ℕ ↦
            d * (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k / (n : ℝ) ^ k))
          atTop (𝓝 d) := by
      simpa only [mul_one] using
        tendsto_const_nhds.mul (tendsto_shiftedNatPowerRatio k)
    have hratioLower :
        ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
          c' ^ (k + 1) ≤
            d * (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k / (n : ℝ) ^ k) :=
      (hratio.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hc'd)).mono fun _ hn ↦ hn.le
    have hshiftSmall :
        ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
          (k : ℝ) / pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n ≤ c' - c := by
      have hpos : 0 < c' - c := sub_pos.mpr hcc'
      exact
        ((tendsto_dimension_div_pathTokenScale k (by omega)).eventually
          (Iio_mem_nhds hpos)).mono fun _ hn ↦ hn.le
    filter_upwards [eventually_density_power_lower k hk hη,
        hratioLower, hshiftSmall, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with
        n hdensity hratioN hshift hn
    have hscale : 0 < pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n :=
      pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos hn
    have hnPow : 0 < (n : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
    have hnormalized :
        c' ^ (k + 1) * (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤
          d * ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k := by
      calc
        c' ^ (k + 1) * (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤
            (d * (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k / (n : ℝ) ^ k)) *
              (n : ℝ) ^ k :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hratioN hnPow.le
        _ = d * ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k := by
          field_simp
    have hpowers :
        (c' * pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n) ^ (k + 1) ≤
          ((pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n + k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
      rw [mul_pow, pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pow]
      exact hnormalized.trans (by simpa [hcoefficient] using hdensity)
    have hbases :
        c' * pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n ≤
          ((pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n + k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact
        (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (mul_nonneg hc'0 hscale.le) (by positivity)
          (by omega)).mp hpowers
    have hshifted :
        c' ≤
          ((pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n + k : ℕ) : ℝ) /
            pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n :=
      (le_div_iff₀ hscale).2 hbases
    rw [pathTokenBurningRatio]
    push_cast at hshifted
    rw [add_div] at hshifted
    linarith
  · have hcneg : c < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hc0
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
      hcneg.le.trans (pathTokenBurningRatio_nonneg k n)

name: BurningPath.pathTokenLimitConstant_le_liminf
statement:
theorem pathTokenLimitConstant_le_liminf (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    pathTokenLimitConstant k ≤ liminf (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hupper :
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
        pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≤ generalUpperConstant k + 1 :=
    eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant_add
      k (by omega) (by norm_num)
  have hcob :
      atTop.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (pathTokenBurningRatio k) :=
    isCoboundedUnder_ge_of_eventually_le atTop hupper
  have hbdd :
      atTop.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (pathTokenBurningRatio k) := by
    change ∃ b : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≥ b
    exact ⟨0, Eventually.of_forall (pathTokenBurningRatio_nonneg k)⟩
  apply (le_liminf_iff' hcob hbdd).2
  intro c hc
  exact eventually_constant_le_pathTokenBurningRatio_of_lt_limit k hk hc

name: BurningPath.eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_candidateWidth
statement:
theorem eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_candidateWidth
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : pathTokenLimitConstant k < c) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≤
        (pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n : ℝ) /
          pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n
proof:
:= by
  have hcpos : 0 < c := (pathTokenLimitConstant_pos hk).trans hc
  have hcpow :
      cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k < c ^ (k + 1) := by
    rw [← pathTokenLimitConstant_pow hk]
    exact
      (pow_lt_pow_iff_left₀ (pathTokenLimitConstant_pos hk).le hcpos.le
        (by omega)).2 hc
  let d :=
    (cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k + c ^ (k + 1)) / 2
  have hCd : cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k < d := by
    dsimp [d]
    linarith
  have hdc : d < c ^ (k + 1) := by
    dsimp [d]
    linarith
  let η := d * Nat.factorial k - cubeBulkDensity k
  have hη : 0 < η := by
    dsimp [η]
    have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.factorial k := by positivity
    exact sub_pos.mpr ((div_lt_iff₀ hfac).mp hCd)
  have hcoefficient :
      (cubeBulkDensity k + η) / Nat.factorial k = d := by
    dsimp [η]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hleft :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          d * (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k / (n : ℝ) ^ k))
        atTop (𝓝 d) := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using
      tendsto_const_nhds.mul (tendsto_shiftedNatPowerRatio k)
  have hright :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (((pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) /
            pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n) ^ (k + 1))
        atTop (𝓝 (c ^ (k + 1))) :=
    (tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_sub_div_scale (by omega) hcpos).pow (k + 1)
  have hnormalized :
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        d * (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ k / (n : ℝ) ^ k) ≤
          (((pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) /
            pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n) ^ (k + 1) :=
    (hleft.eventually_lt hright hdc).mono fun _ hn ↦ hn.le
  have hside :=
    tendsto_pathTokenCandidateSimplexSide_atTop (k := k) (by omega) hcpos
  have hdensity :=
    hside.eventually (eventually_simplexCoverNumber_upper k hk hη)
  filter_upwards [hnormalized, hdensity, eventually_ge_atTop k,
      (tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_atTop (k := k) (by omega)
        hcpos).eventually_gt_atTop k,
      eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hnormalizedN hdensityN hkn ht hn
  let t := pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n
  let X : ℝ := ((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let Y : ℝ := ((t - k : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have hscale : 0 < pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n :=
    pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos hn
  have hnPow : 0 < (n : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
  have hY : 0 < Y := by
    dsimp [Y]
    exact_mod_cast (show 0 < t - k by omega)
  have hpower :
      d * X ^ k ≤ Y ^ (k + 1) := by
    calc
      d * X ^ k =
          (d * (X ^ k / (n : ℝ) ^ k)) * (n : ℝ) ^ k := by
        field_simp
      _ ≤
          (Y / pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n) ^ (k + 1) *
            (n : ℝ) ^ k := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        · simpa [X, Y, t] using hnormalizedN
        · exact hnPow.le
      _ = Y ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [div_pow, pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pow]
        field_simp
  have hvolume :
      d * (X / Y) ^ k ≤ Y := by
    rw [div_pow]
    calc
      d * (X ^ k / Y ^ k) = (d * X ^ k) / Y ^ k := by ring
      _ ≤ Y := (div_le_iff₀ (pow_pos hY k)).2 (by
        simpa [pow_succ, mul_comm] using hpower)
  have hcoverReal :
      (simplexCoverNumber k (X / Y) : ℝ) ≤ Y := by
    calc
      (simplexCoverNumber k (X / Y) : ℝ) ≤
          (cubeBulkDensity k + η) *
            ((X / Y) ^ k / Nat.factorial k) := by
        simpa [pathTokenCandidateSimplexSide, X, Y, t] using hdensityN
      _ = d * (X / Y) ^ k := by
        rw [← hcoefficient]
        ring
      _ ≤ Y := hvolume
  have hcoverNat :
      simplexCoverNumber k
        (((n - k : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((t - k : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ t - k := by
    exact_mod_cast (by simpa [X, Y] using hcoverReal)
  have hburn :
      pathTokenBurningNumber n k hkn ≤ t :=
    pathTokenBurningNumber_le_of_simplexCoverNumber_le_sub
      hk hkn (by simpa [t] using ht) hcoverNat
  have htotal : pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n ≤ t := by
    rw [pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_eq hkn]
    exact hburn
  rw [pathTokenBurningRatio]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast htotal) hscale.le

name: BurningPath.limsup_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_limitConstant
statement:
theorem limsup_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_limitConstant
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    limsup (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop ≤ pathTokenLimitConstant k
proof:
:= by
  have hcob :
      atTop.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (pathTokenBurningRatio k) :=
    isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le atTop (pathTokenBurningRatio_nonneg k)
  have hbdd :
      atTop.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (pathTokenBurningRatio k) := by
    change ∃ b : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≤ b
    exact
      ⟨generalUpperConstant k + 1,
        eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant_add
          k (by omega) (by norm_num)⟩
  apply (limsup_le_iff' hcob hbdd).2
  intro y hy
  let c := (pathTokenLimitConstant k + y) / 2
  have hCc : pathTokenLimitConstant k < c := by
    dsimp [c]
    linarith
  have hcy : c < y := by
    dsimp [c]
    linarith
  have hcandidate :=
    eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_candidateWidth k hk hCc
  have hcandidateLt :
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
        (pathTokenCandidateWidth k c n : ℝ) /
            pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n < y :=
    (tendsto_pathTokenCandidateWidth_div_scale (by omega)
      ((pathTokenLimitConstant_pos hk).trans hCc)).eventually
        (Iio_mem_nhds hcy)
  filter_upwards [hcandidate, hcandidateLt] with n hn hn'
  exact hn.trans hn'.le

name: BurningPath.pathTokenLimitConstant_variational_formula
statement:
theorem pathTokenLimitConstant_variational_formula (k : ℕ) :
    pathTokenLimitConstant k =
      ((1 / (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)) *
        sInf {x : ℝ | ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧
          x = (cubeCoverNumber k L : ℝ) / L ^ k}) ^
        (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathTokenLimitConstant, cubeBulkDensity]
  apply congrArg (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹)
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, mul_comm]

name: BurningPath.higherDimensionalConstant_bounds
statement:
theorem higherDimensionalConstant_bounds (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (((k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        pathTokenLimitConstant k ∧
      pathTokenLimitConstant k ≤
        ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) /
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * Nat.factorial k)) ^
            (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:=
  pathTokenLimitConstant_bounds hk

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_of_limsup_le
statement:
theorem tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_of_limsup_le (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    (hupper :
      limsup (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop ≤ pathTokenLimitConstant k) :
    Tendsto (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop
      (𝓝 (pathTokenLimitConstant k))
proof:
:= by
  have hboundedAbove :
      atTop.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) (pathTokenBurningRatio k) := by
    change ∃ b : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≤ b
    exact
      ⟨generalUpperConstant k + 1,
        eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant_add
          k (by omega) (by norm_num)⟩
  have hboundedBelow :
      atTop.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (pathTokenBurningRatio k) := by
    change ∃ b : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≥ b
    exact ⟨0, Eventually.of_forall (pathTokenBurningRatio_nonneg k)⟩
  exact
    tendsto_of_le_liminf_of_limsup_le
      (pathTokenLimitConstant_le_liminf k hk) hupper
      hboundedAbove hboundedBelow

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_limitConstant
statement:
theorem tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_limitConstant
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    Tendsto (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop
      (𝓝 (pathTokenLimitConstant k))
proof:
:=
  tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_of_limsup_le k hk
    (limsup_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_limitConstant k hk)

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningRatio_liminf_limsup
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurningRatio_liminf_limsup (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    pathTokenLimitConstant k ≤
        liminf (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop ∧
      liminf (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop ≤
        limsup (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop ∧
      limsup (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop ≤
        pathTokenLimitConstant k
proof:
:= by
  have hlimit := tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_limitConstant k hk
  rw [hlimit.liminf_eq, hlimit.limsup_eq]
  exact ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl, le_rfl⟩

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningRatio_liminf_eq
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurningRatio_liminf_eq (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :

proof:

  (tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_limitConstant k hk).liminf_eq

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningRatio_limsup_eq
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurningRatio_limsup_eq (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenBurningNumber_normalized
statement:
theorem tendsto_pathTokenBurningNumber_normalized
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
          (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)))
      atTop (𝓝 (pathTokenLimitConstant k))
proof:
:= by
  have hfun :
      pathTokenBurningRatio k =
        fun n : ℕ ↦
          (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
            (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)) := by
    funext n
    rw [pathTokenBurningRatio, pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow]
  rw [← hfun]
  exact tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_limitConstant k hk

name: BurningPath.higherDimensionalAsymptotic_variational
statement:
theorem higherDimensionalAsymptotic_variational
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    Tendsto (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop
      (𝓝
        (((1 / (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)) *
          sInf {x : ℝ | ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧
            x = (cubeCoverNumber k L : ℝ) / L ^ k}) ^
          (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹))

name: BurningPath.cubeBulkDensity_two
statement:
theorem cubeBulkDensity_two :
    cubeBulkDensity 2 = (3 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcandidate :
      pathTokenLimitConstant 2 ≤ shelfSharpConstant := by
    rw [← tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_two.liminf_eq]
    exact pathTokenLimitConstant_le_liminf 2 (by omega)
  have hpow :
      pathTokenLimitConstant 2 ^ 3 ≤ shelfSharpConstant ^ 3 :=
    (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (pathTokenLimitConstant_pos (by omega)).le
      shelfSharpConstant_pos.le (by norm_num : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).2 hcandidate
  have hupper : cubeBulkDensity 2 ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [pathTokenLimitConstant_pow (by omega),
      shelfSharpConstant_pow_three] at hpow
    norm_num at hpow ⊢
    linarith
  have hlower := cubeBulkDensity_lower (k := 2) (by omega)
  norm_num at hlower
  exact le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: BurningPath.interleavedRankEmbedding_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem interleavedRankEmbedding_val (M q : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (a : Fin M) (j : Fin q) :
    (interleavedRankEmbedding M q hM (a, j)).val = M * j.val + a.val
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.interleavedRank_normalized_le
statement:
theorem interleavedRank_normalized_le {M q : ℕ} (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (a : Fin M) (j : Fin q) :
    (j.val : ℝ) / q ≤
      ((interleavedRankEmbedding M q hM (a, j)).val : ℝ) / (M * q)
proof:
:= by
  have hMpos : (0 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hqpos : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hqpos (mul_pos hMpos hqpos)]
  have hnat :
      j.val * (M * q) ≤ (M * j.val + a.val) * q := by
    calc
      j.val * (M * q) = (M * j.val) * q := by ring
      _ ≤ (M * j.val + a.val) * q :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_right q (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  change
    (j.val : ℝ) * (M * q) ≤
      ((M * j.val + a.val : ℕ) : ℝ) * q
  exact_mod_cast hnat

name: BurningPath.hasL1NormalizedRankedCover_interleave
statement:
theorem hasL1NormalizedRankedCover_interleave {k M q : ℕ}
    {S : Set (Fin k → ℝ)} (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (centers : Fin M → Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ))
    (hlegal : ∀ a j, centers a j ∈ S)
    (hcover :
      ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ a : Fin M, ∃ j : Fin q,
        realL1Dist x (centers a j) ≤ (j.val : ℝ) / q) :
    HasL1NormalizedRankedCover S (M * q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := interleavedRankEmbedding M q hM
  let localCenters : Fin M × Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    fun p ↦ centers p.1 p.2
  let defaultCenter := centers ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let globalCenters : Fin (M * q) → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    Function.extend e localCenters (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter)
  have hglobal (a : Fin M) (j : Fin q) :
      globalCenters (e (a, j)) = centers a j := by
    exact e.injective.extend_apply localCenters (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter) (a, j)
  refine ⟨globalCenters, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r
    by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨⟨a, j⟩, rfl⟩ := hr
      rw [hglobal]
      exact hlegal a j
    · change Function.extend e localCenters (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter) r ∈ S
      rw [Function.extend_apply' localCenters (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter) r]
      · exact hlegal ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⟨0, by omega⟩
      · simpa only [Set.mem_range] using hr
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, j, hj⟩ := hcover x hx
    refine ⟨e (a, j), ?_⟩
    rw [hglobal]
    exact hj.trans (by simpa [e] using interleavedRank_normalized_le hM hq a j)

name: BurningPath.IsPathMetricRankedCover.isRankedCover_pathTokenGraph
proof:
:= by
