name: BurningPath.HasPathMetricRankedCover.isBurningLength_pathTokenGraph
statement:
theorem HasPathMetricRankedCover.isBurningLength_pathTokenGraph
    [Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) k)] {t : ℕ}
    (h : HasPathMetricRankedCover n k t) :
    (pathTokenGraph n k).IsBurningLength t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨centers, hcover⟩ := h
  have hfin : Nonempty (Fin t) := by
    obtain ⟨r, _⟩ :=
      hcover (Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) k)))
    exact ⟨r⟩
  exact
    ⟨Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mpr hfin, centers,
      hcover.isRankedCover_pathTokenGraph⟩

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningNumber_le_blockUpperBound
proof:
:= by
  letI := nonempty_configuration_of_le (Fin n) (by simpa using hk)
  change (pathTokenGraph n k).burningNumber ≤ blockUpperBound n k s
  apply (pathTokenGraph n k).burningNumber_min
  exact
    (hasPathMetricRankedCover_blockUpperBound hk hs).isBurningLength_pathTokenGraph

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningNumber_le_optimalBlockUpperBound
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurningNumber_le_optimalBlockUpperBound {n k : ℕ}
    (hnk : k + 1 ≤ n) :
    pathTokenBurningNumber n k ((Nat.le_add_right k 1).trans hnk) ≤
      optimalBlockUpperBound n k
proof:
:= by
  let hk : k ≤ n := (Nat.le_add_right k 1).trans hnk
  letI := nonempty_configuration_of_le (Fin n) (by simpa using hk)
  change (pathTokenGraph n k).burningNumber ≤ optimalBlockUpperBound n k
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := by omega
  obtain ⟨s, hs, _, hvalue⟩ :=
    optimalBlockUpperBound_spec (n := n) (k := k) hn
  rw [hvalue]
  apply (pathTokenGraph n k).burningNumber_min
  exact
    (hasPathMetricRankedCover_blockUpperBound hk hs).isBurningLength_pathTokenGraph

name: BurningPath.tendsto_cubeGridCount_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_cubeGridCount_div (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun L : ℝ ↦ (cubeGridCount k L : ℝ) / L)
      atTop (𝓝 (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by positivity
  have hceil :
      Tendsto (fun L : ℝ ↦ (⌈a * L⌉₊ : ℝ) / L)
        atTop (𝓝 a) :=
    tendsto_nat_ceil_mul_div_atTop ha
  apply hceil.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with L hL
  have haPos : 0 < a := by positivity
  have hceilPos : 1 ≤ ⌈a * L⌉₊ := by
    have : 0 < a * L := mul_pos haPos (by linarith)
    exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr this
  simp only [cubeGridCount, a]
  have harg :
      ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 * L =
        ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L / 2 := by ring
  rw [harg] at hceilPos ⊢
  rw [max_eq_right hceilPos]

name: BurningPath.tendsto_cubeGridDensityBound
statement:
theorem tendsto_cubeGridDensityBound (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (cubeGridDensityBound k) atTop
      (𝓝 ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) / 2 ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := (tendsto_cubeGridCount_div k).pow k
  have hmul :
      Tendsto
        (fun L : ℝ ↦
          ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (((cubeGridCount k L : ℝ) / L) ^ k))
        atTop
        (𝓝 (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2) ^ k))) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.mul hbase
  convert hmul using 1
  · funext L
    unfold cubeGridDensityBound
    push_cast
    rw [div_pow]
    ring
  · rw [div_pow, pow_succ']
    norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    ring

name: BurningPath.cubeCoverDensityAt_le_grid
statement:
theorem cubeCoverDensityAt_le_grid {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) :
    cubeCoverDensityAt k L ≤ cubeGridDensityBound k L
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubeCoverDensityAt cubeGridDensityBound
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
  · exact_mod_cast cubeCoverNumber_le_grid (k := k) hL.le
  · exact pow_nonneg hL.le k

name: BurningPath.cubeBulkDensity_le_explicit
statement:
theorem cubeBulkDensity_le_explicit (k : ℕ) :
    cubeBulkDensity k ≤
      (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) / 2 ^ k
proof:
:= by
  apply ge_of_tendsto (tendsto_cubeGridDensityBound k)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with L hL
  exact
    (cubeBulkDensity_le_densityAt (by linarith)).trans
      (cubeCoverDensityAt_le_grid (by linarith))

name: BurningPath.l1ClosedBall_eq_preimage_add
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [l1ClosedBall, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage]
  have hdist : realL1Dist x c = realL1Dist (-c + x) 0 := by
    rw [realL1Dist, realL1Dist]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.neg_apply, Pi.zero_apply]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hdist]

name: BurningPath.volume_l1ClosedBall_center
statement:
theorem volume_l1ClosedBall_center {k : ℕ} (c : Fin k → ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    volume (l1ClosedBall c r) =
      volume (l1ClosedBall (0 : Fin k → ℝ) r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [l1ClosedBall_eq_preimage_add]
  exact measure_preimage_add volume (-c) (l1ClosedBall 0 r)

name: BurningPath.volume_l1ClosedBall
statement:
theorem volume_l1ClosedBall {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (c : Fin k → ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    volume (l1ClosedBall c r) =
      ENNReal.ofReal r ^ k *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial)
proof:
:= by
  rw [volume_l1ClosedBall_center]
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (by omega)
  have h :=
    MeasureTheory.volume_sum_rpow_le (Fin k) (p := (1 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) r
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  rw [show l1ClosedBall (0 : Fin k → ℝ) r =
      {x : Fin k → ℝ |
        (∑ i, |x i| ^ (1 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (1 : ℝ)) ≤ r} by
    ext x
    simp [l1ClosedBall, realL1Dist]]
  rw [h]
  congr 2
  norm_num [Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]

name: BurningPath.volume_crossPolytope
statement:
theorem volume_crossPolytope {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    volume (crossPolytope k) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin k) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (by omega)
  have h :=
    MeasureTheory.volume_sum_rpow_le (Fin k) (p := (1 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) 1
  rw [show crossPolytope k =
      {x : Fin k → ℝ |
        (∑ i, |x i| ^ (1 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (1 : ℝ)) ≤ 1} by
    ext x
    simp [crossPolytope, realL1Dist]]
  rw [h]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_pow, one_mul]
  congr 1
  norm_num [Real.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial]

name: BurningPath.volume_realCube
statement:
theorem volume_realCube {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    volume (realCube k L) = ENNReal.ofReal (L ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show realCube k L = Set.Icc (0 : Fin k → ℝ) (fun _ ↦ L) by
    ext x
    simp only [realCube, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Icc, Pi.le_def, Pi.zero_apply]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨fun i ↦ (h i).1, fun i ↦ (h i).2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h0, h1⟩ i
      exact ⟨h0 i, h1 i⟩]
  rw [Real.volume_Icc_pi]
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pow hL k).symm

name: BurningPath.realCube_pow_le_rankedBallVolumeSum
proof:
:= by
  let balls : Fin q → Set (Fin k → ℝ) := fun i ↦
    l1ClosedBall (centers i) ((i.1 : ℝ) / q)
  have hsubset : realCube k L ⊆ ⋃ i, balls i := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover.2 x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, hi⟩
  have hvolume : volume (realCube k L) ≤ ∑ i, volume (balls i) :=
    (volume.mono hsubset).trans (measure_iUnion_fintype_le volume balls)
  rw [volume_realCube hL] at hvolume
  simp_rw [balls, volume_l1ClosedBall hk] at hvolume
  have hterm (i : Fin q) :
      ENNReal.ofReal ((i.1 : ℝ) / q) ^ k *
          ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial) ≠ ∞ :=
    ENNReal.mul_ne_top (ENNReal.pow_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
      ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hfinite :
      (∑ i : Fin q,
        ENNReal.ofReal ((i.1 : ℝ) / q) ^ k *
          ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial)) ≠ ∞ := by
    rw [ENNReal.sum_ne_top]
    exact fun i _ ↦ hterm i
  have hreal := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite hvolume
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (pow_nonneg hL k)] at hreal
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun i _ ↦ hterm i)] at hreal
  have hradius (i : Fin q) : 0 ≤ (i.1 : ℝ) / q := by positivity
  have hcoefficient : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial := by positivity
  simp_rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_pow,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hradius _),
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hcoefficient] at hreal
  calc
    L ^ k ≤ ∑ i : Fin q, ((i.1 : ℝ) / q) ^ k *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial) := hreal
    _ = (∑ i : Fin q, ((i.1 : ℝ) / q) ^ k) *
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial) :=
      (Finset.sum_mul Finset.univ
        (fun i : Fin q ↦ ((i.1 : ℝ) / q) ^ k) _).symm
    _ = ((2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial) *
        ∑ i : Fin q, ((i.1 : ℝ) / q) ^ k := mul_comm _ _

name: BurningPath.normalizedRankPowSum_le
statement:
theorem normalizedRankPowSum_le {k q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∑ i : Fin q, ((i.1 : ℝ) / q) ^ k ≤ (q : ℝ) / (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : MonotoneOn (fun x : ℝ ↦ x ^ k) (Set.Icc 0 (0 + q)) := by
    intro x hx y _ hxy
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hx.1 hxy k
  have hsum := hmono.sum_le_integral
  rw [integral_pow] at hsum
  norm_num at hsum
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun i ↦ ((i : ℝ) / q) ^ k
  change (∑ i : Fin q, f i.1) ≤ (q : ℝ) / (k + 1)
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range f]
  dsimp [f]
  simp_rw [div_pow]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  have hqR : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range q, (i : ℝ) ^ k) / (q : ℝ) ^ k ≤
        ((q : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) / (k + 1)) / (q : ℝ) ^ k :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hsum (pow_nonneg hqR.le k)
    _ = (q : ℝ) / (k + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ]
      field_simp

name: BurningPath.cubeNormalizedRankedCover_ratio_lower
proof:
:= by
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hvolume :=
    realCube_pow_le_rankedBallVolumeSum hk1 hq hL.le hcover
  have hsum := normalizedRankPowSum_le (k := k) hq
  have hcoefficient : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial := by positivity
  have hbound :
      L ^ k ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial) *
        ((q : ℝ) / (k + 1)) :=
    hvolume.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum hcoefficient)
  have hfactorial : (k.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hsucc : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp [hfactorial, hsucc] at hbound
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  nlinarith

name: BurningPath.cubeRankedCover_ratio_lower
statement:
theorem cubeRankedCover_ratio_lower {k q : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hL : 0 < L) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcover : HasCubeRankedCover k L q) :
    ((k.factorial : ℝ) * (k + 1)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤
      (q : ℝ) / L ^ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨centers, hcenters⟩ := hcover
  exact cubeNormalizedRankedCover_ratio_lower hk hL hq hcenters

name: BurningPath.burningPathToken_partA
statement:
theorem burningPathToken_partA (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (∀ {n : ℕ} (hnk : k + 1 ≤ n),
      volumeThreshold k (n.choose k) ≤
        pathTokenBurningNumber n k ((Nat.le_add_right k 1).trans hnk)) ∧
      (((k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        liminf
          (fun n : ℕ ↦
            (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
              (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)))
          atTop
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro n hnk
    exact pathToken_volumeThreshold_lower hnk
  · have hlimit := generalLowerAsymptotic_real_liminf k hk
    have hfun :
        pathTokenBurningRatio k =
          fun n : ℕ ↦
            (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
              (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)) := by
      funext n
      rw [pathTokenBurningRatio, pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow]
    rw [hfun] at hlimit
    simpa only [volumeLowerConstant, volumeLowerPowerConstant] using hlimit

name: BurningPath.burningPathToken_partB
statement:
theorem burningPathToken_partB (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (∀ {n : ℕ} (hnk : k + 1 ≤ n),
      pathTokenBurningNumber n k ((Nat.le_add_right k 1).trans hnk) ≤
        optimalBlockUpperBound n k) ∧
      limsup
          (fun n : ℕ ↦
            (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
              (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)))
          atTop ≤
        (k + 1 : ℝ) /
          (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro n hnk
    exact pathTokenBurningNumber_le_optimalBlockUpperBound hnk
  · exact generalUpperAsymptotic_limsup k hk

name: BurningPath.burningPathToken_partC
statement:
theorem burningPathToken_partC (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (fun n ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop]
      pathTokenStandardScale k
proof:
:=
  pathTokenBurning_isTheta_standardScale k hk

name: BurningPath.burningPathToken_partD
statement:
theorem burningPathToken_partD :
    (∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n),
      twoTokenCubicThreshold (n.choose 2) ≤
        pathTokenBurningNumber n 2 hn) ∧
      Tendsto
          (fun n : ℕ ↦
            (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ) /
              (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
          atTop (𝓝 ((3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℝ)⁻¹)) ∧
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ)) ~[atTop]
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          ((3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
            (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    exact twoTokenCubicThreshold_lower hn
  · change Tendsto twoTokenNormalizedBurning atTop (𝓝 shelfSharpConstant)
    exact tendsto_twoTokenNormalizedBurning
  · simpa only [shelfSharpConstant] using
      twoTokenBurning_isEquivalent_sharp

name: BurningPath.burningPathToken_partE
statement:
theorem burningPathToken_partE (k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
            (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)))
        atTop (𝓝 (pathTokenLimitConstant k)) ∧
      pathTokenLimitConstant k =
        ((1 / (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)) *
          sInf {x : ℝ | ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧
            x = (cubeCoverNumber k L : ℝ) / L ^ k}) ^
          (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ ∧
      ((((k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
          pathTokenLimitConstant k ∧
        pathTokenLimitConstant k ≤
          ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) /
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * Nat.factorial k)) ^
              (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tendsto_pathTokenBurningNumber_normalized k (by omega), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact pathTokenLimitConstant_variational_formula k
  · exact higherDimensionalConstant_bounds k (by omega)

name: BurningPath.burningPathToken_mainResult
statement:
theorem burningPathToken_mainResult :
    (∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k →
      ((∀ {n : ℕ} (hnk : k + 1 ≤ n),
        volumeThreshold k (n.choose k) ≤
          pathTokenBurningNumber n k ((Nat.le_add_right k 1).trans hnk)) ∧
        (((k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
          liminf
            (fun n : ℕ ↦
              (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
                (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)))
            atTop)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k →
        ((∀ {n : ℕ} (hnk : k + 1 ≤ n),
          pathTokenBurningNumber n k ((Nat.le_add_right k 1).trans hnk) ≤
            optimalBlockUpperBound n k) ∧
          limsup
              (fun n : ℕ ↦
                (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
                  (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)))
              atTop ≤
            (k + 1 : ℝ) /
              (k.factorial : ℝ) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, 2 ≤ k →
        (fun n ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop]
          pathTokenStandardScale k) ∧
      ((∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n),
        twoTokenCubicThreshold (n.choose 2) ≤
          pathTokenBurningNumber n 2 hn) ∧
        Tendsto
            (fun n : ℕ ↦
              (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ) /
                (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
            atTop (𝓝 ((3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℝ)⁻¹)) ∧
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ)) ~[atTop]
          (fun n : ℕ ↦
            ((3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
              (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))) ∧
      ((∀ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k →
        (Tendsto
            (fun n : ℕ ↦
              (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
                (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)))
            atTop (𝓝 (pathTokenLimitConstant k)) ∧
          pathTokenLimitConstant k =
            ((1 / (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)) *
              sInf {x : ℝ | ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧
                x = (cubeCoverNumber k L : ℝ) / L ^ k}) ^
              (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹ ∧
          ((((k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
              pathTokenLimitConstant k ∧
            pathTokenLimitConstant k ≤
              ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) /
                ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * Nat.factorial k)) ^
                  (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹)))) ∧
        cubeBulkDensity 2 = (3 / 2 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k hk
    exact burningPathToken_partA k hk
  · intro k hk
    exact burningPathToken_partB k hk
  · intro k hk
    exact burningPathToken_partC k hk
  · exact burningPathToken_partD
  · refine ⟨?_, cubeBulkDensity_two⟩
    intro k hk
    exact burningPathToken_partE k hk

name: BurningPath.ceilDiv_add_denominator
statement:
private theorem ceilDiv_add_denominator (n d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    (n + d) ⌈/⌉ d = n ⌈/⌉ d + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div, Nat.ceilDiv_eq_add_pred_div]
  have h : n + d + d - 1 = (n + d - 1) + d := by omega
  rw [h, Nat.add_div_right _ hd]

name: BurningPath.rankPaddingValue_strictMono
statement:
theorem rankPaddingValue_strictMono {q₀ q : ℕ} (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q) :
    StrictMono (rankPaddingValue q₀ q)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hq₀pos : 0 < q₀ := by omega
  have hstep : q * i + q₀ ≤ q * j := by
    calc
      q * i + q₀ ≤ q * i + q := Nat.add_le_add_left hqq₀ (q * i)
      _ = q * (i + 1) := by rw [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
      _ ≤ q * j := Nat.mul_le_mul_left q (Nat.add_one_le_iff.mpr hij)
  have hmono :
      (q * i + q₀) ⌈/⌉ q₀ ≤ (q * j) ⌈/⌉ q₀ :=
    (gc_mul_ceilDiv hq₀pos).monotone_l hstep
  rw [ceilDiv_add_denominator _ _ hq₀pos] at hmono
  exact Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le.mpr hmono

name: BurningPath.rankPaddingValue_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hq₀pos : 0 < q₀ := by omega
  calc
    rankPaddingValue q₀ q j.1 < rankPaddingValue q₀ q q₀ :=
      rankPaddingValue_strictMono hq₀ hqq₀ j.isLt
    _ = q := by
      simpa [rankPaddingValue, Nat.mul_comm] using smul_ceilDiv hq₀pos q

name: BurningPath.rankPaddingEmbedding_apply_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rankPaddingEmbedding_apply_val {q₀ q : ℕ} (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q)

name: BurningPath.rankPaddingEmbedding_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rankPaddingEmbedding_zero {q₀ q : ℕ} (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q) :
    rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀ ⟨0, by omega⟩ = ⟨0, by omega⟩
proof:

  apply Fin.ext
  simp [rankPaddingValue]

name: BurningPath.rankPaddingEmbedding_strictMono
statement:
theorem rankPaddingEmbedding_strictMono {q₀ q : ℕ} (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q) :
    StrictMono (rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀)
proof:

name: BurningPath.rankPaddingEmbedding_le_sub_one
statement:
theorem rankPaddingEmbedding_le_sub_one {q₀ q : ℕ} (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q)
    (j : Fin q₀) :
    (rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀ j).1 ≤ q - 1
proof:
:= by

name: BurningPath.rankPaddingEmbedding_cross_mul
statement:
theorem rankPaddingEmbedding_cross_mul {q₀ q : ℕ} (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q)
    (j : Fin q₀) :
    q * j.1 ≤ q₀ * (rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀ j).1
proof:
:= by
  have hq₀pos : 0 < q₀ := by omega
  simpa [rankPaddingValue] using
    (le_smul_ceilDiv (a := q₀) (b := q * j.1) hq₀pos)

name: BurningPath.rankPaddingEmbedding_normalized_le
statement:
theorem rankPaddingEmbedding_normalized_le {q₀ q : ℕ} (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀)
    (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q) (j : Fin q₀) :
    (j.1 : ℝ) / q₀ ≤ ((rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀ j).1 : ℝ) / q
proof:
:= by
  have hq₀pos : 0 < q₀ := by omega
  have hqpos : 0 < q := hq₀pos.trans_le hqq₀
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by exact_mod_cast hq₀pos) (by exact_mod_cast hqpos)]
  have hcross :
      j.1 * q ≤ (rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀ j).1 * q₀ := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using rankPaddingEmbedding_cross_mul hq₀ hqq₀ j
  exact_mod_cast hcross

name: BurningPath.IsNormalizedRankedCover.pad
statement:
theorem IsNormalizedRankedCover.pad [Nonempty C] {covers : C → ℝ → X → Prop}
    {q₀ q : ℕ} (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hqq₀ : q₀ ≤ q) {centers : Fin q₀ → C}
    (hcover : IsNormalizedRankedCover covers centers)
    (hmono : ∀ c x {r s : ℝ}, r ≤ s → covers c r x → covers c s x) :
    ∃ padded : Fin q → C,
      IsNormalizedRankedCover covers padded ∧
        ∀ j, padded (rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀ j) = centers j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := rankPaddingEmbedding q₀ q hq₀ hqq₀
  let padded : Fin q → C :=
    Function.extend e centers (fun _ ↦ Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty C))
  have hpadded : ∀ j, padded (e j) = centers j := by
    intro j
    exact e.injective.extend_apply centers
      (fun _ ↦ Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty C)) j
  refine ⟨padded, ?_, hpadded⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcover x
  refine ⟨e j, ?_⟩
  rw [hpadded j]
  exact hmono _ _ (rankPaddingEmbedding_normalized_le hq₀ hqq₀ j) hj

name: BurningPath.cubeCoverDensityAt_le_simplexCoverDensityAt

:= by

    (cubeCoverDensityAt_le_simplexCoverDensityAt hk hL)

name: BurningPath.simplexCoverNumber_lower
statement:
theorem simplexCoverNumber_lower {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {ε L : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hL : 0 < L) :
    (cubeBulkDensity k - ε) *
        (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
      (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdensity :=
    cubeBulkDensity_le_simplexCoverDensityAt (show 1 ≤ k by omega) hL
  have hvolume : 0 < L ^ k / Nat.factorial k := by positivity
  unfold simplexCoverDensityAt at hdensity
  have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ hvolume).mp
    ((sub_le_self _ hε.le).trans hdensity)
  exact hmul

name: BurningPath.sum_range_choose
statement:
theorem sum_range_choose (t j : ℕ) :
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.range t, r.choose j = t.choose (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
      simpa [add_comm] using (Nat.choose_succ_succ' t j).symm

name: BurningPath.cumulativeLatticeBallPolynomial_eq
statement:
theorem cumulativeLatticeBallPolynomial_eq (k t : ℕ) :
    cumulativeLatticeBallPolynomial k t = rankedVolumePolynomial k t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cumulativeLatticeBallPolynomial, latticeBallPolynomial, rankedVolumePolynomial]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_range_choose]

name: BurningPath.three_mul_rankedVolumePolynomial_two
statement:
theorem three_mul_rankedVolumePolynomial_two (t : ℕ) :
    3 * rankedVolumePolynomial 2 t = t * (2 * t ^ 2 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [rankedVolumePolynomial]
  | succ t ih =>
      simp only [rankedVolumePolynomial, Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.reduceAdd,
        Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.choose_one_right, Nat.choose_self, Nat.choose_succ_succ',
        pow_zero, pow_one, one_mul, Nat.reducePow, Finset.sum_range_zero,
        Finset.sum_range_succ] at ih ⊢
      cases t with
      | zero => norm_num at ih ⊢
      | succ t =>
          have hchoose := Nat.choose_succ_right_eq (t + 1) 1
          simp only [Nat.choose_one_right, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hchoose
          nlinarith

name: BurningPath.rankedVolumePolynomial_two
statement:
theorem rankedVolumePolynomial_two (t : ℕ) :
    rankedVolumePolynomial 2 t = t * (2 * t ^ 2 + 1) / 3
proof:
:= by
  refine (Nat.div_eq_of_eq_mul_left (by norm_num : 0 < 3) ?_).symm
  simpa [mul_comm] using (three_mul_rankedVolumePolynomial_two t).symm

name: BurningPath.le_rankedVolumePolynomial
statement:
theorem le_rankedVolumePolynomial (k t : ℕ) :
    t ≤ rankedVolumePolynomial k t
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : 0 ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := by simp
  calc
    t = 2 ^ 0 * k.choose 0 * t.choose (0 + 1) := by simp
    _ ≤ rankedVolumePolynomial k t := by
      unfold rankedVolumePolynomial
      exact Finset.single_le_sum
        (f := fun j ↦ 2 ^ j * k.choose j * t.choose (j + 1))
        (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) hzero

name: BurningPath.exists_isVolumeThresholdLength
statement:
theorem exists_isVolumeThresholdLength (k N : ℕ) :
    ∃ t, IsVolumeThresholdLength k N t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨N + 1, Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le N), ?_⟩
  exact (Nat.le_succ N).trans (le_rankedVolumePolynomial k (N + 1))

name: BurningPath.volumeThreshold_spec

name: BurningPath.volumeThreshold_min

name: BurningPath.isVolumeThresholdLength_two_iff
statement:
theorem isVolumeThresholdLength_two_iff (N t : ℕ) :
    IsVolumeThresholdLength 2 N t ↔
      1 ≤ t ∧ N ≤ t * (2 * t ^ 2 + 1) / 3
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsVolumeThresholdLength, rankedVolumePolynomial_two]

name: BurningPath.twoTokenCubicThreshold_spec
statement:
theorem twoTokenCubicThreshold_spec (N : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ twoTokenCubicThreshold N ∧
      N ≤ twoTokenCubicThreshold N *
        (2 * twoTokenCubicThreshold N ^ 2 + 1) / 3
proof:
:= by
  exact (isVolumeThresholdLength_two_iff N (volumeThreshold 2 N)).mp
    (volumeThreshold_spec 2 N)

name: BurningPath.twoTokenCubicThreshold_min
proof:

  exact volumeThreshold_min ((isVolumeThresholdLength_two_iff N t).mpr h)

statement:

name: BurningPath.pathConfigurationDist_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (configurationEquivOrderEmbedding (Fin n) k).injective
    ext i
    exact Nat.eq_of_dist_eq_zero <|
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _).mp h i (Finset.mem_univ i)
  · rintro rfl

name: BurningPath.natDist_eq_natAbs_intSub
statement:
theorem natDist_eq_natAbs_intSub (a b : ℕ) :
    Nat.dist a b = ((a : ℤ) - b).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · rw [Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le hab, Int.natAbs_natCast_sub_natCast_of_le hab]
  · rw [Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le_right hba, Int.natAbs_natCast_sub_natCast_of_ge hba]

name: BurningPath.tendsto_simplexCoverDensityAt
statement:
theorem tendsto_simplexCoverDensityAt (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    Tendsto (simplexCoverDensityAt k) atTop (𝓝 (cubeBulkDensity k))
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_order.2
  constructor
  · intro l hl
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with L hL
    exact hl.trans_le
      (cubeBulkDensity_le_simplexCoverDensityAt
        (show 1 ≤ k by omega) (by linarith))
  · intro U hU
    have hε : 0 < (U - cubeBulkDensity k) / 2 := by linarith
    have hstrict :
        cubeBulkDensity k + (U - cubeBulkDensity k) / 2 < U := by
      linarith
    filter_upwards
      [eventually_simplexCoverDensityAt_le_cubeBulkDensity_add k hk hε]
      with L hL
    exact hL.trans_lt hstrict

name: BurningPath.eventually_simplexCoverDensityAt_bounds
statement:
theorem eventually_simplexCoverDensityAt_bounds
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ L : ℝ in atTop,
      cubeBulkDensity k - ε ≤ simplexCoverDensityAt k L ∧
        simplexCoverDensityAt k L ≤ cubeBulkDensity k + ε
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards
    [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ),
      eventually_simplexCoverDensityAt_le_cubeBulkDensity_add k hk hε]
    with L hL hupper
  constructor
  · exact
      (sub_le_self _ hε.le).trans
        (cubeBulkDensity_le_simplexCoverDensityAt
          (show 1 ≤ k by omega) (by linarith))
  · exact hupper

name: BurningPath.eventually_simplexCoverNumber_bounds
statement:
theorem eventually_simplexCoverNumber_bounds
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ L : ℝ in atTop,
      (cubeBulkDensity k - ε) *
            (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
          (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) ∧
        (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) ≤
          (cubeBulkDensity k + ε) *
            (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards
    [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ),
      eventually_simplexCoverNumber_upper k hk hε]
    with L hL hupper
  exact ⟨simplexCoverNumber_lower hk hε (by linarith), hupper⟩

name: BurningPath.exists_simplexCoverNumber_bounds_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_simplexCoverNumber_bounds_threshold
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ Lε : ℝ, ∀ L ≥ Lε,
      (cubeBulkDensity k - ε) *
            (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
          (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) ∧
        (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) ≤
          (cubeBulkDensity k + ε) *
            (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k)
proof:
:= by
  exact eventually_atTop.1
    (eventually_simplexCoverNumber_bounds k hk hε)

name: BurningPath.pathTokenStandardScale_nonneg
statement:
theorem pathTokenStandardScale_nonneg (k n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ pathTokenStandardScale k n
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathTokenStandardScale
  positivity

name: BurningPath.pathTokenStandardScale_pos
statement:
theorem pathTokenStandardScale_pos {k n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    0 < pathTokenStandardScale k n
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathTokenStandardScale
  exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hn) _

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurning_isBigO_standardScale
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurning_isBigO_standardScale (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (fun n ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ)) =O[atTop]
      pathTokenStandardScale k
proof:
:= by
  let C := generalUpperConstant k + 1
  have hupper :=
    eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant_add
      k (by omega) (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)
  refine IsBigO.of_bound C ?_
  filter_upwards [hupper, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hnpos
  have hscale : 0 < pathTokenStandardScale k n :=
    pathTokenStandardScale_pos hnpos
  have hn' :
      (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
          pathTokenStandardScale k n ≤ C := by
    simpa [C, pathTokenBurningRatio, pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow,
      pathTokenStandardScale] using hn
  have hmul :
      (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ≤
        C * pathTokenStandardScale k n := by
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hscale).mp hn'
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg,
    pathTokenStandardScale_nonneg] using hmul

name: BurningPath.standardScale_isBigO_pathTokenBurning
statement:
theorem standardScale_isBigO_pathTokenBurning (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    pathTokenStandardScale k =O[atTop]
      (fun n ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let c := volumeLowerConstant k / 2
  have hc : 0 < c := by
    dsimp [c]
    exact half_pos (volumeLowerConstant_pos k)
  have hlower :=
    eventually_generalLowerAsymptotic k hk
      (show 0 < volumeLowerConstant k / 2 by exact hc)
  refine IsBigO.of_bound c⁻¹ ?_
  filter_upwards [hlower, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hnpos
  have hscaleNonneg := pathTokenStandardScale_nonneg k n
  have hburnNonneg :
      0 ≤ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hlower' :
      c * pathTokenStandardScale k n ≤
        (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) := by
    have hn' := hn
    change
      (volumeLowerConstant k - volumeLowerConstant k / 2) *
          pathTokenStandardScale k n ≤
        (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) at hn'
    have heq :
        volumeLowerConstant k - volumeLowerConstant k / 2 = c := by
      dsimp [c]
      ring
    rwa [heq] at hn'
  have hdiv :
      pathTokenStandardScale k n ≤
        (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) / c := by
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hc).2 (by simpa [mul_comm] using hlower')
  have hbound :
      pathTokenStandardScale k n ≤
        c⁻¹ * (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) := by
    simpa [div_eq_inv_mul] using hdiv
  simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hscaleNonneg,
    abs_of_nonneg hburnNonneg] using hbound

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurning_isTheta_standardScale
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurning_isTheta_standardScale (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (fun n ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop]
      pathTokenStandardScale k
proof:
:=
  ⟨pathTokenBurning_isBigO_standardScale k hk,
    standardScale_isBigO_pathTokenBurning k hk⟩

name: BurningPath.generalLowerAsymptotic_real_liminf
statement:
theorem generalLowerAsymptotic_real_liminf (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    volumeLowerConstant k ≤ liminf (pathTokenBurningRatio k) atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hupper :
      ∀ᶠ n in atTop,
        pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≤ generalUpperConstant k + 1 :=
    eventually_pathTokenBurningRatio_le_generalUpperConstant_add
      k (by omega) (by norm_num)
  have hcob :
      atTop.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (pathTokenBurningRatio k) :=
    isCoboundedUnder_ge_of_eventually_le atTop hupper
  have hbdd :
      atTop.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) (pathTokenBurningRatio k) :=
    by
      change ∃ b : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, pathTokenBurningRatio k n ≥ b
      exact ⟨0, Eventually.of_forall (pathTokenBurningRatio_nonneg k)⟩
  apply (le_liminf_iff' hcob hbdd).2
  intro c hc
  exact eventually_constant_le_pathTokenBurningRatio k (by omega) hc

name: BurningPath.twoTokenLowerAsymptotic_liminf
statement:
theorem twoTokenLowerAsymptotic_liminf :
    ((3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      liminf
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ) /
            (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
        atTop
proof:
:= by
  have h := generalLowerAsymptotic_real_liminf 2 (by omega)
  norm_num [volumeLowerConstant, volumeLowerPowerConstant] at h
  have hfun :
      pathTokenBurningRatio 2 =
        fun n : ℕ ↦
          (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ) /
            (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    funext n
    rw [pathTokenBurningRatio, pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow]
    norm_num
  rw [hfun] at h
  convert h using 1
  norm_num [one_div]

name: BurningPath.exists_isBlockUpperBoundValue

name: BurningPath.optimalBlockUpperBound_spec

name: BurningPath.parityCap_zero

name: BurningPath.mem_integerSquare
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_integerSquare {c p : ℤ × ℤ} {r : ℕ} :
    p ∈ integerSquare c r ↔ intLinfDist p c ≤ r
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: BurningPath.parityCapApex_mem
proof:
:= by
  simp only [parityCapApex, parityCap, Set.mem_setOf_eq, abs_zero, Nat.cast_add]
  constructor
  · omega
  constructor
  · omega
  constructor
  · omega

name: BurningPath.parityCap_subset_apex_square
statement:
theorem parityCap_subset_apex_square (h z : ℕ) (σ : ℤ) :
    parityCap h z σ ⊆ integerSquare (parityCapApex h z) z
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rcases hp with ⟨hY, hYtop, hX, hpar⟩
  simp only [integerSquare, intLinfDist, parityCapApex, Set.mem_setOf_eq, max_le_iff]
  constructor
  · simpa only [sub_zero] using hX.trans (by omega)
  · rw [abs_le]

name: BurningPath.parityCap_subset_terminal_square
statement:
theorem parityCap_subset_terminal_square {h z w : ℕ} (σ : ℤ) (hz : z ≤ w - 1) :
    parityCap h z σ ⊆ integerSquare (parityCapApex h z) (w - 1)
proof:
:=
  fun p hp ↦ by
    have hbase := parityCap_subset_apex_square h z σ hp
    change intLinfDist p (parityCapApex h z) ≤ (z : ℤ) at hbase
    change intLinfDist p (parityCapApex h z) ≤ ((w - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)
    exact hbase.trans (by exact_mod_cast hz)

name: BurningPath.exists_mem_abs_sub_le_of_chain
statement:
theorem exists_mem_abs_sub_le_of_chain (a : ℕ) (x : ℤ) (xs : List ℤ)
    (hchain : (x :: xs).IsChain fun u v ↦ v - u ≤ 2 * (a : ℤ)) {X : ℤ}
    (hleft : x - (a : ℤ) ≤ X)
    (hright : X ≤ (x :: xs).getLast (by simp) + (a : ℤ)) :
    ∃ c ∈ x :: xs, |X - c| ≤ (a : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing x with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨x, by simp, ?_⟩
      have hright' : X ≤ x + (a : ℤ) := by
        simpa using hright
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> omega
  | cons y ys ih =>
      have hparts :
          y - x ≤ 2 * (a : ℤ) ∧
            (y :: ys).IsChain (fun u v ↦ v - u ≤ 2 * (a : ℤ)) :=
        List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hchain
      by_cases hX : X ≤ x + a
      · refine ⟨x, by simp, ?_⟩
        rw [abs_le]
        constructor <;> omega
      · have hrightTail :
            X ≤ (y :: ys).getLast (by simp) + (a : ℤ) := by
          simpa using hright
        obtain ⟨c, hc, hdist⟩ :=
          ih y hparts.2 (by omega) hrightTail
        exact ⟨c, by simp [hc], hdist⟩

name: BurningPath.exists_fin_abs_sub_le_of_chain
statement:
theorem exists_fin_abs_sub_le_of_chain (a q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (f : Fin q → ℤ)
    (hstep :
      ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < q),
        f ⟨i + 1, hi⟩ - f ⟨i, by omega⟩ ≤ 2 * (a : ℤ))
    {X : ℤ}
    (hleft : f ⟨0, hq⟩ - (a : ℤ) ≤ X)
    (hright : X ≤ f ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ + (a : ℤ)) :
    ∃ i : Fin q, |X - f i| ≤ (a : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing X with
  | h q ih =>
      cases q with
      | zero => omega
      | succ q =>
          cases q with
          | zero =>
              have hright0 :
                  X ≤ f ⟨0, by omega⟩ + (a : ℤ) := by
                simpa using hright
              refine ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
              rw [abs_le]
              constructor <;> omega
          | succ q =>
              let first : Fin (q + 2) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
              have hleftFirst : f first - (a : ℤ) ≤ X := by
                simpa [first] using hleft
              by_cases hX : X ≤ f first + (a : ℤ)
              · refine ⟨first, ?_⟩
                rw [abs_le]
                constructor <;> omega
              · let tail : Fin (q + 1) → ℤ := fun i ↦ f i.succ
                have htailStep :
                    ∀ i (hi : i + 1 < q + 1),
                      tail ⟨i + 1, hi⟩ - tail ⟨i, by omega⟩ ≤
                        2 * (a : ℤ) := by
                  intro i hi
                  simpa [tail] using hstep (i + 1) (by omega)
                have hgap :
                    f ⟨1, by omega⟩ - f first ≤ 2 * (a : ℤ) := by
                  simpa [first] using hstep 0 (by omega)
                have htailLeft :
                    tail ⟨0, by omega⟩ - (a : ℤ) ≤ X := by
                  change f ⟨1, by omega⟩ - (a : ℤ) ≤ X
                  omega
                have htailRight :
                    X ≤ tail ⟨q, by omega⟩ + (a : ℤ) := by
                  simpa [tail] using hright
                obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ :=
                  ih (q + 1) (by omega) (by omega) tail htailStep
                    htailLeft htailRight
                exact ⟨i.succ, by simpa [tail] using hi⟩

name: BurningPath.exists_shelf_centers
statement:
theorem exists_shelf_centers {h z w q : ℕ} {σ : ℤ}
    (hσ : (h + z : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2])
    (hw : 3 ≤ w) (hz : w - 1 < z)
    (hq2 : 2 ≤ q) (hqw : q < w) (hcapacity : z ≤ q * (w - q)) :
    ∃ centers : Fin q → ℤ × ℤ,
      (∀ i, centers i ∈ parityCap h z σ) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ parityCap h z σ,
          p.2 ≤ (h + 2 * (w - q) : ℕ) →
            ∃ i, p ∈ integerSquare (centers i) (w - (i.val + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a := w - q
  have haPos : 0 < a := by omega
  have hzW : w ≤ z := by omega
  have haZ : a ≤ z := by omega
  have hqa : q * a = (q - 1) * a + a := by
    calc
      q * a = ((q - 1) + 1) * a := by congr 1; omega
      _ = (q - 1) * a + a := by rw [Nat.add_mul]; simp
  have hallocation : z - a ≤ (q - 1) * a := by
    change z ≤ q * a at hcapacity
    omega
  obtain ⟨e, heBound, heSum⟩ :=
    exists_fin_bounded_composition (q - 1) a (z - a) hallocation
  let eNat : ℕ → ℕ := fun j ↦ if hj : j < q - 1 then e ⟨j, hj⟩ else 0
  have heNatBound (j : ℕ) : eNat j ≤ a := by
    by_cases hj : j < q - 1
    · simpa [eNat, hj] using heBound ⟨j, hj⟩
    · simp [eNat, hj]
  have heNatSum :
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (q - 1), eNat j = z - a := by
    rw [← heSum, Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range]
  let partialSum : Fin q → ℕ :=
    fun i ↦ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range i.val, eNat j
  let ξ : Fin q → ℤ :=
    fun i ↦ -(z : ℤ) + (a : ℤ) + 2 * (partialSum i : ℤ)
  let centers : Fin q → ℤ × ℤ :=
    fun i ↦ (ξ i, (h + a : ℕ))
  have hpartialSum_le (i : Fin q) : partialSum i ≤ z - a := by
    calc
      partialSum i ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (q - 1), eNat j := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset
        exact Finset.range_mono (by omega)
      _ = z - a := heNatSum
  have hξBounds (i : Fin q) :
      -((z - a : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ ξ i ∧ ξ i ≤ ((z - a : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
    have hp := hpartialSum_le i
    have hcast : ((z - a : ℕ) : ℤ) = (z : ℤ) - a := by
      omega
    simp only [ξ]
    rw [hcast]
    constructor <;> omega
  have hlegal (i : Fin q) : centers i ∈ parityCap h z σ := by
    have hbounds := hξBounds i
    simp only [centers, parityCap, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · push_cast
      omega
    constructor
    · push_cast
      omega
    constructor
    · have hza :
          ((h + z : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((h + a : ℕ) : ℤ) =
            ((z - a : ℕ) : ℤ) := by
        omega
      rw [hza]
      rw [abs_le]
      exact hbounds
    · rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd] at hσ ⊢
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hσ
      refine ⟨d + h + z - partialSum i, ?_⟩
      simp only [ξ]
      push_cast
      omega
  have hξStep :
      ∀ j (hj : j + 1 < q),
        ξ ⟨j + 1, hj⟩ - ξ ⟨j, by omega⟩ ≤ 2 * (a : ℤ) := by
    intro j hj
    have he := heNatBound j
    simp only [ξ, partialSum, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    push_cast
    omega
  have hξFirst : ξ ⟨0, by omega⟩ = -(z : ℤ) + a := by
    simp [ξ, partialSum]
  have hξLast : ξ ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ = (z : ℤ) - a := by
    have hsum :
        partialSum ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ = z - a := by
      exact heNatSum
    simp only [ξ, hsum]
    exact_mod_cast (show -(z : ℤ) + a + 2 * (z - a) = z - a by omega)
  refine ⟨centers, hlegal, ?_⟩
  intro p hp hpY
  have hpBottom : (h : ℤ) ≤ p.2 := hp.1
  have hpSide : |p.1| ≤ (h + z : ℕ) - p.2 := hp.2.2.1
  have hpX : -(z : ℤ) ≤ p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ (z : ℤ) := by
    rw [abs_le] at hpSide
    constructor <;> omega
  have hleft : ξ ⟨0, by omega⟩ - (a : ℤ) ≤ p.1 := by
    rw [hξFirst]
    omega
  have hright : p.1 ≤ ξ ⟨q - 1, by omega⟩ + (a : ℤ) := by
    rw [hξLast]
    omega
  obtain ⟨i, hiX⟩ :=
    exists_fin_abs_sub_le_of_chain a q (by omega) ξ hξStep hleft hright
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  simp only [integerSquare, intLinfDist, centers, Set.mem_setOf_eq, max_le_iff]
  have hiY : |p.2 - (h + a : ℕ)| ≤ (a : ℤ) := by
    rw [abs_le]
    push_cast at hpY ⊢
    constructor <;> omega
  have haRadius : a ≤ w - (i.val + 1) := by
    simp only [a]
    omega
  constructor
  · exact hiX.trans (by exact_mod_cast haRadius)
  · exact hiY.trans (by exact_mod_cast haRadius)

name: BurningPath.mem_residual_parityCap
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp with ⟨hpBottom, hpTop, hpSide, hpParity⟩
  have hapex : h + 2 * a + (z - 2 * a) = h + z := by omega
  have hapexInt :
      ((h + 2 * a : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((z - 2 * a : ℕ) : ℤ) = (h : ℤ) + z := by
    exact_mod_cast hapex
  simp only [parityCap, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · exact_mod_cast hY
  constructor
  · rw [hapexInt]
    exact hpTop
  constructor
  · rw [hapex]
    exact hpSide
  · exact hpParity

name: BurningPath.exists_shelf_centers_cover_cap
statement:
theorem exists_shelf_centers_cover_cap {h z w q : ℕ} {σ : ℤ}
    (hσ : (h + z : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2])
    (hw : 3 ≤ w) (hz : w - 1 < z)
    (hq2 : 2 ≤ q) (hqw : q < w) (hcapacity : z ≤ q * (w - q))
    (hterminal : z ≤ 2 * (w - q)) :
    ∃ centers : Fin q → ℤ × ℤ,
      (∀ i, centers i ∈ parityCap h z σ) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ parityCap h z σ,
          ∃ i, p ∈ integerSquare (centers i) (w - (i.val + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨centers, hlegal, hband⟩ :=
    exists_shelf_centers hσ hw hz hq2 hqw hcapacity
  refine ⟨centers, hlegal, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  apply hband p hp
  have hpTop : p.2 ≤ (h + z : ℕ) := hp.2.1
  exact hpTop.trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_left hterminal h)

name: BurningPath.exists_shelf_centers_with_residual
statement:
theorem exists_shelf_centers_with_residual {h z w q : ℕ} {σ : ℤ}
    (hσ : (h + z : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2])
    (hw : 3 ≤ w) (hz : w - 1 < z)
    (hq2 : 2 ≤ q) (hqw : q < w) (hcapacity : z ≤ q * (w - q))
    (hnonterminal : 2 * (w - q) < z) :
    ∃ centers : Fin q → ℤ × ℤ,
      (∀ i, centers i ∈ parityCap h z σ) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ parityCap h z σ,
          p.2 ≤ (h + 2 * (w - q) : ℕ) →
            ∃ i, p ∈ integerSquare (centers i) (w - (i.val + 1))) ∧
        ∀ p ∈ parityCap h z σ,
          (∀ i, p ∉ integerSquare (centers i) (w - (i.val + 1))) →
            p ∈ parityCap (h + 2 * (w - q)) (z - 2 * (w - q)) σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨centers, hlegal, hband⟩ :=
    exists_shelf_centers hσ hw hz hq2 hqw hcapacity
  refine ⟨centers, hlegal, hband, ?_⟩
  intro p hp huncovered
  have hpAbove :
      ((h + 2 * (w - q) : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ p.2 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hpY : p.2 ≤ ((h + 2 * (w - q) : ℕ) : ℤ) := by omega
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hband p hp hpY
    exact huncovered i hi
  exact mem_residual_parityCap (by omega) hp hpAbove

name: BurningPath.coordinate_mem'
statement:
private theorem coordinate_mem' {n k : ℕ} (A : Configuration (Fin n) k) (i : Fin k) :
    coordinate A i ∈ A.1
proof:
:= by
  change A.1.orderEmbOfFin A.2 i ∈ A.1
  exact Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem A.1 A.2 i

name: BurningPath.coordinate_eq_update_of_move
statement:
private theorem coordinate_eq_update_of_move {n k : ℕ}
    {A C : Configuration (Fin n) k} (i : Fin k) (v : Fin n) (hvA : v ∉ A.1)
    (hC : C.1 = insert v (A.1.erase (coordinate A i)))
    (hAC : (pathTokenGraph n k).Adj A C) :
    coordinate C = Function.update (coordinate A) i v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, w, _, hwA, hcoordinate⟩ :=
    pathTokenGraph_adj_exists_coordinate_update A C hAC
  have hwC : w ∈ C.1 := by
    have hrw : coordinate C r = w := by
      rw [hcoordinate, Function.update_self]
    rw [← hrw]
    exact coordinate_mem' C r
  have hwv : w = v := by
    rw [hC] at hwC
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hwC with hwv | hwErase
    · exact hwv
    · exact (hwA (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hwErase)).elim
  subst w
  have hremoved : coordinate A r ∉ C.1 := by
    intro hrC
    have hrRange : coordinate A r ∈ Set.range (C.1.orderEmbOfFin C.2) := by
      rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
      exact hrC
    obtain ⟨s, hs'⟩ := hrRange
    have hs : coordinate C s = coordinate A r := by
      change C.1.orderEmbOfFin C.2 s = coordinate A r
      exact hs'
    rw [hcoordinate] at hs
    by_cases hsr : s = r
    · subst s
      rw [Function.update_self] at hs
      exact hvA (hs ▸ coordinate_mem' A r)
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hsr] at hs
      exact hsr ((coordinate_strictMono A).injective hs)
  have hri : r = i := by
    apply (coordinate_strictMono A).injective
    rw [hC] at hremoved
    by_contra hne
    apply hremoved
    exact Finset.mem_insert.mpr <|
      Or.inr (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, coordinate_mem' A r⟩)
  subst r
  exact hcoordinate

name: BurningPath.pathConfigurationDist_eq_succ_of_update
statement:
private theorem pathConfigurationDist_eq_succ_of_update {n k : ℕ}
    {A B C : Configuration (Fin n) k} (i : Fin k) (v : Fin n)
    (hcoordinate : coordinate C = Function.update (coordinate A) i v)
    (hstep :
      Nat.dist (coordinate A i).val (coordinate B i).val =
        Nat.dist v.val (coordinate B i).val + 1) :
    pathConfigurationDist A B = pathConfigurationDist C B + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let fA := fun j : Fin k ↦ Nat.dist (coordinate A j).val (coordinate B j).val
  let fC := fun j : Fin k ↦ Nat.dist (coordinate C j).val (coordinate B j).val
  have hi : fA i = fC i + 1 := by
    simp only [fA, fC]
    rw [hcoordinate, Function.update_self]
    exact hstep
  have hrest :
      (Finset.univ.erase i).sum fA = (Finset.univ.erase i).sum fC := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hji : j ≠ i := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1
    simp only [fA, fC]
    rw [hcoordinate, Function.update_of_ne hji]
  change ∑ j, fA j = (∑ j, fC j) + 1
  calc
    ∑ j, fA j = fA i + (Finset.univ.erase i).sum fA :=
      (Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ fA (Finset.mem_univ i)).symm
    _ = (fC i + 1) + (Finset.univ.erase i).sum fC := by rw [hi, hrest]
    _ = (fC i + (Finset.univ.erase i).sum fC) + 1 := by omega
    _ = (∑ j, fC j) + 1 := by
      rw [Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ fC (Finset.mem_univ i)]

name: BurningPath.exists_adj_pathConfigurationDist_eq_succ
statement:
private theorem exists_adj_pathConfigurationDist_eq_succ {n k : ℕ}
    (A B : Configuration (Fin n) k) (hAB : A ≠ B) :
    ∃ C : Configuration (Fin n) k,
      (pathTokenGraph n k).Adj A C ∧
        pathConfigurationDist A B = pathConfigurationDist C B + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let right : Finset (Fin k) :=
    Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ coordinate A i < coordinate B i
  by_cases hright : right.Nonempty
  · let i := right.max' hright
    have hiRight : coordinate A i < coordinate B i := by
      have hiMem : i ∈ right := by
        simpa [i] using right.max'_mem hright
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiMem).2
    let u := coordinate A i
    let v : Fin n := ⟨u.val + 1, by
      have hiVal : u.val < (coordinate B i).val := hiRight
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.add_one_le_iff.mpr hiVal) (coordinate B i).isLt⟩
    have hvVal : v.val = u.val + 1 := rfl
    have huA : u ∈ A.1 := by
      exact coordinate_mem' A i
    have huv : (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj u v := by
      apply SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj.mpr
      exact Or.inl rfl
    have hvA : v ∉ A.1 := by
      intro hvMem
      have hvRange : v ∈ Set.range (A.1.orderEmbOfFin A.2) := by
        rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
        exact hvMem
      obtain ⟨j, hj'⟩ := hvRange
      have hj : coordinate A j = v := by
        change A.1.orderEmbOfFin A.2 j = v
        exact hj'
      have hij : i < j := by
        apply lt_of_not_ge
        intro hji
        have hmono := (coordinate_strictMono A).monotone hji
        have hjVal := congrArg Fin.val hj
        change (coordinate A j).val ≤ u.val at hmono
        change (coordinate A j).val = v.val at hjVal
        omega
      have hjNotRight : j ∉ right := by
        intro hjRight
        have hji : j ≤ i := by
          simpa [i] using right.le_max' j hjRight
        exact (not_le_of_gt hij) hji
      have hjBA : coordinate B j ≤ coordinate A j := by
        apply le_of_not_gt
        intro hjRight
        exact hjNotRight (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hjRight⟩)
      have hBmono := coordinate_strictMono B hij
      have hiVal : u.val < (coordinate B i).val := hiRight
      have hjVal := congrArg Fin.val hj
      change (coordinate B j).val ≤ (coordinate A j).val at hjBA
      change (coordinate B i).val < (coordinate B j).val at hBmono
      change (coordinate A j).val = v.val at hjVal
      omega
    have hkPos : 0 < k := by
      rw [← A.2]
      exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨u, huA⟩
    let C : Configuration (Fin n) k :=
      ⟨insert v (A.1.erase u), by
        simp [huA, hvA, A.2]
        omega⟩
    have hAC : (pathTokenGraph n k).Adj A C := by
      apply (tokenGraph_adj_iff_exists_move (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) k A C).mpr
      exact ⟨u, huA, v, hvA, huv, rfl⟩
    have hcoordinate : coordinate C = Function.update (coordinate A) i v := by
      apply coordinate_eq_update_of_move i v hvA
      · rfl
      · exact hAC
    have hstep :
        Nat.dist (coordinate A i).val (coordinate B i).val =
          Nat.dist v.val (coordinate B i).val + 1 := by
      have hiVal : u.val < (coordinate B i).val := hiRight
      change Nat.dist u.val (coordinate B i).val =
        Nat.dist (u.val + 1) (coordinate B i).val + 1
      unfold Nat.dist
      omega
    exact ⟨C, hAC, pathConfigurationDist_eq_succ_of_update i v hcoordinate hstep⟩
  · have hnoRight : ∀ j, ¬coordinate A j < coordinate B j := by
      intro j hj
      exact hright ⟨j, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hj⟩⟩
    have hcoordne : coordinate A ≠ coordinate B := by
      intro hcoordinate
      apply hAB
      apply (configurationEquivOrderEmbedding (Fin n) k).injective
      apply RelEmbedding.ext
      intro j
      change coordinate A j = coordinate B j
      exact congrFun hcoordinate j
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp hcoordne
    have hj₀Left : coordinate B j₀ < coordinate A j₀ :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt (hnoRight j₀)) hj₀.symm
    let left : Finset (Fin k) :=
      Finset.univ.filter fun i ↦ coordinate B i < coordinate A i
    have hleft : left.Nonempty :=
      ⟨j₀, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j₀, hj₀Left⟩⟩
    let i := left.min' hleft
    have hiLeft : coordinate B i < coordinate A i := by
      have hiMem : i ∈ left := by
        simpa [i] using left.min'_mem hleft
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hiMem).2
    let u := coordinate A i
    let v : Fin n := ⟨u.val - 1, by
      exact (Nat.sub_le u.val 1).trans_lt u.isLt⟩
    have hvVal : v.val = u.val - 1 := rfl
    have huPos : 0 < u.val := by
      have hiVal : (coordinate B i).val < u.val := hiLeft
      omega
    have huA : u ∈ A.1 := coordinate_mem' A i
    have huv : (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj u v := by
      apply SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj.mpr
      exact Or.inr (by change u.val - 1 + 1 = u.val; omega)
    have hvA : v ∉ A.1 := by
      intro hvMem
      have hvRange : v ∈ Set.range (A.1.orderEmbOfFin A.2) := by
        rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
        exact hvMem
      obtain ⟨j, hj'⟩ := hvRange
      have hj : coordinate A j = v := by
        change A.1.orderEmbOfFin A.2 j = v
        exact hj'
      have hji : j < i := by
        apply lt_of_not_ge
        intro hij
        have hmono := (coordinate_strictMono A).monotone hij
        have hjVal := congrArg Fin.val hj
        change u.val ≤ (coordinate A j).val at hmono
        change (coordinate A j).val = v.val at hjVal
        omega
      have hjNotLeft : j ∉ left := by
        intro hjLeft
        have hij : i ≤ j := by
          simpa [i] using left.min'_le j hjLeft
        exact (not_le_of_gt hji) hij
      have hjAB : coordinate A j ≤ coordinate B j := by
        apply le_of_not_gt
        intro hjLeft
        exact hjNotLeft (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ j, hjLeft⟩)
      have hBmono := coordinate_strictMono B hji
      have hiVal : (coordinate B i).val < u.val := hiLeft
      have hjVal := congrArg Fin.val hj
      change (coordinate A j).val ≤ (coordinate B j).val at hjAB
      change (coordinate B j).val < (coordinate B i).val at hBmono
      change (coordinate A j).val = v.val at hjVal
      omega
    have hkPos : 0 < k := by
      rw [← A.2]
      exact Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨u, huA⟩
    let C : Configuration (Fin n) k :=
      ⟨insert v (A.1.erase u), by
        simp [huA, hvA, A.2]
        omega⟩
    have hAC : (pathTokenGraph n k).Adj A C := by
      apply (tokenGraph_adj_iff_exists_move (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) k A C).mpr
      exact ⟨u, huA, v, hvA, huv, rfl⟩
    have hcoordinate : coordinate C = Function.update (coordinate A) i v := by
      apply coordinate_eq_update_of_move i v hvA
      · rfl
      · exact hAC
    have hstep :
        Nat.dist (coordinate A i).val (coordinate B i).val =
          Nat.dist v.val (coordinate B i).val + 1 := by
      have hiVal : (coordinate B i).val < u.val := hiLeft
      change Nat.dist u.val (coordinate B i).val =
        Nat.dist (u.val - 1) (coordinate B i).val + 1
      unfold Nat.dist
      omega
    exact ⟨C, hAC, pathConfigurationDist_eq_succ_of_update i v hcoordinate hstep⟩

name: BurningPath.exists_pathTokenGraph_walk_length_eq_pathConfigurationDist
statement:
theorem exists_pathTokenGraph_walk_length_eq_pathConfigurationDist {n k : ℕ}
    (A B : Configuration (Fin n) k) :
    ∃ p : (pathTokenGraph n k).Walk A B,
      p.length = pathConfigurationDist A B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hAB : A = B
  · subst B
    exact ⟨.nil, by simp⟩
  · obtain ⟨C, hAC, hdist⟩ :=
      exists_adj_pathConfigurationDist_eq_succ A B hAB
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ :=
      exists_pathTokenGraph_walk_length_eq_pathConfigurationDist C B
    refine ⟨.cons hAC p, ?_⟩
    simp only [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_cons, hp]
    exact hdist.symm

name: BurningPath.pathTokenGraph_reachable
statement:
theorem pathTokenGraph_reachable {n k : ℕ} (A B : Configuration (Fin n) k) :
    (pathTokenGraph n k).Reachable A B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, _⟩ := exists_pathTokenGraph_walk_length_eq_pathConfigurationDist A B
  exact p.reachable

name: BurningPath.pathTokenGraph_dist_eq_pathConfigurationDist
proof:
:= by
  let hreach := pathTokenGraph_reachable A B
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_pathTokenGraph_walk_length_eq_pathConfigurationDist A B
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa [hp] using (pathTokenGraph n k).dist_le p
  · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hreach.exists_walk_length_eq_dist
    simpa [hq] using pathConfigurationDist_le_walk_length q

name: BurningPath.pathTokenGraph_edist_eq_pathConfigurationDist
proof:
:= by
  have hreach := pathTokenGraph_reachable A B
  rw [← hreach.coe_dist_eq_edist, pathTokenGraph_dist_eq_pathConfigurationDist]

name: BurningPath.mem_latticeBall
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_latticeBall {k r : ℕ} {z : Fin k → ℤ} :
    z ∈ latticeBall k r ↔ ∑ i, Int.natAbs (z i) ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: BurningPath.latticeBall_finite
statement: theorem latticeBall_finite (k r : ℕ) : (latticeBall k r).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hcoordinate : ({x : ℤ | x.natAbs ≤ r} : Set ℤ).Finite := by
    exact Set.finite_def.mpr ⟨intCoordinateFintype r⟩
  refine (Set.Finite.pi' fun _ ↦ hcoordinate).subset ?_
  intro z hz i
  change Int.natAbs (z i) ≤ r
  exact
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _ ↦ Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans hz

name: BurningPath.sum_intCoordinate
proof:
:= by
  let g : Option (Fin r ⊕ Fin r) → ℕ
    | none => f 0
    | some (Sum.inl n) => f (n.val + 1)
    | some (Sum.inr n) => f (n.val + 1)
  calc
    ∑ x : IntCoordinate r, f x.1.natAbs = ∑ y, g y := by
      apply Fintype.sum_equiv (intCoordinateEquiv r)
      intro x
      rcases x with ⟨x, hx⟩
      cases x with
      | ofNat n => cases n <;> rfl
      | negSucc n => rfl
    _ = f 0 + (∑ n : Fin r, f (n.val + 1)) + ∑ n : Fin r, f (n.val + 1) := by
      rw [Fintype.sum_option, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
      simp [g, add_assoc]
    _ = f 0 + 2 * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range r, f (n + 1) := by
      have hsum :
          (∑ n : Fin r, f (n.val + 1)) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range r, f (n + 1) :=
        Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun n ↦ f (n + 1)) r
      rw [hsum]
      omega

name: BurningPath.latticeBall_card_succ
statement:
private theorem latticeBall_card_succ (k r : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (latticeBall (k + 1) r) =
      Fintype.card (latticeBall k r) +
        2 * ∑ q ∈ Finset.range r, Fintype.card (latticeBall k q)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Fintype.card (latticeBall (k + 1) r) =
        Fintype.card (Σ x : IntCoordinate r, latticeBall k (r - x.1.natAbs)) :=
      Fintype.card_congr (latticeBallSuccEquiv k r)
    _ = ∑ x : IntCoordinate r, Fintype.card (latticeBall k (r - x.1.natAbs)) :=
      Fintype.card_sigma
    _ = Fintype.card (latticeBall k r) +
        2 * ∑ q ∈ Finset.range r, Fintype.card (latticeBall k (r - (q + 1))) := by
      simpa using sum_intCoordinate r (fun a ↦ Fintype.card (latticeBall k (r - a)))
    _ = Fintype.card (latticeBall k r) +
        2 * ∑ q ∈ Finset.range r, Fintype.card (latticeBall k q) := by
      rw [show (∑ q ∈ Finset.range r, Fintype.card (latticeBall k (r - (q + 1)))) =
          ∑ q ∈ Finset.range r, Fintype.card (latticeBall k q) by
        simpa [Nat.sub_sub, add_comm] using
          (Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun q ↦ Fintype.card (latticeBall k q)) r)]

name: BurningPath.latticeBallPolynomial_succ_dim
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℕ → ℕ := fun i ↦ 2 ^ (i + 1) * k.choose (i + 1) * r.choose (i + 1)
  let B : ℕ → ℕ := fun i ↦ 2 ^ (i + 1) * k.choose i * r.choose (i + 1)
  have hP :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), A i) + 1 = latticeBallPolynomial k r := by
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), A i) + 1 =
          (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, A i) + 1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
        simp [A, Nat.choose_succ_self]
      _ = latticeBallPolynomial k r := by
        rw [latticeBallPolynomial, Finset.sum_range_succ']
        simp [A]
  have hB :
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), B i) = 2 * rankedVolumePolynomial k r := by
    simp only [B, rankedVolumePolynomial, Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp [pow_succ', mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
  calc
    latticeBallPolynomial (k + 1) r =
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (A i + B i)) + 1 := by
      rw [latticeBallPolynomial, Finset.sum_range_succ']
      simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, pow_zero, one_mul]
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      simp [A, B, Nat.choose_succ_succ]
      ring
    _ = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), A i) + 1 +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), B i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      omega
    _ = latticeBallPolynomial k r + 2 * rankedVolumePolynomial k r := by
      rw [hP, hB]

name: BurningPath.latticeBall_card_eq_polynomial
statement:
private theorem latticeBall_card_eq_polynomial (k r : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (latticeBall k r) = latticeBallPolynomial k r
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing r with
  | zero =>
      simp [latticeBall, latticeBallPolynomial]
  | succ k ih =>
      calc
        Fintype.card (latticeBall (k + 1) r) =
            Fintype.card (latticeBall k r) +
              2 * ∑ q ∈ Finset.range r, Fintype.card (latticeBall k q) :=
          latticeBall_card_succ k r
        _ = latticeBallPolynomial k r +
            2 * ∑ q ∈ Finset.range r, latticeBallPolynomial k q := by
          simp_rw [ih]
        _ = latticeBallPolynomial k r + 2 * rankedVolumePolynomial k r := by
          rw [← cumulativeLatticeBallPolynomial_eq]
          rfl
        _ = latticeBallPolynomial (k + 1) r :=
          (latticeBallPolynomial_succ_dim k r).symm

name: BurningPath.latticeBall_ncard
statement:
theorem latticeBall_ncard (k r : ℕ) :
    (latticeBall k r).ncard = latticeBallPolynomial k r
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (latticeBall k r).ncard = Fintype.card (latticeBall k r) := by
      rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
      simp
    _ = latticeBallPolynomial k r := latticeBall_card_eq_polynomial k r

name: BurningPath.latticeBall_ncard_formula
statement:
theorem latticeBall_ncard_formula (k r : ℕ) :
    (latticeBall k r).ncard =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), 2 ^ j * k.choose j * r.choose j
proof:
:= by
  simpa [latticeBallPolynomial] using latticeBall_ncard k r

name: BurningPath.cubeGridCount_pos
statement:
theorem cubeGridCount_pos (k : ℕ) (L : ℝ) :
    1 ≤ cubeGridCount k L
proof:
:=
  le_max_left _ _

name: BurningPath.cubeGrid_mesh_bound
statement:
theorem cubeGrid_mesh_bound {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (_hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    L / cubeGridCount k L ≤ 2 / ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let x := (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L / 2)
  have hx : x ≤ (⌈x⌉₊ : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil x
  have hceil :
      (⌈x⌉₊ : ℝ) ≤ cubeGridCount k L := by
    exact_mod_cast le_max_right 1 ⌈x⌉₊
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < cubeGridCount k L := by
    exact_mod_cast cubeGridCount_pos k L
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < (k + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
  dsimp [x] at hx
  have hmain :
      (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L / 2) ≤ cubeGridCount k L :=
    hx.trans hceil
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hm]
  rw [show
    2 / (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * cubeGridCount k L =
      (2 * cubeGridCount k L) / (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) by ring]
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hk]
  have hmain' :
      (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L) ≤ 2 * cubeGridCount k L := by
    simpa [mul_comm] using
      (div_le_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).mp hmain
  nlinarith

name: BurningPath.hasCubeRankedCover_midpointGrid
statement:
theorem hasCubeRankedCover_midpointGrid {k m : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hmesh : L / m ≤ 2 / ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) :
    HasCubeRankedCover k L ((k + 1) * m ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ell : ℝ := L / m
  let Tile := Fin k → Fin m
  let M := Fintype.card Tile
  let tileEquiv : Tile ≃ Fin M := Fintype.equivFin Tile
  let net : Fin M → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    fun a i ↦ (tileEquiv.symm a i).val * ell + ell / 2
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hell : 0 ≤ ell := div_nonneg hL hmR.le
  have hmell : (m : ℝ) * ell = L := by
    dsimp [ell]
    field_simp
  have hMpos : 1 ≤ M := by
    apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
  have hnetLegal : ∀ a, net a ∈ realCube k L := by
    intro a i
    have hai := (tileEquiv.symm a i).isLt
    simp only [net]
    constructor
    · positivity
    · have hendpoint :
          (((tileEquiv.symm a i).val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ell ≤
            (m : ℝ) * ell := by
        gcongr
        exact_mod_cast Nat.add_one_le_iff.mpr hai
      push_cast at hendpoint
      rw [hmell] at hendpoint
      nlinarith
  have hnetCover :
      ∀ x ∈ realCube k L, ∃ a, realL1Dist x (net a) ≤
        (k : ℝ) / (k + 1) := by
    intro x hx
    have htile :
        ∀ i, ∃ a : Fin m,
          (a.val : ℝ) * ell ≤ x i ∧
            x i ≤ (a.val + 1 : ℕ) * ell := by
      intro i
      apply exists_cube_tile_interval hm (hx i).1
      rw [hmell]
      exact (hx i).2
    choose tile htileLower htileUpper using htile
    let a := tileEquiv tile
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    have hcoord (i : Fin k) :
        |x i - net a i| ≤ ell / 2 := by
      have hlo := htileLower i
      have hup := htileUpper i
      simp only [net, a, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      push_cast at hup
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> nlinarith
    calc
      realL1Dist x (net a) ≤ ∑ _ : Fin k, ell / 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        exact hcoord i
      _ = (k : ℝ) * (ell / 2) := by simp
      _ ≤ (k : ℝ) / (k + 1) := by
        have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := by positivity
        have hmesh' : ell ≤ 2 / (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) := hmesh
        have hscaled :
            (k : ℝ) * ell ≤
              (k : ℝ) * (2 / (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmesh' hk0
        calc
          (k : ℝ) * (ell / 2) = ((k : ℝ) * ell) / 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ ((k : ℝ) * (2 / (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)))) / 2 :=
            div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hscaled (by norm_num)
          _ = (k : ℝ) / (k + 1) := by
            have hkne : (k : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
            field_simp
            norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hq :
      1 ≤ (k + 1) * M := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hMpos
  have hMq : M ≤ (k + 1) * M := by
    calc
      M = 1 * M := by simp
      _ ≤ (k + 1) * M := Nat.mul_le_mul_right M (by omega)
  have hradius :
      (k : ℝ) / (k + 1) ≤
        ((((k + 1) * M - M : ℕ) : ℝ) /
          (((k + 1) * M : ℕ) : ℝ)) := by
    have hMR : (0 : ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hMpos
    have hkR : (0 : ℝ) < (k + 1 : ℕ) := by positivity
    have hsub : (k + 1) * M - M = k * M := by
      rw [Nat.add_mul]
      simp
    rw [hsub]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    rfl
  have hcover :
      HasL1NormalizedRankedCover (realCube k L) ((k + 1) * M) :=
    hasL1NormalizedRankedCover_of_finiteNet
      ⟨0, zero_mem_realCube hL⟩ hq hMq net hnetLegal hnetCover hradius
  simpa [HasCubeRankedCover, M, Tile] using hcover

name: BurningPath.hasCubeRankedCover_grid
statement:
theorem hasCubeRankedCover_grid {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    HasCubeRankedCover k L
      ((k + 1) * (cubeGridCount k L) ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  exact hasCubeRankedCover_midpointGrid
    (cubeGridCount_pos k L) hL (cubeGrid_mesh_bound hL)

name: BurningPath.cubeCoverNumber_le_grid
statement:
theorem cubeCoverNumber_le_grid {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    cubeCoverNumber k L ≤ (k + 1) * (cubeGridCount k L) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  apply cubeCoverNumber_min
  exact
    ⟨Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (pow_pos (cubeGridCount_pos k L) k),
      hasCubeRankedCover_grid hL⟩

name: BurningPath.sum_range_forward_difference
statement:
private theorem sum_range_forward_difference (z : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (z i - z (i + 1)) = z 0 - z m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
      ring

name: BurningPath.shelfTrajectory_sum_sq_le
statement:
theorem shelfTrajectory_sum_sq_le {m : ℕ} (w z : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hwNonneg : ∀ i ≤ m, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hzFinal : 0 ≤ z m)
    (hwBound : ∀ i < m, w i ≤ w 0)
    (hwNext : ∀ i < m, 3 * w i ≤ 4 * w (i + 1))
    (hzStep : ∀ i < m, z i - z (i + 1) = 2 * w (i + 1)) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, w i ^ 2 ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * w 0 * z 0
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ w 0 := hwNonneg 0 (Nat.zero_le m)
  have hpoint :
      ∀ i ∈ Finset.range m,
        w i ^ 2 ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * w 0 * w (i + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    have him : i < m := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hwi : 0 ≤ w i := hwNonneg i (Nat.le_of_lt him)
    have hmul : w i * w i ≤ w 0 * w i :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hwBound i him) hwi
    have hnext := hwNext i him
    have hscale :
        3 * (w 0 * w i) ≤ 4 * (w 0 * w (i + 1)) := by
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [hmul]
  have hsumNext :
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, w (i + 1) = (z 0 - z m) / 2 := by
    have htel := sum_range_forward_difference z m
    have hsteps :
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (z i - z (i + 1)) =
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, 2 * w (i + 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact hzStep i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
    rw [hsteps] at htel
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at htel
    nlinarith
  calc
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, w i ^ 2 ≤
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (4 / 3 : ℝ) * w 0 * w (i + 1) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
    _ = (4 / 3 : ℝ) * w 0 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, w (i + 1)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = (2 / 3 : ℝ) * w 0 * (z 0 - z m) := by
      rw [hsumNext]
      ring
    _ ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * w 0 * z 0 := by
      nlinarith

name: BurningPath.shelfPotential_trajectory_loss
statement:
theorem shelfPotential_trajectory_loss {m : ℕ} (w z : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hstep :
      ∀ i < m,
        shelfPotential (w (i + 1)) (z (i + 1)) ≥
          shelfPotential (w i) (z i) - 45 * w i ^ 2) :
    shelfPotential (w m) (z m) ≥
      shelfPotential (w 0) (z 0) -
        45 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, w i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
      have hprefix :
          shelfPotential (w m) (z m) ≥
            shelfPotential (w 0) (z 0) -
              45 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, w i ^ 2) := by
        apply ih
        intro i hi
        exact hstep i (hi.trans (Nat.lt_succ_self m))
      have hlast := hstep m (Nat.lt_succ_self m)
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      nlinarith

name: BurningPath.shelfPotential_trajectory_lower
statement:
theorem shelfPotential_trajectory_lower {m : ℕ} (w z : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hsum :
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, w i ^ 2 ≤ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * w 0 * z 0)
    (hstep :
      ∀ i < m,
        shelfPotential (w (i + 1)) (z (i + 1)) ≥
          shelfPotential (w i) (z i) - 45 * w i ^ 2) :
    shelfPotential (w m) (z m) ≥
      shelfPotential (w 0) (z 0) - 30 * w 0 * z 0
proof:
:= by
  have hloss := shelfPotential_trajectory_loss w z hstep
  nlinarith

name: BurningPath.baseIndex_lt_succIndex
statement:
private theorem baseIndex_lt_succIndex {k : ℕ} (i : Fin (k - 1)) :
    baseIndex i < succIndex i
proof:
:= by
  exact Fin.mk_lt_mk.mpr (by omega)

name: BurningPath.card_missingParam
proof:
:= by
  simp [MissingParam, Fintype.card_subtype_compl]

name: BurningPath.card_wallParam
proof:
:= by
  have hcard :
      Fintype.card (WallParam k N C hk) =
        (N + 1) ^ (k - 1) * (C + 1) +
          (k - 1) * ((N + 1) ^ (k - 1) * (C + 1)) := by
    change
      Fintype.card
        (MissingParam (lastIndex hk) N C ⊕
          Σ i : Fin (k - 1), MissingParam (succIndex i) N C) = _
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, card_missingParam, Fintype.card_sigma]
    simp_rw [card_missingParam]
    simp
  rw [hcard]
  calc
    (N + 1) ^ (k - 1) * (C + 1) +
          (k - 1) * ((N + 1) ^ (k - 1) * (C + 1)) =
        ((k - 1) + 1) * ((N + 1) ^ (k - 1) * (C + 1)) := by ring
    _ = k * ((N + 1) ^ (k - 1) * (C + 1)) := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hk]
    _ = k * (N + 1) ^ (k - 1) * (C + 1) := by ring

name: BurningPath.exists_wallParam_reconstruct
statement:
private theorem exists_wallParam_reconstruct {k N C : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (z : Gamma N k)
    (hz :
      N - z.1 (lastIndex hk) ≤ C ∨
        ∃ i : Fin (k - 1),
          z.1 (succIndex i) - z.1 (baseIndex i) ≤ C) :
    ∃ u : WallParam k N C hk, wallGamma u = z
proof:
:= by
  rcases hz with htop | ⟨i, hgap⟩
  · let values : {j : Fin k // j ≠ lastIndex hk} → Fin (N + 1) :=
      fun j ↦ ⟨z.1 j.1, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (z.2.2 j.1)⟩
    let extra : Fin (C + 1) :=
      ⟨N - z.1 (lastIndex hk), by omega⟩
    let u₀ : MissingParam (lastIndex hk) N C := ⟨values, extra⟩
    let u : WallParam k N C hk := Sum.inl u₀
    have hraw : rawWallParam u = z.1 := by
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = lastIndex hk
      · subst j
        simp only [u, rawWallParam, u₀, topRaw, extra]
        exact Nat.sub_sub_self (z.2.2 (lastIndex hk))
      · simp [u, u₀, rawWallParam, topRaw, values, hj]
    have hvalid :
        Monotone (rawWallParam u) ∧ ∀ j, rawWallParam u j ≤ N := by
      simpa only [hraw] using z.2
    refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
    rw [wallGamma, dif_pos hvalid]
    exact Subtype.ext hraw
  · have hbase :
        z.1 (baseIndex i) ≤ z.1 (succIndex i) :=
      z.2.1 (baseIndex_lt_succIndex i).le
    let values : {j : Fin k // j ≠ succIndex i} → Fin (N + 1) :=
      fun j ↦ ⟨z.1 j.1, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (z.2.2 j.1)⟩
    let extra : Fin (C + 1) :=
      ⟨z.1 (succIndex i) - z.1 (baseIndex i), by omega⟩
    let u₀ : MissingParam (succIndex i) N C := ⟨values, extra⟩
    let u : WallParam k N C hk := Sum.inr ⟨i, u₀⟩
    have hraw : rawWallParam u = z.1 := by
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = succIndex i
      · subst j
        simp only [u, rawWallParam, u₀, gapRaw, values, extra]
        exact Nat.add_sub_of_le hbase
      · simp [u, u₀, rawWallParam, gapRaw, values, hj]
    have hvalid :
        Monotone (rawWallParam u) ∧ ∀ j, rawWallParam u j ≤ N := by
      simpa only [hraw] using z.2
    refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
    rw [wallGamma, dif_pos hvalid]
    exact Subtype.ext hraw

name: BurningPath.floorToGamma_error_le
statement:
private theorem floorToGamma_error_le {k D : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hD : 1 ≤ D) (x : Fin k → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ orderedSimplex k L) :
    realL1Dist x
        (gammaScale (D := D) (floorToGamma (D := D) x hx)) ≤
      (k : ℝ) / D
proof:
:= by
  have hDR : 0 < (D : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
  rw [realL1Dist]
  calc
    (∑ i, |x i -
        gammaScale (D := D) (floorToGamma (D := D) x hx) i|) ≤
        ∑ _i : Fin k, (1 : ℝ) / D := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ (D : ℝ) * x i :=
        mul_nonneg hDR.le (hx.1 i).1
      have hfloor :
          (⌊(D : ℝ) * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ) * x i :=
        Nat.floor_le hnonneg
      have hlt := Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((D : ℝ) * x i)
      change
        (D : ℝ) * x i <
          (⌊(D : ℝ) * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 at hlt
      simp only [gammaScale, floorToGamma]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg]
      · have hidentity :
            (x i - (⌊(D : ℝ) * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) / D) * D =
              (D : ℝ) * x i - (⌊(D : ℝ) * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) := by
          field_simp
        apply (le_div_iff₀ hDR).2
        rw [hidentity]
        have hlt' :
            (D : ℝ) * x i <
              (⌊(D : ℝ) * x i⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := hlt
        linarith
      · exact sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_iff₀ hDR).2 (by
          simpa [mul_comm] using hfloor))
    _ = (k : ℝ) / D := by
      simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: BurningPath.floorToGamma_wall_bound
statement:
private theorem floorToGamma_wall_bound {k D : ℕ} {ell L : ℝ}
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hD : 1 ≤ D) (_hell : 0 ≤ ell)
    (x : Fin k → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ orderedSimplex k L)
    (hwall : x ∈ simplexWallLayer hk ell L) :
    let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
    let C := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2
    N - (floorToGamma (D := D) x hx).1 (lastIndex hk) ≤ C ∨
      ∃ i : Fin (k - 1),
        (floorToGamma (D := D) x hx).1 (succIndex i) -
            (floorToGamma (D := D) x hx).1 (baseIndex i) ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [simplexWallLayer, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hwall
  dsimp only
  rcases hwall with htop | ⟨i, hgap⟩
  · left
    let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
    let z := ⌊(D : ℝ) * x (lastIndex hk)⌋₊
    let E := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊
    have hDR : 0 < (D : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
    have hL : 0 ≤ L := (hx.1 (lastIndex hk)).1.trans
      (hx.1 (lastIndex hk)).2
    have hN : (N : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ) * L := by
      exact Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg hDR.le hL)
    have hzlt :
        (D : ℝ) * x (lastIndex hk) < (z : ℝ) + 1 := by
      exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hE : (D : ℝ) * ell ≤ (E : ℝ) := by
      exact Nat.le_ceil _
    have hreal : (N : ℝ) < (z : ℝ) + (E : ℝ) + 2 := by
      nlinarith
    have hnat : N < z + E + 2 := by exact_mod_cast hreal
    change N - z ≤ E + 2
    omega
  · right
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    let a := ⌊(D : ℝ) * x (baseIndex i)⌋₊
    let b := ⌊(D : ℝ) * x (succIndex i)⌋₊
    let E := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊
    have hDR : 0 < (D : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hD
    have haLt : (D : ℝ) * x (baseIndex i) < (a : ℝ) + 1 := by
      exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hbLe : (b : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ) * x (succIndex i) := by
      exact Nat.floor_le
        (mul_nonneg hDR.le (hx.1 (succIndex i)).1)
    have hE : (D : ℝ) * ell ≤ (E : ℝ) := by
      exact Nat.le_ceil _
    have hreal : (b : ℝ) < (a : ℝ) + (E : ℝ) + 2 := by
      nlinarith
    have hnat : b < a + E + 2 := by exact_mod_cast hreal
    change b - a ≤ E + 2
    omega

name: BurningPath.exists_wallParam_floor
statement:
private theorem exists_wallParam_floor {k D : ℕ} {ell L : ℝ}
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hell : 0 ≤ ell)
    (x : Fin k → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ orderedSimplex k L)
    (hwall : x ∈ simplexWallLayer hk ell L) :
    ∃ u :
        WallParam k ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
          (⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2) hk,
      wallGamma u = floorToGamma (D := D) x hx
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_wallParam_reconstruct hk
  exact floorToGamma_wall_bound hk hD hell x hx hwall

name: BurningPath.card_strictCell
statement:
private theorem card_strictCell (k p : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (StrictCell k p) = p.choose k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr
    (configurationEquivOrderEmbedding (Fin p) k)]
  simp

name: BurningPath.translatedCellCenter_legal
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i
    constructor
    · exact add_nonneg
        (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hell) (hbaseLegal r i).1
    · have hai : (a i).1 + 1 ≤ p := Nat.add_one_le_iff.mpr (a i).isLt
      have hstep :
          (((a i).1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ell ≤ (p : ℝ) * ell := by
        gcongr
      have hbase := (hbaseLegal r i).2
      push_cast at hstep
      dsimp [translatedCellCenter]
      nlinarith
  · intro i j hij
    rcases hij.eq_or_lt with rfl | hij
    · exact le_rfl
    · have haij : (a i).1 + 1 ≤ (a j).1 := by
        exact a.strictMono hij
      have hscaled :
          (((a i).1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ell ≤
            ((a j).1 : ℝ) * ell := by
        gcongr
      have hi := (hbaseLegal r i).2
      have hj := (hbaseLegal r j).1
      push_cast at hscaled
      dsimp [translatedCellCenter]
      nlinarith

name: BurningPath.translatedCellCenter_covers
proof:
:= by
  let y : Fin k → ℝ := fun i ↦ x i - (a i).1 * ell
  have hy : y ∈ realCube k ell := by
    intro i
    have hi := hx i
    dsimp [y]
    push_cast at hi
    constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hbaseCover y hy
  refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
  calc
    realL1Dist x (translatedCellCenter ell baseCenters a j) =
        realL1Dist y (baseCenters j) := by
      unfold realL1Dist translatedCellCenter
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      congr 1
      dsimp [y]
      ring
    _ ≤ (j.1 : ℝ) / q := hj

name: BurningPath.exists_strictCell_of_not_wall
statement:
private theorem exists_strictCell_of_not_wall {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    {ell L : ℝ} (hell : 0 < ell)
    (x : Fin k → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ orderedSimplex k L)
    (hwall : x ∉ simplexWallLayer hk ell L) :
    ∃ a : StrictCell k ⌊L / ell⌋₊, x ∈ cellRegion ell a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ :=
    Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (by omega : k ≠ 0)
  change
    ¬ (L - x (lastIndex hk) ≤ ell ∨
      ∃ i : Fin (d + 1 - 1),
        x (succIndex i) - x (baseIndex i) ≤ ell) at hwall
  have htop : ell < L - x (lastIndex hk) := by
    exact lt_of_not_ge (not_or.mp hwall).1
  have hgap :
      ∀ i : Fin (d + 1 - 1),
        ell < x (succIndex i) - x (baseIndex i) := by
    intro i
    exact lt_of_not_ge (not_exists.mp (not_or.mp hwall).2 i)
  let p := ⌊L / ell⌋₊
  let m : Fin (d + 1) → ℕ := fun i ↦ ⌊x i / ell⌋₊
  have hm_lt (i : Fin (d + 1)) : m i < p := by
    have hxiLast : x i ≤ x (lastIndex hk) :=
      hx.2 (Fin.le_last i)
    have hratio :
        x i / ell + 1 < L / ell := by
      have hsum : x i + ell < L := by linarith
      have hdiv :=
        (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hell).2 hsum
      simpa [add_div, hell.ne'] using hdiv
    have hpUpper : L / ell < (p : ℝ) + 1 := by
      exact Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hreal : x i / ell < (p : ℝ) := by linarith
    exact (Nat.floor_lt (div_nonneg (hx.1 i).1 hell.le)).2 hreal
  let f : Fin (d + 1) → Fin p := fun i ↦ ⟨m i, hm_lt i⟩
  have hf : StrictMono f := by
    apply Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.mpr
    intro i
    have hcoord :
        x (baseIndex i) / ell + 1 <
          x (succIndex i) / ell := by
      have hsum :
          x (baseIndex i) + ell < x (succIndex i) := by
        linarith [hgap i]
      have hdiv :=
        (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hell).2 hsum
      simpa [add_div, hell.ne'] using hdiv
    have hfloorLe :
