        (m (baseIndex i) : ℝ) ≤ x (baseIndex i) / ell :=
      Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg (hx.1 (baseIndex i)).1 hell.le)
    have hsucc :
        m (baseIndex i) + 1 ≤ m (succIndex i) := by
      apply (Nat.le_floor_iff' (Nat.succ_ne_zero _)).2
      push_cast
      linarith
    change f (Fin.castSucc i) < f i.succ
    change m (Fin.castSucc i) < m i.succ
    have hbaseEq :
        (Fin.castSucc i : Fin (d + 1)) = baseIndex (k := d + 1) i := by
      ext
      rfl
    have hsuccEq :
        (i.succ : Fin (d + 1)) = succIndex (k := d + 1) i := by
      ext
      rfl
    rw [hbaseEq, hsuccEq]
    omega
  let a : StrictCell (d + 1) p := OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono f hf
  refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
  intro i
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ x i / ell :=
    div_nonneg (hx.1 i).1 hell.le
  have hlo : (m i : ℝ) ≤ x i / ell := Nat.floor_le hnonneg
  have hup : x i / ell < (m i : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
  change
    ((a i).1 : ℝ) * ell ≤ x i ∧
      x i ≤ (((a i).1 + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ell
  change
    (m i : ℝ) * ell ≤ x i ∧
      x i ≤ (((m i) + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ell
  push_cast
  constructor
  · exact (le_div_iff₀ hell).mp hlo
  · exact (div_le_iff₀ hell).mp hup.le

name: BurningPath.cellWallRankEmbedding_cell_val
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem cellWallRankEmbedding_cell_val
    (M q₀ A J : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (a : Fin M) (j : Fin q₀) :
    (cellWallRankEmbedding M q₀ A J hM (Sum.inl (a, j))).1 =
      A + 2 * J + (M * j.1 + a.1)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.cellWallRankEmbedding_wall_val
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem cellWallRankEmbedding_wall_val
    (M q₀ A J : ℕ) (hM : 1 ≤ M) (s : Fin J) :
    (cellWallRankEmbedding M q₀ A J hM (Sum.inr s)).1 =
      A + J + s.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.shiftedRank_normalized_le
proof:
:= by
  have hIR : (0 : ℝ) < I := by exact_mod_cast hI
  have hRI : (0 : ℝ) < R + I := by positivity
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hIR hRI]
  exact_mod_cast (show r.1 * (R + I) ≤ (R + r.1) * I by
    nlinarith [r.isLt.le])

name: BurningPath.wallRank_radius_le
statement:
private theorem wallRank_radius_le {M q₀ A J : ℕ}
    (hM : 1 ≤ M) (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (s : Fin J) :
    (((A + J : ℕ) : ℝ) / (A + 2 * J + M * q₀)) ≤
      ((cellWallRankEmbedding M q₀ A J hM (Sum.inr s)).1 : ℝ) /
        (A + 2 * J + M * q₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < A + 2 * J + M * q₀ := by
    positivity
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hden.le
  exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right (A + J) s.1

name: BurningPath.hasSimplexRankedCover_cells_wall
statement:
private theorem hasSimplexRankedCover_cells_wall {k q₀ A D : ℕ}
    {ell L : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hell : 0 < ell) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hp : k ≤ ⌊L / ell⌋₊) (hD : 1 ≤ D) (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀)
    (baseCenters : Fin q₀ → (Fin k → ℝ))
    (hbase :
      IsL1NormalizedRankedCover (realCube k ell) baseCenters)
    (hradius :
      let p := ⌊L / ell⌋₊
      let M := Fintype.card (StrictCell k p)
      let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
      let C := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2
      let J := Fintype.card (WallParam k N C hk)
      (k : ℝ) / D ≤
        ((A + J : ℕ) : ℝ) / (A + 2 * J + M * q₀)) :
    let p := ⌊L / ell⌋₊
    let M := Fintype.card (StrictCell k p)
    let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
    let C := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2
    let J := Fintype.card (WallParam k N C hk)
    HasSimplexRankedCover k L (A + 2 * J + M * q₀)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only at hradius ⊢
  let p := ⌊L / ell⌋₊
  let M := Fintype.card (StrictCell k p)
  let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
  let C := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2
  let J := Fintype.card (WallParam k N C hk)
  change
    (k : ℝ) / D ≤
      ((A + J : ℕ) : ℝ) / (A + 2 * J + M * q₀) at hradius
  change HasSimplexRankedCover k L (A + 2 * J + M * q₀)
  have hpL : (p : ℝ) * ell ≤ L := by
    have hfloor : (p : ℝ) ≤ L / ell :=
      Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hL hell.le)
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hell).mp hfloor
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := by
    dsimp [M]
    rw [card_strictCell]
    exact Nat.choose_pos hp
  have hJ : 1 ≤ J := by
    dsimp [J]
    rw [card_wallParam]
    exact Nat.mul_pos
      (Nat.mul_pos hk (pow_pos (by omega) (k - 1)))
      (by omega)
  let cellEquiv : StrictCell k p ≃ Fin M := Fintype.equivFin _
  let wallEquiv : WallParam k N C hk ≃ Fin J := Fintype.equivFin _
  let e := cellWallRankEmbedding M q₀ A J hM
  let localCenters :
      ((Fin M × Fin q₀) ⊕ Fin J) → (Fin k → ℝ)
    | Sum.inl r =>
        translatedCellCenter ell baseCenters
          (cellEquiv.symm r.1) r.2
    | Sum.inr s =>
        gammaScale (D := D) (wallGamma (wallEquiv.symm s))
  let centers : Fin (A + 2 * J + M * q₀) → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    Function.extend e localCenters (fun _ ↦ 0)
  have hcenters
      (u : (Fin M × Fin q₀) ⊕ Fin J) :
      centers (e u) = localCenters u :=
    e.injective.extend_apply localCenters (fun _ ↦ 0) u
  refine ⟨centers, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r
    by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hr
      rw [hcenters]
      rcases u with u | s
      · exact translatedCellCenter_legal hell.le hpL hbase.1
          (cellEquiv.symm u.1) u.2
      · exact gammaScale_mem_orderedSimplex hD hL
          (wallGamma (wallEquiv.symm s))
    · change Function.extend e localCenters (fun _ ↦ 0) r ∈
        orderedSimplex k L
      rw [Function.extend_apply' localCenters (fun _ ↦ 0) r]
      · exact zero_mem_orderedSimplex hL
      · simpa only [Set.mem_range] using hr
  · intro x hx
    by_cases hwall : x ∈ simplexWallLayer hk ell L
    · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ :=
        exists_wallParam_floor hk hD hell.le x hx hwall
      let s : Fin J := wallEquiv u
      refine ⟨e (Sum.inr s), ?_⟩
      rw [hcenters]
      simp only [localCenters]
      have hparam : wallGamma (wallEquiv.symm s) =
          floorToGamma (D := D) x hx := by
        simpa [s] using hu
      rw [hparam]
      have hwallRank :=
        wallRank_radius_le (A := A) hM hq₀ s
      exact (floorToGamma_error_le hD x hx).trans
        (hradius.trans (by simpa [e, add_assoc] using hwallRank))
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ :=
        exists_strictCell_of_not_wall hk hell x hx hwall
      let b : Fin M := cellEquiv a
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ :=
        translatedCellCenter_covers hbase.2 a ha
      refine ⟨e (Sum.inl (b, j)), ?_⟩
      rw [hcenters]
      simp only [localCenters]
      have hcell :
          translatedCellCenter ell baseCenters
              (cellEquiv.symm b) j =
            translatedCellCenter ell baseCenters a j := by
        simp [b]
      rw [hcell]
      have hinterleave :=
        interleavedRank_normalized_le hM hq₀ b j
      have hI : 1 ≤ M * q₀ := Nat.mul_pos hM hq₀
      have hshift :=
        shiftedRank_normalized_le (R := A + 2 * J) hI
          (interleavedRankEmbedding M q₀ hM (b, j))
      exact hj.trans (hinterleave.trans (by
        simpa [e, add_assoc] using hshift))

name: BurningPath.wallMeshScale_pos
proof:
:= by
  rw [wallMeshScale]
  exact Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (by positivity)

name: BurningPath.wallMesh_error_le
proof:
:= by
  have hD := wallMeshScale_pos hk hθ
  have hceil :
      4 * (k : ℝ) / θ ≤ (wallMeshScale k θ : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.le_ceil _
  have hDR : (0 : ℝ) < wallMeshScale k θ := by exact_mod_cast hD
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hDR]
  have hmul :
      4 * (k : ℝ) ≤ (wallMeshScale k θ : ℝ) * θ :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hθ).mp hceil
  nlinarith

name: BurningPath.reserve_wall_radius
statement:
private theorem reserve_wall_radius {I J : ℕ} {θ : ℝ}
    (hI : 1 ≤ I) (_hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) :
    θ / 4 ≤
      (((reserveRanks θ I + J : ℕ) : ℝ) /
        (reserveRanks θ I + 2 * J + I))
proof:
:= by
  let A := reserveRanks θ I
  have hA : θ * (I : ℝ) ≤ (A : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.le_ceil _
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < A + 2 * J + I := by positivity
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hden]
  push_cast
  have hθA : θ * (A : ℝ) ≤ A := by
    nlinarith [show 0 ≤ (A : ℝ) by positivity]
  have hθJ : 2 * θ * (J : ℝ) ≤ 2 * J := by
    nlinarith [show 0 ≤ (J : ℝ) by positivity]
  nlinarith

name: BurningPath.simplexCoverNumber_le_cells_wall
statement:
private theorem simplexCoverNumber_le_cells_wall {k q₀ : ℕ}
    {ell L θ : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hell : 0 < ell) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hp : k ≤ ⌊L / ell⌋₊) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1)
    (baseCenters : Fin q₀ → (Fin k → ℝ))
    (hbase :
      IsL1NormalizedRankedCover (realCube k ell) baseCenters)
    (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) :
    let p := ⌊L / ell⌋₊
    let M := Fintype.card (StrictCell k p)
    let D := wallMeshScale k θ
    let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
    let C := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2
    let J := Fintype.card (WallParam k N C hk)
    simplexCoverNumber k L ≤
      reserveRanks θ (M * q₀) + 2 * J + M * q₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let p := ⌊L / ell⌋₊
  let M := Fintype.card (StrictCell k p)
  let D := wallMeshScale k θ
  let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
  let C := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2
  let J := Fintype.card (WallParam k N C hk)
  let I := M * q₀
  let A := reserveRanks θ I
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := by
    dsimp [M]
    rw [card_strictCell]
    exact Nat.choose_pos hp
  have hI : 1 ≤ I := Nat.mul_pos hM hq₀
  have hD : 1 ≤ D := wallMeshScale_pos hk hθ
  have hradius :
      (k : ℝ) / D ≤ ((A + J : ℕ) : ℝ) / (A + 2 * J + M * q₀) := by
    exact (wallMesh_error_le hk hθ).trans
      (by simpa [A, I] using reserve_wall_radius hI hθ hθ1)
  have hcover :
      HasSimplexRankedCover k L (A + 2 * J + M * q₀) := by
    exact hasSimplexRankedCover_cells_wall hk hell hL hp hD hq₀
      baseCenters hbase (by simpa [p, M, N, C, J, D] using hradius)
  have hq : 1 ≤ A + 2 * J + M * q₀ := by
    dsimp [I] at hI
    omega
  apply simplexCoverNumber_min
  exact
    ⟨by simpa [A, I, p, M, D, N, C, J] using hq,
      by simpa [A, I, p, M, D, N, C, J] using hcover⟩

name: BurningPath.cellCount_density_le
statement:
private theorem cellCount_density_le {k q₀ : ℕ} {ell L : ℝ}
    (hell : 0 < ell) (hL : 0 < L) :
    ((Fintype.card (StrictCell k ⌊L / ell⌋₊) * q₀ : ℕ) : ℝ) /
        (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
      (q₀ : ℝ) / ell ^ k
proof:
:= by
  let p := ⌊L / ell⌋₊
  have hpLe : (p : ℝ) ≤ L / ell :=
    Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hL.le hell.le)
  have hpNonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := by positivity
  have hratioNonneg : 0 ≤ L / ell := div_nonneg hL.le hell.le
  have hpow : (p : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (L / ell) ^ k :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hpNonneg hpLe k
  have hchoose :
      (Fintype.card (StrictCell k p) : ℝ) ≤
        (L / ell) ^ k / Nat.factorial k := by
    rw [card_strictCell]
    exact (Nat.choose_le_pow_div k p).trans
      (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hpow (by positivity))
  have hqnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ q₀ := by positivity
  have hnum :
      ((Fintype.card (StrictCell k p) * q₀ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        ((L / ell) ^ k / Nat.factorial k) * q₀ := by
    push_cast
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hchoose hqnonneg
  have hvol : 0 < L ^ k / Nat.factorial k := by positivity
  calc
    ((Fintype.card (StrictCell k ⌊L / ell⌋₊) * q₀ : ℕ) : ℝ) /
          (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
        (((L / ell) ^ k / Nat.factorial k) * q₀) /
          (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hvol.le
    _ = (q₀ : ℝ) / ell ^ k := by
      rw [div_pow]
      field_simp [hell.ne', hL.ne', pow_ne_zero]

name: BurningPath.wallCount_density_le
statement:
private theorem wallCount_density_le {k D C : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hL : 1 ≤ L) :
    let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
    let J := Fintype.card (WallParam k N C hk)
    (J : ℝ) / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
      ((k : ℝ) * (C + 1) * (D + 1) ^ (k - 1) *
        Nat.factorial k) / L
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
  have hDL : 0 ≤ (D : ℝ) * L := mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have hN : (N : ℝ) ≤ (D : ℝ) * L := Nat.floor_le hDL
  have hN1 : (N + 1 : ℕ) ≤ ((D + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L := by
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  have hpow :
      ((N + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k - 1) ≤
        (((D + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L) ^ (k - 1) := by
    gcongr
  have hcount :
      (Fintype.card (WallParam k N C hk) : ℝ) ≤
        (k : ℝ) * (C + 1) *
          (((D + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L) ^ (k - 1) := by
    rw [card_wallParam]
    push_cast
    calc
      (k : ℝ) * (N + 1) ^ (k - 1) * (C + 1) =
          ((k : ℝ) * (C + 1)) * (N + 1) ^ (k - 1) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((k : ℝ) * (C + 1)) *
          (((D : ℝ) + 1) * L) ^ (k - 1) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by simpa using hpow)
          (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity))
      _ = (k : ℝ) * (C + 1) *
          (((D : ℝ) + 1) * L) ^ (k - 1) := by ring
  have hvol : 0 < L ^ k / Nat.factorial k := by positivity
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hvol]
  calc
    (Fintype.card (WallParam k ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊ C hk) : ℝ) ≤
        (k : ℝ) * (C + 1) *
          (((D + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L) ^ (k - 1) := hcount
    _ = (((k : ℝ) * (C + 1) * (D + 1) ^ (k - 1) *
          Nat.factorial k) / L) *
          (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) := by
      have hkexp : k - 1 + 1 = k := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
      have hLpow : L ^ k = L ^ (k - 1) * L := by
        calc
          L ^ k = L ^ ((k - 1) + 1) := by rw [hkexp]
          _ = L ^ (k - 1) * L := by rw [pow_succ]
      rw [mul_pow]
      field_simp [show L ≠ 0 by linarith, pow_ne_zero]
      rw [hLpow]
      push_cast
      ring

name: BurningPath.reserveRanks_cast_le
proof:
:= by
  exact (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (mul_nonneg hθ (by positivity))).le

name: BurningPath.simplexCoverDensityAt_le_cells_wall
statement:
private theorem simplexCoverDensityAt_le_cells_wall {k q₀ : ℕ}
    {ell L θ : ℝ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hell : 0 < ell) (hL : 1 ≤ L)
    (hp : k ≤ ⌊L / ell⌋₊) (hθ : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1)
    (baseCenters : Fin q₀ → (Fin k → ℝ))
    (hbase :
      IsL1NormalizedRankedCover (realCube k ell) baseCenters)
    (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) :
    let D := wallMeshScale k θ
    let C := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2
    simplexCoverDensityAt k L ≤
      (1 + θ) * ((q₀ : ℝ) / ell ^ k) +
        1 / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) +
        2 * (((k : ℝ) * (C + 1) * (D + 1) ^ (k - 1) *
          Nat.factorial k) / L)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let p := ⌊L / ell⌋₊
  let M := Fintype.card (StrictCell k p)
  let D := wallMeshScale k θ
  let N := ⌊(D : ℝ) * L⌋₊
  let C := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2
  let J := Fintype.card (WallParam k N C hk)
  let I := M * q₀
  let A := reserveRanks θ I
  have hnumNat :
      simplexCoverNumber k L ≤ A + 2 * J + I := by
    simpa [A, I, p, M, D, N, C, J] using
      (simplexCoverNumber_le_cells_wall hk hell (by linarith) hp hθ hθ1
        baseCenters hbase hq₀)
  have hreserve : (A : ℝ) ≤ θ * I + 1 := by
    simpa [A] using reserveRanks_cast_le (I := I) hθ.le
  have hnum :
      (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) ≤
        (1 + θ) * I + 1 + 2 * J := by
    have hcast : (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) ≤
        ((A + 2 * J + I : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hnumNat
    push_cast at hcast
    nlinarith
  have hvol : 0 < L ^ k / Nat.factorial k := by positivity
  have hcell :
      (I : ℝ) / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
        (q₀ : ℝ) / ell ^ k := by
    simpa [I, M, p] using
      (cellCount_density_le (k := k) (q₀ := q₀) hell
        (show 0 < L by linarith))
  have hwall :
      (J : ℝ) / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
        ((k : ℝ) * (C + 1) * (D + 1) ^ (k - 1) *
          Nat.factorial k) / L := by
    simpa [J, N] using
      (wallCount_density_le (k := k) (D := D) (C := C) hk hL)
  unfold simplexCoverDensityAt
  calc
    (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤
        ((1 + θ) * I + 1 + 2 * J) /
          (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum hvol.le
    _ = (1 + θ) * ((I : ℝ) / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k)) +
          1 / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) +
          2 * ((J : ℝ) / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k)) := by
      ring
    _ ≤ (1 + θ) * ((q₀ : ℝ) / ell ^ k) +
          1 / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) +
          2 * (((k : ℝ) * (C + 1) * (D + 1) ^ (k - 1) *
            Nat.factorial k) / L) := by
      gcongr

name: BurningPath.eventually_simplexCoverDensityAt_le_cubeBulkDensity_add
statement:
theorem eventually_simplexCoverDensityAt_le_cubeBulkDensity_add
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ L : ℝ in atTop,
      simplexCoverDensityAt k L ≤ cubeBulkDensity k + ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨ell, hell, hellDensity⟩ :=
    exists_cubeCoverDensityAt_lt
      (show cubeBulkDensity k < cubeBulkDensity k + ε / 4 by linarith)
  let q₀ := cubeCoverNumber k ell
  have hcubeExists :
      ∃ q, 1 ≤ q ∧ HasCubeRankedCover k ell q := by
    refine
      ⟨(k + 1) * cubeGridCount k ell ^ k,
        Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (pow_pos (cubeGridCount_pos k ell) k),
        hasCubeRankedCover_grid hell.le⟩
  obtain ⟨hq₀, hq₀Cover⟩ := cubeCoverNumber_spec hcubeExists
  obtain ⟨baseCenters, hbase⟩ := hq₀Cover
  let c₀ : ℝ := (q₀ : ℝ) / ell ^ k
  have hc₀nonneg : 0 ≤ c₀ := by
    dsimp [c₀]
    positivity
  have hc₀lt : c₀ < cubeBulkDensity k + ε / 4 := by
    simpa [c₀, q₀, cubeCoverDensityAt] using hellDensity
  let θ : ℝ := min 1 (ε / (8 * (c₀ + 1)))
  have hc₀p : 0 < c₀ + 1 := by linarith
  have hθ : 0 < θ := by
    dsimp [θ]
    rw [lt_min_iff]
    constructor
    · norm_num
    · positivity
  have hθ1 : θ ≤ 1 := by
    exact min_le_left _ _
  have hθfrac : θ ≤ ε / (8 * (c₀ + 1)) :=
    min_le_right _ _
  have hθc₀ : θ * c₀ ≤ ε / 8 := by
    have hden : 0 < 8 * (c₀ + 1) := by positivity
    have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ hden).mp hθfrac
    nlinarith
  have hmain :
      (1 + θ) * c₀ < cubeBulkDensity k + 3 * ε / 8 := by
    nlinarith
  let D := wallMeshScale k θ
  let C := ⌈(D : ℝ) * ell⌉₊ + 2
  let W : ℝ :=
    (k : ℝ) * (C + 1) * (D + 1) ^ (k - 1) *
      Nat.factorial k
  have hW : 0 ≤ W := by
    dsimp [W]
    positivity
  filter_upwards
    [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ),
      eventually_ge_atTop ((k : ℝ) * ell),
      eventually_ge_atTop
        (4 * (Nat.factorial k : ℝ) / ε),
      eventually_ge_atTop (8 * W / ε)]
    with L hL1 hLcells hLvolume hLwall
  have hLpos : 0 < L := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hL1
  have hp : k ≤ ⌊L / ell⌋₊ := by
    apply (Nat.le_floor_iff' (by omega : k ≠ 0)).2
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hell).2 (by
      simpa [mul_comm] using hLcells)
  have henvelope :=
    simplexCoverDensityAt_le_cells_wall
      (show 1 ≤ k by omega) hell hL1 hp hθ hθ1
      baseCenters hbase hq₀
  change
    simplexCoverDensityAt k L ≤
      (1 + θ) * c₀ +
        1 / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) +
        2 * (W / L) at henvelope
  have hLpow : L ≤ L ^ k := by
    have honePow : 1 ≤ L ^ (k - 1) :=
      one_le_pow₀ hL1
    have hkexp : k - 1 + 1 = k :=
      Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1 ≤ k by omega)
    rw [← hkexp, pow_succ]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right honePow hLpos.le]
  have hvolume : 1 / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) ≤ ε / 4 := by
    have hfac :
        (Nat.factorial k : ℝ) / L ≤ ε / 4 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hLpos]
      have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hLvolume
      nlinarith
    calc
      1 / (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k) =
          (Nat.factorial k : ℝ) / L ^ k := by
        field_simp [hLpos.ne', pow_ne_zero]
      _ ≤ (Nat.factorial k : ℝ) / L :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) hLpos hLpow
      _ ≤ ε / 4 := hfac
  have hwallSmall : 2 * (W / L) ≤ ε / 4 := by
    rw [show 2 * (W / L) = (2 * W) / L by ring]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hLpos]
    have hmul := (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp hLwall
    nlinarith
  exact henvelope.trans (by nlinarith)

name: BurningPath.eventually_simplexCoverNumber_upper
statement:
theorem eventually_simplexCoverNumber_upper
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ L : ℝ in atTop,
      (simplexCoverNumber k L : ℝ) ≤
        (cubeBulkDensity k + ε) *
          (L ^ k / Nat.factorial k)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards
    [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ),
      eventually_simplexCoverDensityAt_le_cubeBulkDensity_add k hk hε]
    with L hL hdensity
  have hvol : 0 < L ^ k / Nat.factorial k := by
    have hLpos : 0 < L := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hL
    positivity
  unfold simplexCoverDensityAt at hdensity
  exact (div_le_iff₀ hvol).mp hdensity

name: BurningPath.symmDiff_pair_eq_insert_erase
proof:
:= by
  have huv : u ≠ v := fun h ↦ hv (h ▸ hu)
  ext x
  by_cases hxu : x = u
  · subst x
    simp [Finset.mem_symmDiff, hu, huv]
  by_cases hxv : x = v
  · subst x
    simp [Finset.mem_symmDiff, hv]
  simp [Finset.mem_symmDiff, hxu, hxv]

name: BurningPath.tokenGraph_adj_iff_exists_move
statement:
theorem tokenGraph_adj_iff_exists_move (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ)
    (A B : Configuration V k) :
    (tokenGraph G k).Adj A B ↔
      ∃ u ∈ A.1, ∃ v ∉ A.1, G.Adj u v ∧ B.1 = insert v (A.1.erase u)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [tokenGraph_adj]
    rintro ⟨p, q, hpq, hAB⟩
    have hpq_ne : p ≠ q := hpq.ne
    have hfin : A.1 ∆ B.1 = ({p, q} : Finset V) := by
      apply Finset.coe_injective
      simpa using hAB
    have htotal : (A.1 ∆ B.1).card = 2 := by
      rw [hfin]
      simp [hpq_ne]
    have hdisjoint : Disjoint (A.1 \ B.1) (B.1 \ A.1) := by
      refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 ?_
      intro x hx hy
      exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).2 (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hy).1
    have hsum : (A.1 \ B.1).card + (B.1 \ A.1).card = 2 := by
      rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisjoint, ← Finset.symmDiff_def]
      exact htotal
    have hequal : (A.1 \ B.1).card = (B.1 \ A.1).card :=
      Finset.card_sdiff_comm (A.2.trans B.2.symm)
    have hleft : 0 < (A.1 \ B.1).card := by omega
    have hright : 0 < (B.1 \ A.1).card := by omega
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hleft
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hright
    obtain ⟨huA, huB⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hu
    obtain ⟨hvB, hvA⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hv
    have huPair : u = p ∨ u = q := by
      have : u ∈ ({p, q} : Finset V) := by
        rw [← hfin]
        exact Finset.mem_symmDiff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨huA, huB⟩)
      simpa using this
    have hvPair : v = p ∨ v = q := by
      have : v ∈ ({p, q} : Finset V) := by
        rw [← hfin]
        exact Finset.mem_symmDiff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨hvB, hvA⟩)
      simpa using this
    have huv_ne : u ≠ v := fun h ↦ hvA (h ▸ huA)
    have huv : G.Adj u v := by
      rcases huPair with rfl | rfl
      · rcases hvPair with rfl | rfl
        · exact (huv_ne rfl).elim
        · exact hpq
      · rcases hvPair with rfl | rfl
        · exact hpq.symm
        · exact (huv_ne rfl).elim
    have hpairSubset : ({u, v} : Finset V) ⊆ {p, q} := by
      intro x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx ⊢
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · exact huPair
      · exact hvPair
    have hpairs : ({u, v} : Finset V) = {p, q} := by
      apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hpairSubset
      simp [huv_ne, hpq_ne]
    have hfin' : A.1 ∆ B.1 = ({u, v} : Finset V) :=
      hfin.trans hpairs.symm
    have hB : B.1 = insert v (A.1.erase u) := by
      calc
        B.1 = A.1 ∆ (A.1 ∆ B.1) := (symmDiff_symmDiff_cancel_left A.1 B.1).symm
        _ = A.1 ∆ ({u, v} : Finset V) := by rw [hfin']
        _ = insert v (A.1.erase u) := symmDiff_pair_eq_insert_erase huA hvA
    exact ⟨u, huA, v, hvA, huv, hB⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, huA, v, hvA, huv, hB⟩
    rw [tokenGraph_adj]
    refine ⟨u, v, huv, ?_⟩
    have hfin : A.1 ∆ B.1 = ({u, v} : Finset V) := by
      rw [hB, ← symmDiff_pair_eq_insert_erase huA hvA]
      exact symmDiff_symmDiff_cancel_left A.1 ({u, v} : Finset V)
    simpa using congrArg (fun s : Finset V ↦ (s : Set V)) hfin

name: BurningPath.tokenGraph_adj_exists_move_membership
statement:
theorem tokenGraph_adj_exists_move_membership (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ)
    (A B : Configuration V k) (h : (tokenGraph G k).Adj A B) :
    ∃ u v, u ∈ A.1 ∧ u ∉ B.1 ∧ v ∉ A.1 ∧ v ∈ B.1 ∧ G.Adj u v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, huA, v, hvA, huv, hB⟩ :=
    (tokenGraph_adj_iff_exists_move G k A B).mp h
  refine ⟨u, v, huA, ?_, hvA, ?_, huv⟩
  · rw [hB]
    simp [huv.ne]
  · rw [hB]
    simp

name: BurningPath.tokenGraph_adj_iff_exists_reverseMove
statement:
theorem tokenGraph_adj_iff_exists_reverseMove (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ)
    (A B : Configuration V k) :
    (tokenGraph G k).Adj A B ↔
      ∃ v ∈ B.1, ∃ u ∉ B.1, G.Adj v u ∧ A.1 = insert u (B.1.erase v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(tokenGraph G k).adj_comm]
  exact tokenGraph_adj_iff_exists_move G k B A

name: BurningPath.exists_cube_tile_interval
statement:
theorem exists_cube_tile_interval {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    {L x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hxm : x ≤ m * L) :
    ∃ a : Fin m, (a.val : ℝ) * L ≤ x ∧ x ≤ (a.val + 1 : ℕ) * L
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing x with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
      cases m with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa using hx0
        · simpa using hxm
      | succ m =>
          by_cases hx : x ≤ ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * L
          · obtain ⟨a, haLower, haUpper⟩ := ih (by omega) hx0 hx
            exact ⟨⟨a.val, by omega⟩, haLower, haUpper⟩
          · refine ⟨⟨m + 1, by omega⟩, le_of_not_ge hx, ?_⟩
            simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hxm

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_add_left
statement:
theorem realL1Dist_add_left {k : ℕ} (a x y : Fin k → ℝ) :
    realL1Dist (fun i ↦ a i + x i) (fun i ↦ a i + y i) =
      realL1Dist x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [realL1Dist]

name: BurningPath.realL1Dist_clampToCube_le
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  simp only [clampToCube]
  by_cases hc : c i ≤ L
  · simp [min_eq_left hc]
  · have hxc : x i ≤ c i := (hx i).2.trans (le_of_not_ge hc)
    have hxL := (hx i).2
    rw [show min (c i) L = L by exact min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge hc)]
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hxL), abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hxc)]
    linarith

name: BurningPath.HasCubeRankedCover.restrict
statement:
theorem HasCubeRankedCover.restrict {k q : ℕ} {L U : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hLU : L ≤ U)
    (hcover : HasCubeRankedCover k U q) :
    HasCubeRankedCover k L q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨centers, hlegal, hcover⟩ := hcover
  let clamped : Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    fun i ↦ clampToCube L (centers i)
  refine ⟨clamped, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    simp only [clamped, clampToCube]
    constructor
    · exact le_min (hlegal i j).1 hL
    · exact min_le_right _ _
  · intro x hx
    have hxU : x ∈ realCube k U := by
      intro i
      exact ⟨(hx i).1, (hx i).2.trans hLU⟩
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover x hxU
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    exact (realL1Dist_clampToCube_le x (centers i) hx).trans hi

name: BurningPath.HasCubeRankedCover.replicate
statement:
theorem HasCubeRankedCover.replicate {k m q : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hcover : HasCubeRankedCover k L q) :
    HasCubeRankedCover k ((m : ℝ) * L) (m ^ k * q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨baseCenters, hbaseLegal, hbaseCover⟩ := hcover
  let Tile := Fin k → Fin m
  let M := Fintype.card Tile
  let tileEquiv : Tile ≃ Fin M := Fintype.equivFin Tile
  let offset (a : Tile) : Fin k → ℝ :=
    fun i ↦ (a i).val * L
  let centers : Fin M → Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    fun a j i ↦ offset (tileEquiv.symm a) i + baseCenters j i
  have hM : 1 ≤ M := by
    apply Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr
    exact ⟨fun _ ↦ ⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
  have hlegal : ∀ a j, centers a j ∈ realCube k ((m : ℝ) * L) := by
    intro a j i
    have ha := (tileEquiv.symm a i).isLt
    have hc := hbaseLegal j i
    simp only [centers, offset]
    constructor
    · exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hL) hc.1
    · have haLe : ((tileEquiv.symm a i).val + 1 : ℕ) ≤ m := by omega
      have hoff :
          ((tileEquiv.symm a i).val : ℝ) * L + L ≤ (m : ℝ) * L := by
        have hcast : (((tileEquiv.symm a i).val + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ m := by
          exact_mod_cast haLe
        push_cast at hcast
        nlinarith
      nlinarith
  have hpoint :
      ∀ x ∈ realCube k ((m : ℝ) * L),
        ∃ a : Fin M, ∃ j : Fin q,
          realL1Dist x (centers a j) ≤ (j.val : ℝ) / q := by
    intro x hx
    have htile :
        ∀ i, ∃ a : Fin m,
          (a.val : ℝ) * L ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ (a.val + 1 : ℕ) * L := by
      intro i
      exact exists_cube_tile_interval hm (hx i).1 (hx i).2
    choose tile htileLower htileUpper using htile
    let y : Fin k → ℝ := fun i ↦ x i - (tile i).val * L
    have hy : y ∈ realCube k L := by
      intro i
      constructor
      · exact sub_nonneg.mpr (htileLower i)
      · have hu := htileUpper i
        push_cast at hu
        dsimp only [y]
        nlinarith
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hbaseCover y hy
    let a := tileEquiv tile
    refine ⟨a, j, ?_⟩
    have hdist :
        realL1Dist x (centers a j) = realL1Dist y (baseCenters j) := by
      unfold realL1Dist
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      simp only [centers, offset, a, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, y]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [hdist]
    exact hj
  have hinterleaved :
      HasL1NormalizedRankedCover
        (realCube k ((m : ℝ) * L)) (M * q) :=
    hasL1NormalizedRankedCover_interleave hM hq centers hlegal hpoint
  simpa [HasCubeRankedCover, M, Tile, Nat.mul_comm] using hinterleaved

name: BurningPath.cubeCoverNumber_nat_mul_le
statement:
theorem cubeCoverNumber_nat_mul_le {k m : ℕ} {L : ℝ}
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hexists : ∃ q, 1 ≤ q ∧ HasCubeRankedCover k L q) :
    cubeCoverNumber k ((m : ℝ) * L) ≤ m ^ k * cubeCoverNumber k L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hq, hcover⟩ := cubeCoverNumber_spec hexists
  apply cubeCoverNumber_min
  constructor
  · exact Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos hm k) hq
  · exact hcover.replicate hm hq hL

name: BurningPath.cubeCoverNumber_le_ceil_mul
statement:
theorem cubeCoverNumber_le_ceil_mul {k : ℕ} {L₀ L : ℝ}
    (hL₀ : 0 < L₀) (hL₀L : L₀ ≤ L)
    (hexists : ∃ q, 1 ≤ q ∧ HasCubeRankedCover k L₀ q) :
    cubeCoverNumber k L ≤
      ⌈L / L₀⌉₊ ^ k * cubeCoverNumber k L₀
proof:
:= by
  let m := ⌈L / L₀⌉₊
  have hratio : (1 : ℝ) ≤ L / L₀ := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hL₀]
    simpa using hL₀L
  have hm : 1 ≤ m := by
    have hceil : L / L₀ ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    exact_mod_cast hratio.trans hceil
  have hLm : L ≤ (m : ℝ) * L₀ := by
    have hceil : L / L₀ ≤ (m : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil _
    exact (div_le_iff₀ hL₀).mp hceil
  obtain ⟨hq, hcover⟩ := cubeCoverNumber_spec hexists
  apply cubeCoverNumber_min
  constructor
  · exact Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos hm k) hq
  · exact
      (hcover.replicate hm hq hL₀.le).restrict
        (hL₀.le.trans hL₀L) hLm

name: BurningPath.twoTokenNormalizedBurning_nonneg
statement:
theorem twoTokenNormalizedBurning_nonneg (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ twoTokenNormalizedBurning n
proof:
:= by
  exact div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)

name: BurningPath.eventually_twoTokenBurning_le_shelfInitialWidth
statement:
theorem eventually_twoTokenBurning_le_shelfInitialWidth {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n ≤ shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hlarge :=
    (tendsto_sub_atTop_nat 2).eventually (eventually_shelf_large_conditions hε.1)
  filter_upwards [hlarge, eventually_ge_atTop 2] with n hnlarge hn
  rw [pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_eq hn]
  exact
    pathTokenBurningNumber_le_shelfInitialWidth_of_large_conditions
      hε.1 hn hnlarge.1 hnlarge.2

name: BurningPath.exists_twoTokenBurning_upper_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_twoTokenBurning_upper_threshold {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ nε : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ nε,
      pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n ≤ shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact eventually_atTop.1 (eventually_twoTokenBurning_le_shelfInitialWidth hε)

name: BurningPath.exists_twoTokenBurning_upper_threshold_actual
statement:
theorem exists_twoTokenBurning_upper_threshold_actual {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ nε : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ nε, ∀ hn : 2 ≤ n,
      pathTokenBurningNumber n 2 hn ≤ shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨nε, hthreshold⟩ := exists_twoTokenBurning_upper_threshold hε
  refine ⟨nε, ?_⟩
  intro n hnε hn
  have htotal := hthreshold n hnε
  rwa [pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_eq hn] at htotal

name: BurningPath.tendsto_sub_two_div_natCast
statement:
theorem tendsto_sub_two_div_natCast :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have htwo :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (2 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have h :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ (1 : ℝ) - 2 / (n : ℝ))
        atTop (𝓝 1) :=
    by
      simpa using
        (show Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 1) from
          tendsto_const_nhds).sub htwo
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 2, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn hnpos
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hn]
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  norm_num

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shelfWidthScale_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale
statement:
theorem tendsto_shelfWidthScale_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        shelfWidthScale (n - 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    Filter.Tendsto.rpow_const tendsto_sub_two_div_natCast
      (p := (2 / 3 : ℝ)) (Or.inl one_ne_zero)
  have h' :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
        atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa using h
  apply h'.congr'
  filter_upwards with n
  simpa only [shelfWidthScale] using
    (Real.div_rpow
      (show 0 ≤ ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) by positivity)
      (show 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) by positivity) (2 / 3 : ℝ))

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale
statement:
theorem tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale {ε : ℝ} :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        shelfIdealWidth ε (n - 2) / (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 ((1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant))
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      Tendsto
        (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant)
        atTop (𝓝 ((1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have h :=
    hconst.mul tendsto_shelfWidthScale_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale
  simpa only [shelfIdealWidth, mul_div_assoc, mul_one] using h

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shelfInitialWidth_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale
statement:
theorem tendsto_shelfInitialWidth_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2) : ℝ) /
          (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 ((1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant))
proof:
:= by
  have hidealTop :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ shelfIdealWidth ε (n - 2)) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_atTop hε).comp (tendsto_sub_atTop_nat 2)
  have hceil :
      Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2) : ℝ) /
            shelfIdealWidth ε (n - 2))
        atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [shelfInitialWidth, Function.comp_def] using
      (tendsto_nat_ceil_div_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp hidealTop
  have hproduct :=
    hceil.mul
      (tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale (ε := ε))
  have heq :
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        ((shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2) : ℝ) /
            shelfIdealWidth ε (n - 2)) *
          (shelfIdealWidth ε (n - 2) /
            (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))) =ᶠ[atTop]
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          (shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2) : ℝ) /
            (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hidealTop.eventually_gt_atTop 0, eventually_gt_atTop 0]
      with n hideal hn
    have hscale : (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
      (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) _).ne'
    field_simp [hideal.ne', hscale]
  simpa only [one_mul] using hproduct.congr' heq

name: BurningPath.eventually_twoTokenNormalizedBurning_le_shelfWidthRatio
statement:
theorem eventually_twoTokenNormalizedBurning_le_shelfWidthRatio {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      twoTokenNormalizedBurning n ≤
        (shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2) : ℝ) /
          (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_twoTokenBurning_le_shelfInitialWidth hε]
    with n hn
  unfold twoTokenNormalizedBurning
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hn)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)

name: BurningPath.twoTokenSharpUpper_limsup
statement:
theorem twoTokenSharpUpper_limsup :
    limsup twoTokenNormalizedBurning atTop ≤ shelfSharpConstant
proof:
:= by
  have hcob :
      atTop.IsCoboundedUnder (· ≤ ·) twoTokenNormalizedBurning :=
    isCoboundedUnder_le_of_le atTop twoTokenNormalizedBurning_nonneg
  apply le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro η hη
  let ε : ℝ := min (1 / 2 : ℝ) (η / (2 * shelfSharpConstant))
  have hεpos : 0 < ε := by
    dsimp [ε]
    exact lt_min (by norm_num) (div_pos hη (mul_pos two_pos shelfSharpConstant_pos))
  have hεlt : ε < 1 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    exact (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  have hεc :
      ε * shelfSharpConstant < η := by
    have hle : ε ≤ η / (2 * shelfSharpConstant) := by
      exact min_le_right _ _
    have hc := shelfSharpConstant_pos
    have hmul :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle hc.le
    have heq :
        η / (2 * shelfSharpConstant) * shelfSharpConstant = η / 2 := by
      field_simp [hc.ne']
    rw [heq] at hmul
    linarith
  have hlimit :
      (1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant < shelfSharpConstant + η := by
    nlinarith
  have henvelope :=
    (tendsto_shelfInitialWidth_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale hεpos).eventually
      (Iio_mem_nhds hlimit)
  have hupper :=
    eventually_twoTokenNormalizedBurning_le_shelfWidthRatio
      (show ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 from ⟨hεpos, hεlt⟩)
  exact limsup_le_of_le hcob <|
    (hupper.and henvelope).mono fun _ hn ↦ hn.1.trans hn.2.le

name: BurningPath.twoTokenNormalizedBurning_bddAbove
statement:
private theorem twoTokenNormalizedBurning_bddAbove :
    atTop.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) twoTokenNormalizedBurning
proof:
:= by
  let ε : ℝ := 1 / 2
  have hε : ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    dsimp [ε]
    norm_num
  have hupper :=
    eventually_twoTokenNormalizedBurning_le_shelfWidthRatio hε
  have henvelope :=
    (tendsto_shelfInitialWidth_sub_two_div_twoTokenScale hε.1).eventually
      (Iio_mem_nhds
        (lt_add_one ((1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant)))
  refine ⟨(1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant + 1, ?_⟩
  exact
    (hupper.and henvelope).mono fun _ hn ↦
      hn.1.trans hn.2.le

name: BurningPath.twoTokenNormalizedBurning_bddBelow
statement:
private theorem twoTokenNormalizedBurning_bddBelow :
    atTop.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) twoTokenNormalizedBurning
proof:
:= by
  change ∃ b : ℝ, ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, twoTokenNormalizedBurning n ≥ b
  exact ⟨0, Eventually.of_forall twoTokenNormalizedBurning_nonneg⟩

name: BurningPath.tendsto_twoTokenNormalizedBurning
statement:
theorem tendsto_twoTokenNormalizedBurning :
    Tendsto twoTokenNormalizedBurning atTop (𝓝 shelfSharpConstant)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_of_le_liminf_of_limsup_le
  · change
      ((3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (3 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        liminf
          (fun n : ℕ ↦
            (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ) /
              (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
          atTop
    exact twoTokenLowerAsymptotic_liminf
  · exact twoTokenSharpUpper_limsup
  · exact twoTokenNormalizedBurning_bddAbove
  · exact twoTokenNormalizedBurning_bddBelow

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_two
statement:
theorem tendsto_pathTokenBurningRatio_two :
    Tendsto (pathTokenBurningRatio 2) atTop (𝓝 shelfSharpConstant)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun :
      pathTokenBurningRatio 2 = twoTokenNormalizedBurning := by
    funext n
    rw [pathTokenBurningRatio, pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow,
      twoTokenNormalizedBurning]
    norm_num
  rw [hfun]
  exact tendsto_twoTokenNormalizedBurning

name: BurningPath.twoTokenBurning_isEquivalent_sharp
statement:
theorem twoTokenBurning_isEquivalent_sharp :
    (fun n : ℕ ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ)) ~[atTop]
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        shelfSharpConstant * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply isEquivalent_of_tendsto_one
  change
    Tendsto
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ) /
          (shelfSharpConstant * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)))
      atTop (𝓝 1)
  have hdiv :=
    tendsto_twoTokenNormalizedBurning.div_const shelfSharpConstant
  have hquot :
      (fun n : ℕ ↦
        (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal 2 n : ℝ) /
          (shelfSharpConstant * (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ))) =
        (fun n : ℕ ↦
          twoTokenNormalizedBurning n / shelfSharpConstant) := by
    funext n
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      simp [twoTokenNormalizedBurning]
    · have hnpos : 0 < (n : ℝ) := by positivity
      have hscale : (n : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≠ 0 :=
        (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hnpos _).ne'
      unfold twoTokenNormalizedBurning
      field_simp [twoTokenNormalizedBurning, shelfSharpConstant_pos.ne', hscale]
  rw [hquot]
  simpa only [div_self shelfSharpConstant_pos.ne'] using hdiv

name: BurningPath.topRankEmbedding_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem topRankEmbedding_val (q M : ℕ) (hMq : M ≤ q) (i : Fin M) :
    (topRankEmbedding q M hMq i).val = q - M + i.val
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.hasL1NormalizedRankedCover_of_finiteNet
statement:
theorem hasL1NormalizedRankedCover_of_finiteNet {k M q : ℕ}
    {S : Set (Fin k → ℝ)} {δ : ℝ}
    (hS : S.Nonempty) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hMq : M ≤ q)
    (net : Fin M → (Fin k → ℝ))
    (hlegal : ∀ i, net i ∈ S)
    (hnet : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ i, realL1Dist x (net i) ≤ δ)
    (hradius : δ ≤ ((q - M : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) :
    HasL1NormalizedRankedCover S q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨i, _⟩ := hnet x hx
  have hMpos : 0 < M := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mpr ⟨i⟩
  let e := topRankEmbedding q M hMq
  let defaultCenter := net ⟨0, hMpos⟩
  let centers : Fin q → (Fin k → ℝ) :=
    Function.extend e net (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter)
  have hcenters (i : Fin M) : centers (e i) = net i :=
    e.injective.extend_apply net (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter) i
  refine ⟨centers, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r
    by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hr
      rw [hcenters]
      exact hlegal i
    · change Function.extend e net (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter) r ∈ S
      rw [Function.extend_apply' net (fun _ ↦ defaultCenter) r]
      · exact hlegal ⟨0, hMpos⟩
      · simpa only [Set.mem_range] using hr
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hnet y hy
    refine ⟨e j, ?_⟩
    rw [hcenters]
    calc
      realL1Dist y (net j) ≤ δ := hj
      _ ≤ ((q - M : ℕ) : ℝ) / q := hradius
      _ ≤ ((e j).val : ℝ) / q := by
        have hqpos : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
        apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ hqpos.le
        simp only [e, topRankEmbedding_val]
        exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right (q - M) j.val

name: BurningPath.volumeThreshold_le_burningNumber_of_ball_bound
statement:
theorem volumeThreshold_le_burningNumber_of_ball_bound
    [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ)
    (hball : ∀ c r, (G.closedBall c r).ncard ≤ latticeBallPolynomial k r) :
    volumeThreshold k (Fintype.card V) ≤ G.burningNumber
proof:
:= by
  apply volumeThreshold_min
  refine ⟨G.one_le_burningNumber, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨centers, hcover⟩ := G.burningNumber_spec.2
  have hcard :=
    G.card_le_sum_ball_bound hcover (latticeBallPolynomial k) hball
  calc
    Fintype.card V ≤ cumulativeLatticeBallPolynomial k G.burningNumber := by
      simpa [cumulativeLatticeBallPolynomial, Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range] using hcard
    _ = rankedVolumePolynomial k G.burningNumber :=
      cumulativeLatticeBallPolynomial_eq k G.burningNumber

name: BurningPath.exists_fin_bounded_composition
statement:
theorem exists_fin_bounded_composition (m a s : ℕ) (h : s ≤ m * a) :
    ∃ e : Fin m → ℕ, (∀ i, e i ≤ a) ∧ ∑ i, e i = s
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing s with
  | zero =>
      have hs : s = 0 := by simpa using h
      subst s
      exact ⟨fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i, fun i ↦ Fin.elim0 i, by simp⟩
  | succ m ih =>
      let x := min s a
      have hx_le_a : x ≤ a := min_le_right s a
      have hx_le_s : x ≤ s := min_le_left s a
      have htail : s - x ≤ m * a := by
        by_cases hsa : s ≤ a
        · simp [x, min_eq_left hsa]
        · have has : a ≤ s := Nat.le_of_not_ge hsa
          simp only [Nat.succ_mul] at h
          simp only [x, min_eq_right has]
          omega
      obtain ⟨e, he_bound, he_sum⟩ := ih (s - x) htail
      refine ⟨Fin.cons x e, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i
        · simpa using hx_le_a
        · simpa using he_bound j
      · rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
        simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, he_sum]
        omega

name: BurningPath.measurableSet_orderedSimplex
statement:
theorem measurableSet_orderedSimplex (k : ℕ) (L : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (orderedSimplex k L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show orderedSimplex k L =
      {x | ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ L} ∩ {x | Monotone x} by rfl]
  apply MeasurableSet.inter
  · simp only [Set.setOf_forall]
    exact MeasurableSet.iInter fun i ↦
      (measurableSet_le measurable_const (measurable_pi_apply i)).inter
        (measurableSet_le (measurable_pi_apply i) measurable_const)
  · change MeasurableSet {x : Fin k → ℝ | ∀ i j, i ≤ j → x i ≤ x j}
    simp only [Set.setOf_forall]
    refine MeasurableSet.iInter fun i ↦ MeasurableSet.iInter fun j ↦ ?_
    by_cases hij : i ≤ j
    · simpa [hij] using
        measurableSet_le (measurable_pi_apply i) (measurable_pi_apply j)
    · simp [hij]

name: BurningPath.splitLast_fst
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: BurningPath.splitLast_snd
proof:
:= by
  simp [splitLast, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_apply,
    Fin.insertNthEquiv, Fin.init]

name: BurningPath.splitLast_symm_last
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      (splitLast k ((splitLast k).symm p)).1 = p.1 :=
    congrArg Prod.fst ((splitLast k).apply_symm_apply p)
  rw [splitLast_fst] at h
  exact h

name: BurningPath.splitLast_symm_castSucc
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem splitLast_symm_castSucc (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ × (Fin k → ℝ))
    (i : Fin k) :
    (splitLast k).symm p i.castSucc = p.2 i
proof:
:= by
  have h :
      (splitLast k ((splitLast k).symm p)).2 i = p.2 i :=
    congrArg (fun q : ℝ × (Fin k → ℝ) ↦ q.2 i)
      ((splitLast k).apply_symm_apply p)
  rw [splitLast_snd] at h
  exact h

name: BurningPath.splitLast_image_orderedSimplex
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · exact hx.1 (Fin.last k)
    · constructor
      · intro i
        constructor
        · simpa using (hx.1 i.castSucc).1
        · simpa using hx.2 (Fin.le_last i.castSucc)
      · intro i j hij
        simpa using hx.2 (Fin.castSucc_le_castSucc_iff.mpr hij)
  · intro hp
    refine ⟨(splitLast k).symm p, ?_, (splitLast k).apply_symm_apply p⟩
    constructor
    · intro i
      cases i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          simpa only [splitLast_symm_last, Set.mem_Icc] using hp.1
      | cast j =>
        constructor
        · simpa using (hp.2.1 j).1
        · simpa only [splitLast_symm_castSucc] using
            (hp.2.1 j).2.trans hp.1.2
    · intro i j hij
      cases i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          have hj : j = Fin.last k := le_antisymm (Fin.le_last j) hij
          subst j
          exact le_rfl
      | cast i' =>
          cases j using Fin.lastCases with
          | last =>
              simpa only [splitLast_symm_castSucc, splitLast_symm_last] using
                (hp.2.1 i').2
          | cast j' =>
              have hij' : i' ≤ j' := Fin.castSucc_le_castSucc_iff.mp hij
              simpa only [splitLast_symm_castSucc] using hp.2.2 hij'

name: BurningPath.setLIntegral_pow_div_factorial
statement:
private theorem setLIntegral_pow_div_factorial (k : ℕ) {L : ℝ}
    (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∫⁻ y : ℝ in Set.Icc 0 L,
        ENNReal.ofReal (y ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (L ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [setLIntegral_congr Ioc_ae_eq_Icc.symm]
  have hint :
      IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ ↦ y ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ))
        (Set.Ioc 0 L) :=
    (intervalIntegral.intervalIntegrable_pow k).1.div_const _
  have hnonneg :
      0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 L)]
        (fun y : ℝ ↦ y ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioc] with y hy
    exact div_nonneg (pow_nonneg hy.1.le k) (by positivity)
  rw [← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hint hnonneg]
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hL,
    intervalIntegral.integral_div, integral_pow]
  rw [zero_pow (by omega : k + 1 ≠ 0), sub_zero]
  congr 1
  rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: BurningPath.volume_orderedSimplex
statement:
theorem volume_orderedSimplex (k : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    volume (orderedSimplex k L) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (L ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing L with
  | zero =>
      have hset : orderedSimplex 0 L = realCube 0 L := by
        ext x
        constructor
        · exact fun hx ↦ hx.1
        · intro hx
          exact ⟨hx, fun i ↦ isEmptyElim i⟩
      rw [hset, volume_realCube hL]
      norm_num
  | succ k ih =>
      let e := splitLast k
      let S := e '' orderedSimplex (k + 1) L
      have hS : MeasurableSet S := by
        exact e.measurableSet_image.mpr
          (measurableSet_orderedSimplex (k + 1) L)
      have hpre : e ⁻¹' S = orderedSimplex (k + 1) L := by
        exact e.injective.preimage_image _
      have hpres :
          MeasurePreserving e volume volume := by
        simpa [e, splitLast] using
          (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove
            (fun _ : Fin (k + 1) ↦ ℝ) (Fin.last k))
      calc
        volume (orderedSimplex (k + 1) L) =
            volume (e ⁻¹' S) := by rw [hpre]
        _ = volume S :=
          hpres.measure_preimage hS.nullMeasurableSet
        _ = ∫⁻ y : ℝ, volume (Prod.mk y ⁻¹' S) :=
          by
            change (volume.prod volume) S = _
            exact Measure.prod_apply hS
        _ = ∫⁻ y : ℝ in Set.Icc 0 L,
            volume (orderedSimplex k y) := by
          have hfiber (y : ℝ) :
              volume (Prod.mk y ⁻¹' S) =
                Set.indicator (Set.Icc 0 L)
                  (fun z : ℝ ↦ volume (orderedSimplex k z)) y := by
            rw [show S =
                {p : ℝ × (Fin k → ℝ) |
                  p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) L ∧
                    p.2 ∈ orderedSimplex k p.1} by
              simpa [S, e] using splitLast_image_orderedSimplex k L]
            have hpreimage :
                Prod.mk y ⁻¹'
                    {p : ℝ × (Fin k → ℝ) |
                      p.1 ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) L ∧
                        p.2 ∈ orderedSimplex k p.1} =
                  {a : Fin k → ℝ |
                    (0 ≤ y ∧ y ≤ L) ∧ a ∈ orderedSimplex k y} := by
              ext a
              simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_Icc]
            rw [hpreimage]
            by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) L
            · have hy' : 0 ≤ y ∧ y ≤ L := by
                simpa only [Set.mem_Icc] using hy
              rw [show
                  {a : Fin k → ℝ |
                    (0 ≤ y ∧ y ≤ L) ∧ a ∈ orderedSimplex k y} =
                    orderedSimplex k y by
                ext a
                simp [hy']]
              simp [hy]
            · have hy' : ¬(0 ≤ y ∧ y ≤ L) := by
                simpa only [Set.mem_Icc] using hy
              rw [show
                  {a : Fin k → ℝ |
                    (0 ≤ y ∧ y ≤ L) ∧ a ∈ orderedSimplex k y} =
                    ∅ by
                ext a
                simp [hy']]
              simp [hy]
          simp_rw [hfiber]
          exact lintegral_indicator measurableSet_Icc _
        _ = ∫⁻ y : ℝ in Set.Icc 0 L,
            ENNReal.ofReal (y ^ k / (k.factorial : ℝ)) := by
          apply setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Icc
          intro y hy
          exact ih hy.1
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal
            (L ^ (k + 1) / ((k + 1).factorial : ℝ)) :=
          setLIntegral_pow_div_factorial k hL

name: BurningPath.exists_cubeRankedCover
statement:
private theorem exists_cubeRankedCover {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 ≤ L) :
    ∃ q, 1 ≤ q ∧ HasCubeRankedCover k L q
proof:
:= by
  let q := (k + 1) * cubeGridCount k L ^ k
  refine ⟨q, ?_, hasCubeRankedCover_grid hL⟩
  exact Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (pow_pos (cubeGridCount_pos k L) k)

name: BurningPath.cubeDensityValues_nonempty
statement:
private theorem cubeDensityValues_nonempty (k : ℕ) :
    {x : ℝ | ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ x = cubeCoverDensityAt k L}.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨cubeCoverDensityAt k 1, 1, by norm_num, rfl⟩

name: BurningPath.cubeDensityValues_bddBelow
statement:
private theorem cubeDensityValues_bddBelow (k : ℕ) :
    BddBelow {x : ℝ | ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ x = cubeCoverDensityAt k L}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rintro x ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩
  exact div_nonneg (by positivity) (pow_nonneg hL.le k)

name: BurningPath.cubeBulkDensity_le_densityAt
statement:
theorem cubeBulkDensity_le_densityAt {k : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) :
    cubeBulkDensity k ≤ cubeCoverDensityAt k L
proof:
:= by
  rw [cubeBulkDensity]
  apply csInf_le (cubeDensityValues_bddBelow k)
  exact ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩

name: BurningPath.exists_cubeCoverDensityAt_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [cubeBulkDensity] at hU
  obtain ⟨x, ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩, hx⟩ :=
    exists_lt_of_csInf_lt (cubeDensityValues_nonempty k) hU
  exact ⟨L, hL, hx⟩

name: BurningPath.tendsto_cubeReplicationFactor
statement:
theorem tendsto_cubeReplicationFactor (L₀ : ℝ) (hL₀ : 0 < L₀) :
    Tendsto (cubeReplicationFactor L₀) atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hratio :
      Tendsto (fun L : ℝ ↦ L / L₀) atTop atTop := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using
      tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop (inv_pos.mpr hL₀)
  exact tendsto_nat_ceil_div_atTop.comp hratio

name: BurningPath.cubeCoverDensityAt_le_replication
statement:
theorem cubeCoverDensityAt_le_replication {k : ℕ} {L₀ L : ℝ}
    (hL₀ : 0 < L₀) (hL₀L : L₀ ≤ L) :
    cubeCoverDensityAt k L ≤
      cubeCoverDensityAt k L₀ * cubeReplicationFactor L₀ L ^ k
proof:
:= by
  have hL : 0 < L := hL₀.trans_le hL₀L
  have hNat :=
    cubeCoverNumber_le_ceil_mul hL₀ hL₀L
      (exists_cubeRankedCover (k := k) hL₀.le)
  have hcast :
      (cubeCoverNumber k L : ℝ) ≤
        (⌈L / L₀⌉₊ ^ k * cubeCoverNumber k L₀ : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hNat
  calc
    cubeCoverDensityAt k L ≤
        ((⌈L / L₀⌉₊ ^ k * cubeCoverNumber k L₀ : ℕ) : ℝ) /
          L ^ k := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hcast (pow_nonneg hL.le k)
    _ = cubeCoverDensityAt k L₀ * cubeReplicationFactor L₀ L ^ k := by
      have hfactor :
          cubeReplicationFactor L₀ L =
            (⌈L / L₀⌉₊ : ℝ) * L₀ / L := by
        unfold cubeReplicationFactor
        field_simp [hL.ne', hL₀.ne']
      unfold cubeCoverDensityAt
      rw [hfactor, div_pow, mul_pow]
      push_cast
      field_simp [hL.ne', hL₀.ne', pow_ne_zero]

name: BurningPath.tendsto_cubeCoverDensityAt
statement:
theorem tendsto_cubeCoverDensityAt (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (cubeCoverDensityAt k) atTop (𝓝 (cubeBulkDensity k))
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_order.2
  constructor
  · intro l hl
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with L hL
    exact hl.trans_le (cubeBulkDensity_le_densityAt (by linarith))
  · intro U hU
    obtain ⟨L₀, hL₀, hL₀U⟩ := exists_cubeCoverDensityAt_lt hU
    have htend :
        Tendsto
          (fun L ↦
            cubeCoverDensityAt k L₀ * cubeReplicationFactor L₀ L ^ k)
          atTop (𝓝 (cubeCoverDensityAt k L₀)) := by
      simpa using
        tendsto_const_nhds.mul ((tendsto_cubeReplicationFactor L₀ hL₀).pow k)
    filter_upwards
      [eventually_ge_atTop L₀, htend.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hL₀U)]
      with L hL hfactor
    exact (cubeCoverDensityAt_le_replication hL₀ hL).trans_lt hfactor

name: BurningPath.cubeBulkDensity_eq_limit
statement:
theorem cubeBulkDensity_eq_limit (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto
      (fun L ↦ (cubeCoverNumber k L : ℝ) / L ^ k)
      atTop (𝓝 (cubeBulkDensity k))
proof:
:=
  tendsto_cubeCoverDensityAt k

name: BurningPath.mem_integerSquare_iff_centeredCoordinateSquare
statement:
theorem mem_integerSquare_iff_centeredCoordinateSquare
    {c p : ℤ × ℤ} {r : ℕ} :
    p ∈ integerSquare c r ↔ p ∈ centeredCoordinateSquare c r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [integerSquare, intLinfDist, centeredCoordinateSquare,
    Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  rw [max_le_iff, max_le_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    · have h :
          (((p.1 - c.1).natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r : ℤ) := by
          simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using h₁
      exact_mod_cast h
    · have h :
          (((p.2 - c.2).natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r : ℤ) := by
          simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using h₂
      exact_mod_cast h
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    · have h :
          (((p.1 - c.1).natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r : ℤ) := by
          exact_mod_cast h₁
      simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using h
    · have h :
          (((p.2 - c.2).natAbs : ℕ) : ℤ) ≤ (r : ℤ) := by
          exact_mod_cast h₂
      simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using h

name: BurningPath.IsParityCapRankedCover.toPathTokenRankedCover
statement:
theorem IsParityCapRankedCover.toPathTokenRankedCover
    {n t : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2])
    {squareCenters : Fin t → ℤ × ℤ}
    (hcover : IsParityCapRankedCover 0 (n - 2) t σ squareCenters) :
    ∃ centers : Fin t → Configuration (Fin n) 2,
      (pathTokenGraph n 2).IsRankedCover centers
proof:
:= by
  have htriangle (r : Fin t) :
      squareCenters r ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) σ := by
    rw [← parityCap_zero]
    exact hcover.1 r
  let centers : Fin t → Configuration (Fin n) 2 :=
    fun r ↦
      (twoConfigurationPhiEquiv hn σ hσ).symm
        ⟨squareCenters r, htriangle r⟩
  refine ⟨centers, ?_⟩
  intro A
  have hAtriangle :
      twoConfigurationPhi A ∈ parityTriangle (n - 2) σ :=
    twoTokenPhi_mem_parityTriangle hn σ hσ
      (twoConfigurationEquivTwoPathPoint n A)
  have hAcap :
      twoConfigurationPhi A ∈ parityCap 0 (n - 2) σ := by
    rwa [parityCap_zero]
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hcover.2 (twoConfigurationPhi A) hAcap
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  apply
    (mem_twoToken_closedBall_iff_phi_mem_centeredCoordinateSquare
      A (centers r)).mpr
  have hcenterPhi :
      twoConfigurationPhi (centers r) = squareCenters r := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      ((twoConfigurationPhiEquiv hn σ hσ).apply_symm_apply
        ⟨squareCenters r, htriangle r⟩)
  rw [hcenterPhi]
  exact mem_integerSquare_iff_centeredCoordinateSquare.mp hr

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningNumber_le_of_parityTriangleCover
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurningNumber_le_of_parityTriangleCover
    {n t : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (σ : ℤ)
    (hσ : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2])
    (hcover :
      ∃ squareCenters : Fin t → ℤ × ℤ,
        IsParityCapRankedCover 0 (n - 2) t σ squareCenters) :
    pathTokenBurningNumber n 2 hn ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨squareCenters, hsquare⟩ := hcover
  obtain ⟨centers, hcenters⟩ :=
    hsquare.toPathTokenRankedCover hn σ hσ
  letI := nonempty_configuration_of_le (Fin n) (by simpa using hn)
  change (pathTokenGraph n 2).burningNumber ≤ t
  apply (pathTokenGraph n 2).burningNumber_min
  have ht : 0 < t := by
    obtain ⟨r, _⟩ :=
      hcenters
        (Classical.choice
          (inferInstance : Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) 2)))
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le r.val) r.isLt
  exact ⟨ht, centers, hcenters⟩

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningNumber_le_shelfInitialWidth_of_large_conditions
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurningNumber_le_shelfInitialWidth_of_large_conditions
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hloss :
      30 * (shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2) : ℝ) * ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        shelfDelta ε / 2 * ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hwidth :
      (144 : ℝ) ≤ shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale (n - 2)) :
    pathTokenBurningNumber n 2 hn ≤ shelfInitialWidth ε (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  let σ : ℤ := n
  have hσn : (n : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2] := Int.ModEq.rfl
  have hσN : ((n - 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2] := by
    apply Int.ModEq.trans _ hσn
    rw [Int.modEq_iff_dvd]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    omega
  have hcover :=
    exists_parityTriangleCover_of_large_conditions hε hσN hloss hwidth
  exact
    pathTokenBurningNumber_le_of_parityTriangleCover
      hn σ hσn hcover

name: BurningPath.coordinate_mem

name: BurningPath.strictMono_update_of_pathGraph_adj
statement:
private theorem strictMono_update_of_pathGraph_adj {n k : ℕ} {f : Fin k → Fin n}
    (hf : StrictMono f) {i : Fin k} {u v : Fin n} (hi : f i = u)
    (hv : ∀ j, f j ≠ v) (huv : (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj u v) :
    StrictMono (Function.update f i v)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have hpath := SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj.mp huv
  by_cases hai : a = i
  · subst a
    have hbi : b ≠ i := by
      intro h
      subst b
      exact (lt_irrefl i hab).elim
    rw [Function.update_self, Function.update_of_ne hbi]
    have hub : u < f b := by
      rw [← hi]
      exact hf hab
    have hbne : (f b).val ≠ v.val := fun h ↦ hv b (Fin.ext h)
    change v.val < (f b).val
    rcases hpath with hpath | hpath <;> omega
  · by_cases hbi : b = i
    · subst b
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hai, Function.update_self]
      have hau : f a < u := by
        rw [← hi]
        exact hf hab
      have hane : (f a).val ≠ v.val := fun h ↦ hv a (Fin.ext h)
      change (f a).val < v.val
      rcases hpath with hpath | hpath <;> omega
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hai, Function.update_of_ne hbi]
      exact hf hab

name: BurningPath.pathTokenGraph_adj_exists_coordinate_update
statement:
theorem pathTokenGraph_adj_exists_coordinate_update {n k : ℕ}
    (A B : Configuration (Fin n) k) (h : (pathTokenGraph n k).Adj A B) :
    ∃ i : Fin k, ∃ v : Fin n,
      (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n).Adj (coordinate A i) v ∧
        v ∉ A.1 ∧ coordinate B = Function.update (coordinate A) i v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, huA, v, hvA, huv, hB⟩ :=
    (tokenGraph_adj_iff_exists_move (SimpleGraph.pathGraph n) k A B).mp h
  have huRange : u ∈ Set.range (A.1.orderEmbOfFin A.2) := by
    rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
    exact huA
  obtain ⟨i, hi'⟩ := huRange
  have hi : coordinate A i = u := by
    change A.1.orderEmbOfFin A.2 i = u
    exact hi'
  have hvcoord : ∀ j, coordinate A j ≠ v := by
    intro j hj
    exact hvA (hj ▸ coordinate_mem A j)
  let updated : Fin k → Fin n := Function.update (coordinate A) i v
  have hupdated : StrictMono updated := by
    exact strictMono_update_of_pathGraph_adj (coordinate_strictMono A) hi hvcoord huv
  let updatedEmb : Fin k ↪o Fin n := OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono updated hupdated
  have hupdatedMem : ∀ j, updatedEmb j ∈ B.1 := by
    intro j
    rw [hB]
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst j
      simp [updatedEmb, updated]
    · have hju : coordinate A j ≠ u := by
        intro hju
        apply hji
        exact (coordinate_strictMono A).injective (hju.trans hi.symm)
      simp [updatedEmb, updated, hji, hju, coordinate_mem A j]
  have hemb : updatedEmb = B.1.orderEmbOfFin B.2 :=
    Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique' B.2 hupdatedMem
  have hcoordinate : coordinate B = updated := by
    funext j
    change B.1.orderEmbOfFin B.2 j = updated j
    rw [← hemb]
    rfl
  refine ⟨i, v, ?_, hvA, ?_⟩
  · rw [hi]
    exact huv
  · simpa [updated] using hcoordinate

name: BurningPath.pathConfigurationDist_eq_one_of_adj
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨i, v, hiv, _, hcoordinate⟩ :=
    pathTokenGraph_adj_exists_coordinate_update A B h
  rw [pathConfigurationDist, hcoordinate, Fintype.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [Function.update_self]
    rcases SimpleGraph.pathGraph_adj.mp hiv with hiv | hiv <;> unfold Nat.dist <;> omega
  · intro j hji
    rw [Function.update_of_ne hji]
    exact Nat.dist_self _

name: BurningPath.pathConfigurationDist_le_walk_length
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons A B C hAB p ih =>
      calc
        pathConfigurationDist A C ≤
            pathConfigurationDist A B + pathConfigurationDist B C :=
          pathConfigurationDist_triangle A B C
        _ = 1 + pathConfigurationDist B C := by
          rw [pathConfigurationDist_eq_one_of_adj A B hAB]
        _ ≤ 1 + p.length := Nat.add_le_add_left ih 1
        _ = (SimpleGraph.Walk.cons hAB p).length := by simp [add_comm]

name: BurningPath.pathToken_closedBall_subset_pathConfigurationBall
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA
  have hfinite : (pathTokenGraph n k).edist A C ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro htop
    simp [SimpleGraph.mem_closedBall, htop] at hA
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (pathTokenGraph n k).exists_walk_of_edist_ne_top hfinite
  have hlength : p.length ≤ r := by
    have hlength' : (p.length : ℕ∞) ≤ (r : ℕ∞) := by
      simpa [SimpleGraph.mem_closedBall, hp] using hA
    exact_mod_cast hlength'
  exact (pathConfigurationDist_le_walk_length p).trans hlength

name: BurningPath.pathToken_closedBall_ncard_le
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ((pathTokenGraph n k).closedBall C r).ncard ≤ (pathConfigurationBall C r).ncard :=

    _ ≤ latticeBallPolynomial k r := pathConfigurationBall_ncard_le C r

name: BurningPath.cubeBulkDensity_lower
statement:
theorem cubeBulkDensity_lower {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    ((Nat.factorial k : ℝ) * (k + 1)) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤
      cubeBulkDensity k
proof:
:= by
  rw [cubeBulkDensity]
  apply le_csInf
  · exact
      ⟨(cubeCoverNumber k 1 : ℝ),
        ⟨1, by norm_num, by simp⟩⟩
  · rintro x ⟨L, hL, rfl⟩
    let q := (k + 1) * cubeGridCount k L ^ k
    have hq : 1 ≤ q :=
      Nat.mul_pos (by omega) (pow_pos (cubeGridCount_pos k L) k)
    have hexists :
        ∃ t, 1 ≤ t ∧ HasCubeRankedCover k L t :=
      ⟨q, hq, hasCubeRankedCover_grid hL.le⟩
    obtain ⟨hνpos, hνcover⟩ := cubeCoverNumber_spec hexists
    exact cubeRankedCover_ratio_lower hk hL hνpos hνcover

name: BurningPath.IsPathMetricRankedSubcover.extend
statement:
theorem IsPathMetricRankedSubcover.extend [Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) k)]
    {t : ℕ} {ι : Type*} {radii : ι ↪ Fin t}
    {centers : ι → Configuration (Fin n) k}
    (h : IsPathMetricRankedSubcover radii centers) :
    ∃ fullCenters : Fin t → Configuration (Fin n) k,
      IsPathMetricRankedCover fullCenters ∧
        ∀ i, fullCenters (radii i) = centers i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let fullCenters : Fin t → Configuration (Fin n) k :=
    Function.extend radii centers
      (fun _ ↦ Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) k)))
  have hfull : ∀ i, fullCenters (radii i) = centers i := by
    intro i
    exact radii.injective.extend_apply centers
      (fun _ ↦ Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) k))) i
  refine ⟨fullCenters, ?_, hfull⟩
  intro A
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h A
  refine ⟨radii i, ?_⟩
  rw [hfull i]
  exact hi

name: BurningPath.IsPathMetricRankedCover.extendLength
statement:
theorem IsPathMetricRankedCover.extendLength [Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) k)]
    {u v : ℕ} {centers : Fin u → Configuration (Fin n) k}
    (h : IsPathMetricRankedCover centers) (huv : u ≤ v) :
    HasPathMetricRankedCover n k v
proof:
:= by
  have hsub :
      IsPathMetricRankedSubcover (Fin.castLEEmb huv) centers := by
    intro A
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h A
    exact ⟨r, hr⟩
  obtain ⟨fullCenters, hcover, _⟩ := hsub.extend
  exact ⟨fullCenters, hcover⟩

name: BurningPath.highRadiusEmbedding_val
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: BurningPath.configuration_nonempty_of_le
statement:
private theorem configuration_nonempty_of_le {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hcard⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_subset_card_eq (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) (by simpa using hkn)

name: BurningPath.hasPathMetricRankedCover_realizedBlockClasses
statement:
theorem hasPathMetricRankedCover_realizedBlockClasses {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    HasPathMetricRankedCover n k
      (realizedBlockClassCount n k s hs + k * (s - 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) k) := configuration_nonempty_of_le hkn
  let signatures := realizedBlockSignatures n k s hs
  let M := signatures.card
  let R := k * (s - 1)
  have representative_exists :
      ∀ σ : signatures, ∃ A : Configuration (Fin n) k,
        blockSignature s hs A = σ.1 := by
    intro σ
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp σ.2 with ⟨A, hA, hsignature⟩
    exact ⟨A, hsignature⟩
  choose representative hrepresentative using representative_exists
  let enumerate : signatures ≃ Fin M := signatures.equivFin
  let radii : signatures ↪ Fin (M + R) :=
    enumerate.toEmbedding.trans (highRadiusEmbedding R M)
  have hsub : IsPathMetricRankedSubcover radii representative := by
    intro A
    let σ : signatures :=
      ⟨blockSignature s hs A, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨A, Finset.mem_univ A, rfl⟩⟩
    refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
    have hdist :
        pathConfigurationDist A (representative σ) ≤ R := by
      apply pathConfigurationDist_le_of_blockSignature_eq s hs
      simpa [σ] using (hrepresentative σ).symm
    calc
      pathConfigurationDist A (representative σ) ≤ R := hdist
      _ ≤ (radii σ).val := by
        change R ≤ R + (enumerate σ).val
        exact Nat.le_add_right R _
  obtain ⟨centers, hcover, _⟩ := hsub.extend
  simpa [M, R, realizedBlockClassCount, signatures] using
    (show HasPathMetricRankedCover n k (M + R) from ⟨centers, hcover⟩)

name: BurningPath.exists_blockClassCount_and_pathMetricRankedCover
statement:
theorem exists_blockClassCount_and_pathMetricRankedCover {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    ∃ M', M' ≤ Nat.choose (blockCount n s + k - 1) k ∧
      HasPathMetricRankedCover n k (M' + k * (s - 1))
proof:
:=
  ⟨realizedBlockClassCount n k s hs, realizedBlockClassCount_le n k s hs,
    hasPathMetricRankedCover_realizedBlockClasses hkn s hs⟩

name: BurningPath.exists_pathMetricRankedCover_length_le_blockBound
statement:
theorem exists_pathMetricRankedCover_length_le_blockBound {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ Nat.choose (n ⌈/⌉ s + k - 1) k + k * (s - 1) ∧
      HasPathMetricRankedCover n k t
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨realizedBlockClassCount n k s hs + k * (s - 1), ?_,
      hasPathMetricRankedCover_realizedBlockClasses hkn s hs⟩
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right
    (by simpa [blockCount] using realizedBlockClassCount_le n k s hs) _

name: BurningPath.hasPathMetricRankedCover_blockBound
statement:
theorem hasPathMetricRankedCover_blockBound {n k : ℕ} (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    HasPathMetricRankedCover n k
      (Nat.choose (n ⌈/⌉ s + k - 1) k + k * (s - 1))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty (Configuration (Fin n) k) := configuration_nonempty_of_le hkn
  obtain ⟨centers, hcover⟩ :=
    hasPathMetricRankedCover_realizedBlockClasses hkn s hs
  apply hcover.extendLength
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right
    (by simpa [blockCount] using realizedBlockClassCount_le n k s hs) _

name: BurningPath.finOrderEmbedding_index_le
statement:
private theorem finOrderEmbedding_index_le {n k : ℕ} (f : Fin k ↪o Fin n) (i : Fin k) :
    i.val ≤ (f i).val
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ k =>
      induction i using Fin.induction with
      | zero => exact Nat.zero_le _
      | succ i ih =>
          have hstep := f.strictMono (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ : i.castSucc < i.succ)
          simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at ih hstep ⊢
          omega

name: BurningPath.finOrderEmbedding_shift_monotone
statement:
private theorem finOrderEmbedding_shift_monotone {n k : ℕ} (f : Fin k ↪o Fin n) :
    Monotone fun i ↦ (f i).val - i.val
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      intro i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ k =>
      rw [Fin.monotone_iff_le_succ]
      intro i
      have hindex := finOrderEmbedding_index_le f i.castSucc
      have hstep := f.strictMono (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ : i.castSucc < i.succ)
      simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at hindex hstep ⊢
      omega

name: BurningPath.finOrderEmbedding_shift_le
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ k =>
      have hmono := finOrderEmbedding_shift_monotone f
      have hi := hmono (Fin.le_last i)
      have hlast := (f (Fin.last k)).isLt
      simp only [Fin.val_last] at hi hlast
      omega

name: BurningPath.configurationEquivGamma_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem configurationEquivGamma_apply {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n)
    (A : Configuration (Fin n) k) (i : Fin k) :
    (configurationEquivGamma hk A).1 i = (coordinate A i).val - i.val
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.coordinate_configurationEquivGamma_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinate_configurationEquivGamma_symm {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n)
    (z : Gamma (n - k) k) (i : Fin k) :
    (coordinate ((configurationEquivGamma hk).symm z) i).val = z.1 i + i.val
proof:
:= by
  change
    ((configurationEquivOrderEmbedding (Fin n) k
      ((configurationEquivOrderEmbedding (Fin n) k).symm
        (gammaToFinOrderEmbedding hk z))) i).val =
      z.1 i + i.val
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: BurningPath.pathConfigurationDist_eq_gammaL1Dist
statement:
theorem pathConfigurationDist_eq_gammaL1Dist {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n)
    (A B : Configuration (Fin n) k) :
    pathConfigurationDist A B =
      gammaL1Dist (configurationEquivGamma hk A) (configurationEquivGamma hk B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathConfigurationDist gammaL1Dist
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [configurationEquivGamma_apply]
  have hA :=
    finOrderEmbedding_index_le (configurationEquivOrderEmbedding (Fin n) k A) i
  have hB :=
    finOrderEmbedding_index_le (configurationEquivOrderEmbedding (Fin n) k B) i
  simpa only [coordinate, Nat.sub_add_cancel hA, Nat.sub_add_cancel hB] using
    Nat.dist_add_add_right ((coordinate A i).val - i.val) i.val
      ((coordinate B i).val - i.val)

name: BurningPath.gammaL1Dist_eq_pathConfigurationDist
statement:
theorem gammaL1Dist_eq_pathConfigurationDist {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n)

name: BurningPath.pathTokenLimitConstant_pos
statement:
theorem pathTokenLimitConstant_pos {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    0 < pathTokenLimitConstant k
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathTokenLimitConstant
  apply Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
  exact div_pos (cubeBulkDensity_pos hk) (by positivity)

name: BurningPath.pathTokenLimitConstant_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathTokenLimitConstant_pow {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    pathTokenLimitConstant k ^ (k + 1) =
      cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pathTokenLimitConstant] using
    (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow
      (x := cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k) (n := k + 1)
      (div_nonneg (cubeBulkDensity_pos hk).le (by positivity))
      (by omega))

name: BurningPath.pathTokenLimitConstant_bounds
statement:
theorem pathTokenLimitConstant_bounds {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    (((k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        pathTokenLimitConstant k ∧
      pathTokenLimitConstant k ≤
        ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) /
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * Nat.factorial k)) ^
            (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.factorial k := by positivity
  have hlowerBase :
      (k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤
        cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hfac]
    have hlower := cubeBulkDensity_lower hk
    calc
      ((k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) * Nat.factorial k =
          (Nat.factorial k : ℝ) * (k + 1) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
        ring
      _ ≤ cubeBulkDensity k := hlower
  have hupperBase :
      cubeBulkDensity k / Nat.factorial k ≤
        ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) /
          ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * Nat.factorial k) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hfac]
    have hupper := cubeBulkDensity_le_explicit k
    have heq :
        (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) /
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ k * Nat.factorial k)) *
            Nat.factorial k =
          ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by
      field_simp
    rw [heq]
    exact hupper
  constructor
  · unfold pathTokenLimitConstant
    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hlowerBase (by positivity)
  · unfold pathTokenLimitConstant
    exact
      Real.rpow_le_rpow
        (div_nonneg (cubeBulkDensity_pos hk).le hfac.le)
        hupperBase (by positivity)

name: BurningPath.pathConfigurationDisplacement_mem_latticeBall

        (fun A hA ↦ pathConfigurationDisplacement_mem_latticeBall hA)
        (pathConfigurationDisplacement_injective C).injOn (latticeBall_finite k r)

name: SimpleGraph.IsRankedSubcover.extend
statement:
theorem IsRankedSubcover.extend [Nonempty V] {G : SimpleGraph V} {t : ℕ}
    {radii : ι ↪ Fin t} {centers : ι → V} (h : G.IsRankedSubcover radii centers) :
    ∃ fullCenters : Fin t → V,
      G.IsRankedCover fullCenters ∧ ∀ i, fullCenters (radii i) = centers i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let fullCenters : Fin t → V :=
    Function.extend radii centers (fun _ ↦ Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty V))
  have hfull : ∀ i, fullCenters (radii i) = centers i := by
    intro i
    exact radii.injective.extend_apply centers
      (fun _ ↦ Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty V)) i
  refine ⟨fullCenters, ?_, hfull⟩
  intro v
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h v
  refine ⟨radii i, ?_⟩
  rw [hfull i]
  exact hi

name: SimpleGraph.IsRankedCover.extendLength
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : G.IsRankedSubcover (Fin.castLEEmb hst) centers := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h v
    exact ⟨r, hr⟩
  obtain ⟨fullCenters, hcover, _⟩ := hsub.extend
  exact ⟨fullCenters, hcover⟩

name: SimpleGraph.isBurningLength_iff_exists_isChronologicalCover
statement:
theorem isBurningLength_iff_exists_isChronologicalCover {G : SimpleGraph V} {t : ℕ} :
    G.IsBurningLength t ↔
      1 ≤ t ∧ ∃ sources : Fin t → V, G.IsChronologicalCover sources
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ht, centers, hcover⟩
    refine ⟨ht, rankedToChronological centers, ?_⟩
    rw [isChronologicalCover_iff_isRankedCover]
    simpa
  · rintro ⟨ht, sources, hcover⟩
    exact
      ⟨ht, chronologicalToRanked sources,
        isChronologicalCover_iff_isRankedCover.mp hcover⟩

name: SimpleGraph.burningNumber_le_iff

theorem burningNumber_le_iff [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) {t : ℕ} :

proof:
