  · exact fun h ↦ G.burningNumber_spec.mono h
  · exact G.burningNumber_min

name: BurningPath.shelfRadiusEmbedding_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shelfRadiusEmbedding_val (w q : ℕ) (hqw : q ≤ w) (i : Fin q) :
    (shelfRadiusEmbedding w q hqw i).val = w - (i.val + 1)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.residual_parityCap_subset
statement:
theorem residual_parityCap_subset {h z a : ℕ} {σ : ℤ} (ha : 2 * a ≤ z) :
    parityCap (h + 2 * a) (z - 2 * a) σ ⊆ parityCap h z σ
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rcases hp with ⟨hpBottom, hpTop, hpSide, hpParity⟩
  have hapex : h + 2 * a + (z - 2 * a) = h + z := by omega
  have hapexInt :
      ((h + 2 * a : ℕ) : ℤ) + ((z - 2 * a : ℕ) : ℤ) =
        (h : ℤ) + (z : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hapex
  simp only [parityCap, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · exact hpBottom.trans' (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_add_right h (2 * a))
  constructor
  · rw [← hapexInt]
    exact hpTop
  constructor
  · rw [← hapex]
    exact hpSide
  · exact hpParity

name: BurningPath.exists_full_rankedCover_of_shelf
statement:
theorem exists_full_rankedCover_of_shelf {h z w q : ℕ} {σ : ℤ}
    (hσ : (h + z : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) (hqw : q ≤ w)
    (shelfCenters : Fin q → ℤ × ℤ)
    (hlegal : ∀ i, shelfCenters i ∈ parityCap h z σ)
    (hcover :
      ∀ p ∈ parityCap h z σ,
        ∃ i, p ∈ integerSquare (shelfCenters i) (w - (i.val + 1))) :
    ∃ centers : Fin w → ℤ × ℤ,
      IsParityCapRankedCover h z w σ centers
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := shelfRadiusEmbedding w q hqw
  let apex := parityCapApex h z
  let centers : Fin w → ℤ × ℤ :=
    Function.extend e shelfCenters (fun _ ↦ apex)
  have hcenters (i : Fin q) : centers (e i) = shelfCenters i :=
    e.injective.extend_apply shelfCenters (fun _ ↦ apex) i
  refine ⟨centers, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r
    by_cases hr : r ∈ Set.range e
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hr
      rw [hcenters]
      exact hlegal i
    · change Function.extend e shelfCenters (fun _ ↦ apex) r ∈ parityCap h z σ
      rw [Function.extend_apply' shelfCenters (fun _ ↦ apex) r]
      · exact parityCapApex_mem hσ
      · simpa only [Set.mem_range] using hr
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover p hp
    refine ⟨e i, ?_⟩
    rw [hcenters]
    simpa only [e, shelfRadiusEmbedding_val] using hi

name: BurningPath.exists_full_rankedCover_of_shelf_and_residual
statement:
theorem exists_full_rankedCover_of_shelf_and_residual {h z w q : ℕ} {σ : ℤ}
    (hσ : (h + z : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) (hqw : q ≤ w)
    (hnonterminal : 2 * (w - q) < z)
    (shelfCenters : Fin q → ℤ × ℤ)
    (hlegal : ∀ i, shelfCenters i ∈ parityCap h z σ)
    (hresidual :
      ∀ p ∈ parityCap h z σ,
        (∀ i, p ∉ integerSquare (shelfCenters i) (w - (i.val + 1))) →
          p ∈ parityCap (h + 2 * (w - q)) (z - 2 * (w - q)) σ)
    (lowerCenters : Fin (w - q) → ℤ × ℤ)
    (hlower :
      IsParityCapRankedCover (h + 2 * (w - q)) (z - 2 * (w - q))
        (w - q) σ lowerCenters) :
    ∃ centers : Fin w → ℤ × ℤ,
      IsParityCapRankedCover h z w σ centers
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let high := shelfRadiusEmbedding w q hqw
  let low : Fin (w - q) ↪ Fin w := Fin.castLEEmb (Nat.sub_le w q)
  let apex := parityCapApex h z
  let withLow : Fin w → ℤ × ℤ :=
    Function.extend low lowerCenters (fun _ ↦ apex)
  let centers : Fin w → ℤ × ℤ :=
    Function.extend high shelfCenters withLow
  have hhigh (i : Fin q) : centers (high i) = shelfCenters i :=
    high.injective.extend_apply shelfCenters withLow i
  have hdisjoint (i : Fin q) (j : Fin (w - q)) : high i ≠ low j := by
    intro hij
    have hval := congrArg Fin.val hij
    simp only [high, low, shelfRadiusEmbedding_val, Fin.castLEEmb_apply,
      Fin.val_castLE] at hval
    have hi : i.val + 1 ≤ q := i.isLt
    have hj := j.isLt
    omega
  have hwithLow (j : Fin (w - q)) : withLow (low j) = lowerCenters j :=
    low.injective.extend_apply lowerCenters (fun _ ↦ apex) j
  have hlow (j : Fin (w - q)) : centers (low j) = lowerCenters j := by
    change Function.extend high shelfCenters withLow (low j) = lowerCenters j
    rw [Function.extend_apply']
    · exact hwithLow j
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact hdisjoint i j hi
  have hresSubset :
      parityCap (h + 2 * (w - q)) (z - 2 * (w - q)) σ ⊆
        parityCap h z σ :=
    residual_parityCap_subset (by omega)
  refine ⟨centers, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r
    by_cases hrHigh : r ∈ Set.range high
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hrHigh
      rw [hhigh]
      exact hlegal i
    · change Function.extend high shelfCenters withLow r ∈ parityCap h z σ
      rw [Function.extend_apply']
      · by_cases hrLow : r ∈ Set.range low
        · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hrLow
          rw [hwithLow]
          exact hresSubset (hlower.1 j)
        · change Function.extend low lowerCenters (fun _ ↦ apex) r ∈ parityCap h z σ
          rw [Function.extend_apply']
          · exact parityCapApex_mem hσ
          · simpa only [Set.mem_range] using hrLow
      · simpa only [Set.mem_range] using hrHigh
  · intro p hp
    by_cases hshelf :
        ∃ i, p ∈ integerSquare (shelfCenters i) (w - (i.val + 1))
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hshelf
      refine ⟨high i, ?_⟩
      rw [hhigh]
      simpa only [high, shelfRadiusEmbedding_val] using hi
    · have huncovered :
          ∀ i, p ∉ integerSquare (shelfCenters i) (w - (i.val + 1)) := by
        simpa only [not_exists] using hshelf
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hlower.2 p (hresidual p hp huncovered)
      refine ⟨low j, ?_⟩
      rw [hlow]
      simpa only [low, Fin.castLEEmb_apply, Fin.val_castLE] using hj

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.exists_rankedCover
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing h z w q with
  | zero =>
      have hw : 3 ≤ w 0 := (run.width 0 (by omega)).trans' (by omega)
      by_cases hterminal : z 0 ≤ w 0 - 1
      · let apex := parityCapApex (h 0) (z 0)
        let centers : Fin (w 0) → ℤ × ℤ := fun _ ↦ apex
        refine ⟨centers, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro r
          exact parityCapApex_mem hσ
        · intro p hp
          refine ⟨⟨w 0 - 1, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
          exact parityCap_subset_terminal_square σ hterminal hp
      · have htall : w 0 - 1 < z 0 := by omega
        have hleast := run.least 0 (by omega) htall
        have hq2 : 2 ≤ q 0 := hleast.1.1
        have hqhalf : 2 * q 0 ≤ w 0 := hleast.1.2.1
        have hqw : q 0 < w 0 := by omega
        have hcapacity : z 0 ≤ q 0 * (w 0 - q 0) := hleast.1.2.2
        have hfinal : z 0 ≤ 2 * (w 0 - q 0) :=
          run.terminal.resolve_left (by simpa using hterminal)
        obtain ⟨shelfCenters, hlegal, hcover⟩ :=
          exists_shelf_centers_cover_cap hσ hw htall hq2 hqw hcapacity hfinal
        exact exists_full_rankedCover_of_shelf hσ hqw.le shelfCenters hlegal hcover
  | succ m ih =>
      have hw : 3 ≤ w 0 := (run.width 0 (by omega)).trans' (by omega)
      have htall : w 0 - 1 < z 0 := run.tall 0 (by omega)
      have hleast := run.least 0 (by omega) htall
      have hq2 : 2 ≤ q 0 := hleast.1.1
      have hqhalf : 2 * q 0 ≤ w 0 := hleast.1.2.1
      have hqw : q 0 < w 0 := by omega
      have hcapacity : z 0 ≤ q 0 * (w 0 - q 0) := hleast.1.2.2
      have hnonterminal : 2 * (w 0 - q 0) < z 0 :=
        run.nonterminal 0 (by omega)
      obtain ⟨shelfCenters, hlegal, _, hresidual⟩ :=
        exists_shelf_centers_with_residual hσ hw htall hq2 hqw hcapacity
          hnonterminal
      let h' : ℕ → ℕ := fun i ↦ h (i + 1)
      let z' : ℕ → ℕ := fun i ↦ z (i + 1)
      let w' : ℕ → ℕ := fun i ↦ w (i + 1)
      let q' : ℕ → ℕ := fun i ↦ q (i + 1)
      have tailRun : ShelfRun m h' z' w' q' := {
        width := by
          intro i hi
          exact run.width (i + 1) (by omega)
        cube := by
          intro i hi
          exact run.cube (i + 1) (by omega)
        tall := by
          intro i hi
          exact run.tall (i + 1) (by omega)
        least := by
          intro i hi hitall
          exact run.least (i + 1) (by omega) hitall
        nonterminal := by
          intro i hi
          exact run.nonterminal (i + 1) (by omega)
        h_next := by
          intro i hi
          exact run.h_next (i + 1) (by omega)
        z_next := by
          intro i hi
          exact run.z_next (i + 1) (by omega)
        w_next := by
          intro i hi
          exact run.w_next (i + 1) (by omega)
        terminal := run.terminal
      }
      have hhNext : h 1 = h 0 + 2 * (w 0 - q 0) := by
        simpa using run.h_next 0 (by omega)
      have hzNext : z 1 = z 0 - 2 * (w 0 - q 0) := by
        simpa using run.z_next 0 (by omega)
      have hwNext : w 1 = w 0 - q 0 := by
        simpa using run.w_next 0 (by omega)
      have hapex : h 1 + z 1 = h 0 + z 0 := by omega
      have hσ' : (h' 0 + z' 0 : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2] := by
        change (h 1 + z 1 : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]
        rw [hapex]
        exact hσ
      obtain ⟨lowerCenters, hlower⟩ := ih tailRun hσ'
      change IsParityCapRankedCover (h 1) (z 1) (w 1) σ lowerCenters at hlower
      rw [hhNext, hzNext] at hlower
      let adjustedLower : Fin (w 0 - q 0) → ℤ × ℤ :=
        fun r ↦ lowerCenters (Fin.cast hwNext.symm r)
      have hadjusted :
          IsParityCapRankedCover (h 0 + 2 * (w 0 - q 0))
            (z 0 - 2 * (w 0 - q 0)) (w 0 - q 0) σ adjustedLower := by
        constructor
        · intro r
          exact hlower.1 (Fin.cast hwNext.symm r)
        · intro p hp
          obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hlower.2 p hp
          refine ⟨Fin.cast hwNext r, ?_⟩
          simpa [adjustedLower] using hr
      exact
        exists_full_rankedCover_of_shelf_and_residual hσ hqw.le hnonterminal
          shelfCenters hlegal hresidual adjustedLower hadjusted

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.w_le_initial
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih =>
      calc
        w (i + 1) = w i - q i := run.w_next i (by omega)
        _ ≤ w i := Nat.sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ w 0 := ih (by omega)

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.three_mul_w_le_four_mul_w_next
proof:
:= by
  have htall := run.tall i hi
  have hleast := run.least i (by omega) htall
  have hbounds := hleast.bounds (run.width i (by omega)) (run.cube i (by omega))
  rw [run.w_next i hi]
  exact hbounds.2.2

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.z_sub_z_next
proof:
:= by
  rw [run.z_next i hi, run.w_next i hi]
  have hsub : 2 * (w i - q i) ≤ z i := by
    exact (run.nonterminal i hi).le
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hsub]
  norm_num

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.potential_step
statement:
theorem ShelfRun.potential_step {m : ℕ} {h z w q : ℕ → ℕ}
    (run : ShelfRun m h z w q) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < m) :
    shelfPotential (w (i + 1) : ℝ) (z (i + 1) : ℝ) ≥
      shelfPotential (w i : ℝ) (z i : ℝ) - 45 * (w i : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have htall := run.tall i hi
  have hleast := run.least i (by omega) htall
  have hstep :=
    hleast.potential_update (run.width i (by omega)) htall
      (run.cube i (by omega)) (run.nonterminal i hi)
  rw [run.w_next i hi, run.z_next i hi]
  exact hstep

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.sum_sq_le
statement:
theorem ShelfRun.sum_sq_le {m : ℕ} {h z w q : ℕ → ℕ}
    (run : ShelfRun m h z w q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, (w i : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      (2 / 3 : ℝ) * (w 0 : ℝ) * (z 0 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply shelfTrajectory_sum_sq_le (fun i ↦ (w i : ℝ)) (fun i ↦ (z i : ℝ))
  · intro i hi
    positivity
  · positivity
  · intro i hi
    exact_mod_cast run.w_le_initial (hi.le.trans hj)
  · intro i hi
    exact_mod_cast run.three_mul_w_le_four_mul_w_next (hi.trans_le hj)
  · intro i hi
    exact run.z_sub_z_next (hi.trans_le hj)

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.potential_lower
statement:
theorem ShelfRun.potential_lower {m : ℕ} {h z w q : ℕ → ℕ}
    (run : ShelfRun m h z w q) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) :
    shelfPotential (w j : ℝ) (z j : ℝ) ≥
      shelfPotential (w 0 : ℝ) (z 0 : ℝ) -
        30 * (w 0 : ℝ) * (z 0 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply shelfPotential_trajectory_lower (fun i ↦ (w i : ℝ)) (fun i ↦ (z i : ℝ))
  · exact run.sum_sq_le hj
  · intro i hi
    exact run.potential_step (hi.trans_le hj)

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.potential_ge_of_initial_margin
statement:
theorem ShelfRun.potential_ge_of_initial_margin {m : ℕ}
    {h z w q : ℕ → ℕ} (run : ShelfRun m h z w q) {E : ℝ}
    (hmargin :
      E + 30 * (w 0 : ℝ) * (z 0 : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w 0 : ℝ) (z 0 : ℝ))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) :
    E ≤ shelfPotential (w j : ℝ) (z j : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have htrajectory := run.potential_lower hj
  linarith

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.width_cube_ge_of_initial_margin
statement:
theorem ShelfRun.width_cube_ge_of_initial_margin {m : ℕ}
    {h z w q : ℕ → ℕ} (run : ShelfRun m h z w q) {E : ℝ}
    (hmargin :
      E + 30 * (w 0 : ℝ) * (z 0 : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w 0 : ℝ) (z 0 : ℝ))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) :
    (3 / 4 : ℝ) * E ≤ (w j : ℝ) ^ 3
proof:
:=
  cube_lower_of_shelfPotential_lower (run.potential_ge_of_initial_margin hmargin hj)

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.nonterminal_count_mul_le
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint :
      ∀ i ∈ Finset.range m,
        (3 / 2 : ℝ) * B ≤ (z i : ℝ) - z (i + 1) := by
    intro i hi
    have him := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hwidth := hB i him
    have hnext : 3 * (w i : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (w (i + 1) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast run.three_mul_w_le_four_mul_w_next him
    rw [run.z_sub_z_next him]
    nlinarith
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum hpoint
  rw [sum_range_forward_difference] at hsum
  have hzFinal : 0 ≤ (z m : ℝ) := by positivity
  simpa only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] using
    hsum.trans (by nlinarith : (z 0 : ℝ) - z m ≤ z 0)

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.nonterminal_count_le_ceil
proof:
:= by
  have hcount := run.nonterminal_count_mul_le hB
  have hreal : (m : ℝ) ≤ (2 * (z 0 : ℝ)) / (3 * B) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 3 * B)).2
    nlinarith
  have hceil :
      (2 * (z 0 : ℝ)) / (3 * B) ≤
        (⌈(2 * (z 0 : ℝ)) / (3 * B)⌉₊ : ℝ) :=
    Nat.le_ceil _
  exact_mod_cast hreal.trans hceil

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.shelf_count_le_ceil_add_one
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right (run.nonterminal_count_le_ceil hBpos hB) 1

name: BurningPath.shelfDelta_pos
statement:
theorem shelfDelta_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    0 < shelfDelta ε
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) < 1 + ε := by linarith
  have hpow : (1 : ℝ) ^ 3 < (1 + ε) ^ 3 :=
    (pow_lt_pow_iff_left₀ (by positivity) (by positivity) (by norm_num)).2 hone
  rw [shelfDelta]
  norm_num at hpow ⊢
  exact hpow

name: BurningPath.shelfBeta_pos
statement:
theorem shelfBeta_pos {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    0 < shelfBeta ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [shelfBeta]
  apply Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
  exact div_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (shelfDelta_pos hε)) (by norm_num)

name: BurningPath.shelfBeta_pow_three
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shelfBeta_pow_three {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    shelfBeta ε ^ 3 = (3 * shelfDelta ε) / 8
proof:
:= by
  simpa [shelfBeta] using
    (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (x := (3 * shelfDelta ε) / 8) (n := 3)
      (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (shelfDelta_pos hε).le) (by norm_num))
      (by norm_num))

name: BurningPath.shelfWidthScale_pow_three
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shelfWidthScale_pow_three (N : ℕ) :
    shelfWidthScale N ^ 3 = (N : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    (Real.rpow_mul_natCast (show 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) by positivity)
      (2 / 3 : ℝ) 3).symm
  norm_num [shelfWidthScale, Real.rpow_natCast] at h ⊢
  exact h

name: BurningPath.shelfWidthScale_pos
statement:
theorem shelfWidthScale_pos {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    0 < shelfWidthScale N
proof:
:= by
  rw [shelfWidthScale]
  apply Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
  positivity

name: BurningPath.shelfWidthScale_nonneg
statement:
theorem shelfWidthScale_nonneg (N : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ shelfWidthScale N
proof:
:= by
  rw [shelfWidthScale]
  exact Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.shelfBeta_mul_widthScale_le
statement:
theorem ShelfRun.shelfBeta_mul_widthScale_le {m N : ℕ}
    {h z w q : ℕ → ℕ} (run : ShelfRun m h z w q)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hmargin :
      shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 +
          30 * (w 0 : ℝ) * (z 0 : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w 0 : ℝ) (z 0 : ℝ))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) :
    shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N ≤ (w j : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcube :=
    run.width_cube_ge_of_initial_margin hmargin hj
  have hleft :
      (shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N) ^ 3 =
        (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [mul_pow, shelfBeta_pow_three hε, shelfWidthScale_pow_three]
    ring
  apply
    (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀
      (mul_nonneg (shelfBeta_pos hε).le (shelfWidthScale_nonneg N))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by norm_num : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp
  rw [hleft]
  exact hcube

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.equation31
statement:
theorem ShelfRun.equation31 {m N : ℕ} {h z w q : ℕ → ℕ}
    (run : ShelfRun m h z w q) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hmargin :
      shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 +
          30 * (w 0 : ℝ) * (z 0 : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w 0 : ℝ) (z 0 : ℝ))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) :
    shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
        shelfPotential (w j : ℝ) (z j : ℝ) ∧
      shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N ≤ (w j : ℝ) ∧
        144 ≤ w j
proof:
:= by
  exact
    ⟨run.potential_ge_of_initial_margin hmargin hj,
      run.shelfBeta_mul_widthScale_le hε hmargin hj,
      run.width j hj⟩

name: BurningPath.width_scale_quotient
statement:
private theorem width_scale_quotient {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    (N : ℝ) / shelfWidthScale N = (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hNReal : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by positivity
  have h := (Real.rpow_sub hNReal (1 : ℝ) (2 / 3 : ℝ)).symm
  norm_num [shelfWidthScale, Real.rpow_one] at h ⊢
  exact h

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.shelf_count_explicit_bound
statement:
theorem ShelfRun.shelf_count_explicit_bound {m N : ℕ}
    {h z w q : ℕ → ℕ} (run : ShelfRun m h z w q)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hN : 0 < N) (hz0 : z 0 = N)
    (hmargin :
      shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 +
          30 * (w 0 : ℝ) * (z 0 : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w 0 : ℝ) (z 0 : ℝ)) :
    m + 1 ≤
      ⌈(2 / (3 * shelfBeta ε)) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)⌉₊ + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hB :
      ∀ i < m, shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N ≤ (w i : ℝ) := by
    intro i hi
    exact run.shelfBeta_mul_widthScale_le hε hmargin hi.le
  have hcount :=
    run.shelf_count_le_ceil_add_one
      (mul_pos (shelfBeta_pos hε) (shelfWidthScale_pos hN)) hB
  rw [hz0] at hcount
  have harg :
      (2 * (N : ℝ)) / (3 * (shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N)) =
        (2 / (3 * shelfBeta ε)) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    rw [← width_scale_quotient hN]
    field_simp [(shelfBeta_pos hε).ne', (shelfWidthScale_pos hN).ne']
  rwa [harg] at hcount

name: BurningPath.prependNat_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prependNat_zero (x : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    prependNat x f 0 = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.prependNat_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prependNat_succ (x : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
    prependNat x f (i + 1) = f i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BurningPath.ShelfRun.prepend
statement:
theorem ShelfRun.prepend {m : ℕ} {H Z W Q : ℕ → ℕ}
    (tail : ShelfRun m H Z W Q) {h z w q : ℕ}
    (hw : 144 ≤ w) (hcube : 3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3)
    (htall : w - 1 < z) (hleast : IsLeastShelfWidth w z q)
    (hnonterminal : 2 * (w - q) < z)
    (hH : H 0 = h + 2 * (w - q))
    (hZ : Z 0 = z - 2 * (w - q))
    (hW : W 0 = w - q) :
    ShelfRun (m + 1) (prependNat h H) (prependNat z Z)
      (prependNat w W) (prependNat q Q)
proof:
:= by
  refine {
    width := ?_
    cube := ?_
    tall := ?_
    least := ?_
    nonterminal := ?_
    h_next := ?_
    z_next := ?_
    w_next := ?_
    terminal := ?_
  }
  · intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hw
    | succ i => exact tail.width i (by omega)
  · intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hcube
    | succ i => exact tail.cube i (by omega)
  · intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => exact htall
    | succ i => exact tail.tall i (by omega)
  · intro i hi hiTall
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hleast
    | succ i => exact tail.least i (by omega) hiTall
  · intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => exact hnonterminal
    | succ i => exact tail.nonterminal i (by omega)
  · intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => simpa using hH
    | succ i => simpa using tail.h_next i (by omega)
  · intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => simpa using hZ
    | succ i => simpa using tail.z_next i (by omega)
  · intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => simpa using hW
    | succ i => simpa using tail.w_next i (by omega)
  · simpa using tail.terminal

name: BurningPath.HasShelfRun.exists_rankedCover
statement:
theorem HasShelfRun.exists_rankedCover {h z w : ℕ} (hrun : HasShelfRun h z w)
    {σ : ℤ} (hσ : (h + z : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2]) :
    ∃ centers : Fin w → ℤ × ℤ,
      IsParityCapRankedCover h z w σ centers
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, H, Z, W, Q, hH, hZ, hW, run⟩ := hrun
  have hσ' : (H 0 + Z 0 : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2] := by
    rw [hH, hZ]
    exact hσ
  obtain ⟨centers, hcenters⟩ := run.exists_rankedCover hσ'
  subst h
  subst z
  subst w
  exact ⟨centers, hcenters⟩

name: BurningPath.shelf_state_bounds_of_reserve
statement:
theorem shelf_state_bounds_of_reserve {w₀ z₀ z w : ℕ} {E : ℝ}
    (hzle : z ≤ z₀)
    (hmargin :
      E + 30 * (w₀ : ℝ) * (z₀ : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w₀ : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ))
    (hreserve :
      shelfPotential (w₀ : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ) -
          30 * (w₀ : ℝ) * ((z₀ - z : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w : ℝ) (z : ℝ))
    (h144 :
      (144 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * E) :
    144 ≤ w ∧ 3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hgap : (((z₀ - z : ℕ) : ℝ)) ≤ (z₀ : ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hzle]
    exact sub_le_self _ (Nat.cast_nonneg z)
  have hcurrent : E ≤ shelfPotential (w : ℝ) (z : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [show 0 ≤ (w₀ : ℝ) by positivity]
  have hcubeReal : 3 * (z : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (w : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
    rw [shelfPotential] at hcurrent
    nlinarith
  have hwidthCube : (144 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (w : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
    h144.trans (cube_lower_of_shelfPotential_lower hcurrent)
  have hwidthReal : (144 : ℝ) ≤ (w : ℝ) :=
    (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      (by norm_num : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp hwidthCube
  constructor
  · exact_mod_cast hwidthReal
  · exact_mod_cast hcubeReal

name: BurningPath.exists_hasShelfRun_of_reserve
statement:
theorem exists_hasShelfRun_of_reserve {w₀ z₀ h z w : ℕ} {E : ℝ}
    (hzle : z ≤ z₀) (hwle : w ≤ w₀)
    (hmargin :
      E + 30 * (w₀ : ℝ) * (z₀ : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w₀ : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ))
    (hreserve :
      shelfPotential (w₀ : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ) -
          30 * (w₀ : ℝ) * ((z₀ - z : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w : ℝ) (z : ℝ))
    (h144 :
      (144 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * E) :
    HasShelfRun h z w
proof:
:= by
  induction z using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing h w with
  | h z ih =>
      have hstate :=
        shelf_state_bounds_of_reserve hzle hmargin hreserve h144
      have hw144 : 144 ≤ w := hstate.1
      have hcube : 3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3 := hstate.2
      by_cases hapex : z ≤ w - 1
      · let H : ℕ → ℕ := fun _ ↦ h
        let Z : ℕ → ℕ := fun _ ↦ z
        let W : ℕ → ℕ := fun _ ↦ w
        let Q : ℕ → ℕ := fun _ ↦ 0
        refine ⟨0, H, Z, W, Q, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
        refine {
          width := ?_
          cube := ?_
          tall := ?_
          least := ?_
          nonterminal := ?_
          h_next := ?_
          z_next := ?_
          w_next := ?_
          terminal := ?_
        }
        · intro i hi
          simpa [H] using hw144
        · intro i hi
          simpa [Z, W] using hcube
        · intro i hi
          omega
        · intro i hi hiTall
          simp only [Z, W] at hiTall
          omega
        · intro i hi
          omega
        · intro i hi
          omega
        · intro i hi
          omega
        · intro i hi
          omega
        · exact Or.inl (by simpa [Z, W] using hapex)
      · have htall : w - 1 < z := by omega
        obtain ⟨q, hleast⟩ := exists_isLeastShelfWidth hw144 hcube
        by_cases hfinal : z ≤ 2 * (w - q)
        · let H : ℕ → ℕ := fun _ ↦ h
          let Z : ℕ → ℕ := fun _ ↦ z
          let W : ℕ → ℕ := fun _ ↦ w
          let Q : ℕ → ℕ := fun _ ↦ q
          refine ⟨0, H, Z, W, Q, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
          refine {
            width := ?_
            cube := ?_
            tall := ?_
            least := ?_
            nonterminal := ?_
            h_next := ?_
            z_next := ?_
            w_next := ?_
            terminal := ?_
          }
          · intro i hi
            simpa [W] using hw144
          · intro i hi
            simpa [Z, W] using hcube
          · intro i hi
            omega
          · intro i hi hiTall
            simpa [W, Z, Q] using hleast
          · intro i hi
            omega
          · intro i hi
            omega
          · intro i hi
            omega
          · intro i hi
            omega
          · exact Or.inr (by simpa [Z, W, Q] using hfinal)
        · have hnonterminal : 2 * (w - q) < z := by omega
          have hbounds := hleast.bounds hw144 hcube
          have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := hleast.1.1
          have hqhalf : 2 * q ≤ w := hleast.1.2.1
          have hqw : q < w := by omega
          let a := w - q
          let z' := z - 2 * a
          have haPos : 0 < a := by
            dsimp [a]
            omega
          have hz'lt : z' < z := by
            dsimp [z', a]
            omega
          have hz'le : z' ≤ z₀ := by
            dsimp [z']
            omega
          have haLe : a ≤ w₀ := by
            dsimp [a]
            exact (Nat.sub_le w q).trans hwle
          have hstep :=
            hleast.potential_update hw144 htall hcube hnonterminal
          have hquarter : 3 * w ≤ 4 * a := by
            dsimp [a]
            exact hbounds.2.2
          have herror :
              45 * (w : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 60 * (w₀ : ℝ) * (a : ℝ) := by
            have hwleReal : (w : ℝ) ≤ (w₀ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hwle
            have hquarterReal : 3 * (w : ℝ) ≤ 4 * (a : ℝ) := by
              exact_mod_cast hquarter
            have hmul :
                (w : ℝ) * (w : ℝ) ≤ (w₀ : ℝ) * (w : ℝ) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hwleReal (by positivity)
            have hscale :
                3 * ((w₀ : ℝ) * (w : ℝ)) ≤
                  4 * ((w₀ : ℝ) * (a : ℝ)) := by
              nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ (w₀ : ℝ) by positivity)
                (sub_nonneg.mpr hquarterReal)]
            nlinarith
          have hgapNat :
              z₀ - z' = (z₀ - z) + 2 * a := by
            dsimp [z', a]
            omega
          have hgapReal :
              ((z₀ - z' : ℕ) : ℝ) =
                ((z₀ - z : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2 * (a : ℝ) := by
            exact_mod_cast hgapNat
          have hreserve' :
              shelfPotential (w₀ : ℝ) (z₀ : ℝ) -
                  30 * (w₀ : ℝ) * ((z₀ - z' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
                shelfPotential (a : ℝ) (z' : ℝ) := by
            dsimp [a, z'] at hstep ⊢
            rw [hgapReal]
            nlinarith
          obtain ⟨m, H, Z, W, Q, hH, hZ, hW, tail⟩ :=
            ih z' hz'lt (h := h + 2 * a) (w := a) hz'le haLe hreserve'
          refine
            ⟨m + 1, prependNat h H, prependNat z Z, prependNat w W,
              prependNat q Q, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
          exact
            tail.prepend hw144 hcube htall hleast hnonterminal hH hZ hW

name: BurningPath.exists_hasShelfRun_of_initial_margin
statement:
theorem exists_hasShelfRun_of_initial_margin {h z w : ℕ} {E : ℝ}
    (hmargin :
      E + 30 * (w : ℝ) * (z : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (w : ℝ) (z : ℝ))
    (h144 :
      (144 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤ (3 / 4 : ℝ) * E) :
    HasShelfRun h z w
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_hasShelfRun_of_reserve (w₀ := w) (z₀ := z)
    (z := z) (w := w) le_rfl le_rfl hmargin
  · simp
  · exact h144

name: BurningPath.shelfSharpConstant_pos
statement:
theorem shelfSharpConstant_pos :
    0 < shelfSharpConstant
proof:
:= by
  rw [shelfSharpConstant]
  apply Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
  norm_num

name: BurningPath.shelfSharpConstant_pow_three
statement:
@[simp]
theorem shelfSharpConstant_pow_three :
    shelfSharpConstant ^ 3 = (3 / 4 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [shelfSharpConstant] using
    (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (x := (3 / 4 : ℝ)) (n := 3)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num))

name: BurningPath.shelfPotential_initial_lower
statement:
theorem shelfPotential_initial_lower {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (N : ℕ) :
    shelfDelta ε * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      shelfPotential (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) (N : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let target := shelfIdealWidth ε N
  have htarget : 0 ≤ target := by
    dsimp [target]
    rw [shelfIdealWidth]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) shelfSharpConstant_pos.le)
      (shelfWidthScale_nonneg N)
  have hceil : target ≤ (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) := by
    exact Nat.le_ceil target
  have hpow :
      target ^ 3 ≤ (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) ^ 3 :=
    (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ htarget (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      (by norm_num : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).2 hceil
  have htargetCube :
      target ^ 3 =
        (1 + ε) ^ 3 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [target]
    rw [shelfIdealWidth]
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, shelfSharpConstant_pow_three,
      shelfWidthScale_pow_three]
  rw [shelfPotential]
  rw [htargetCube] at hpow
  rw [shelfDelta]
  nlinarith

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shelfWidthScale_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_shelfWidthScale_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ shelfWidthScale N) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  exact
    (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2 / 3)).comp
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop

name: BurningPath.shelfWidthScale_div_natCast
statement:
private theorem shelfWidthScale_div_natCast {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) :
    shelfWidthScale N / (N : ℝ) = (N : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hNReal : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by positivity
  have h := Real.rpow_sub hNReal (2 / 3 : ℝ) (1 : ℝ)
  norm_num [shelfWidthScale, Real.rpow_one] at h ⊢
  exact h.symm

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shelfWidthScale_div_natCast
statement:
theorem tendsto_shelfWidthScale_div_natCast :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ shelfWidthScale N / (N : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)).comp
      tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  apply h.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with N hN
  exact (shelfWidthScale_div_natCast hN).symm

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_atTop {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (shelfIdealWidth ε) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hcoefficient :
      0 < (1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant :=
    mul_pos (by linarith) shelfSharpConstant_pos
  convert tendsto_shelfWidthScale_atTop.const_mul_atTop hcoefficient using 1
  funext N
  simp only [shelfIdealWidth]

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_div_natCast
statement:
theorem tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_div_natCast {ε : ℝ} :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ shelfIdealWidth ε N / (N : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hconst :
      Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant) atTop
        (𝓝 ((1 + ε) * shelfSharpConstant)) :=
    tendsto_const_nhds
  have h := hconst.mul tendsto_shelfWidthScale_div_natCast
  simpa only [shelfIdealWidth, mul_div_assoc, mul_zero] using h

name: BurningPath.tendsto_shelfInitialWidth_div_natCast
statement:
theorem tendsto_shelfInitialWidth_div_natCast {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ ↦ (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) / (N : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hideal := tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_atTop hε
  have hceil :
      Tendsto
        (fun N : ℕ ↦
          (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) / shelfIdealWidth ε N)
        atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [shelfInitialWidth, Function.comp_def] using
      (tendsto_nat_ceil_div_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp hideal
  have hproduct :=
    hceil.mul (tendsto_shelfIdealWidth_div_natCast (ε := ε))
  have heq :
      (fun N : ℕ ↦
        ((shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) / shelfIdealWidth ε N) *
          (shelfIdealWidth ε N / (N : ℝ))) =ᶠ[atTop]
        (fun N : ℕ ↦ (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) / (N : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hideal.eventually_gt_atTop 0, eventually_gt_atTop 0]
      with N hidealN hN
    field_simp [hidealN.ne', show (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 by positivity]
  simpa only [one_mul] using hproduct.congr' heq

name: BurningPath.eventually_shelf_large_conditions
statement:
theorem eventually_shelf_large_conditions {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      30 * (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ≤
          shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧
        (144 : ℝ) ≤ shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N
proof:
:= by
  have hratio := tendsto_shelfInitialWidth_div_natCast hε
  have hratioSmall :
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) / (N : ℝ) <
          shelfDelta ε / 60 :=
    hratio.eventually
      (Iio_mem_nhds (div_pos (shelfDelta_pos hε) (by norm_num)))
  have hwidth :
      Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_shelfWidthScale_atTop.const_mul_atTop (shelfBeta_pos hε)
  filter_upwards [hratioSmall, hwidth.eventually_ge_atTop 144,
      eventually_gt_atTop 0] with N hsmall hlarge hN
  constructor
  · have hNReal : 0 < (N : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hlinear :
        (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) <
          shelfDelta ε / 60 * (N : ℝ) :=
      (div_lt_iff₀ hNReal).mp hsmall
    nlinarith [shelfDelta_pos hε]
  · exact hlarge

name: BurningPath.shelfBeta_widthScale_cube
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_pow, shelfBeta_pow_three hε, shelfWidthScale_pow_three]
  ring

name: BurningPath.exists_hasShelfRun_of_large_conditions
statement:
theorem exists_hasShelfRun_of_large_conditions {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) {N : ℕ}
    (hloss :
      30 * (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ≤
        shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hwidth :
      (144 : ℝ) ≤ shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N) :
    HasShelfRun 0 N (shelfInitialWidth ε N)
proof:
:= by
  have hinitial := shelfPotential_initial_lower hε N
  have hmargin :
      shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 +
          30 * (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) (N : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  have h144 :
      (144 : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤
        (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    have hcube :=
      (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 144)
        (mul_nonneg (shelfBeta_pos hε).le (shelfWidthScale_nonneg N))
        (by norm_num : (3 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).2 hwidth
    rwa [shelfBeta_widthScale_cube hε] at hcube
  exact exists_hasShelfRun_of_initial_margin hmargin h144

name: BurningPath.exists_shelfRun_certificate_of_large_conditions
statement:
theorem exists_shelfRun_certificate_of_large_conditions {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) {N : ℕ}
    (hloss :
      30 * (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ≤
        shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hwidth :
      (144 : ℝ) ≤ shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ H Z W Q : ℕ → ℕ,
      H 0 = 0 ∧ Z 0 = N ∧ W 0 = shelfInitialWidth ε N ∧
        ShelfRun m H Z W Q ∧
        (∀ j ≤ m,
          shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
              shelfPotential (W j : ℝ) (Z j : ℝ) ∧
            shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N ≤ (W j : ℝ) ∧
              144 ≤ W j) ∧
        m + 1 ≤
          ⌈(2 / (3 * shelfBeta ε)) * (N : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)⌉₊ + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, H, Z, W, Q, hH, hZ, hW, run⟩ :=
    exists_hasShelfRun_of_large_conditions hε hloss hwidth
  have hinitial := shelfPotential_initial_lower hε N
  have hmargin :
      shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2 +
          30 * (W 0 : ℝ) * (Z 0 : ℝ) ≤
        shelfPotential (W 0 : ℝ) (Z 0 : ℝ) := by
    rw [hW, hZ]
    nlinarith
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    by_contra hN
    have hN0 : N = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hN
    rw [hN0] at hwidth
    norm_num [shelfWidthScale] at hwidth
  refine ⟨m, H, Z, W, Q, hH, hZ, hW, run, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    exact run.equation31 hε hmargin hj
  · exact run.shelf_count_explicit_bound hε hN hZ hmargin

name: BurningPath.exists_parityTriangleCover_of_large_conditions
statement:
theorem exists_parityTriangleCover_of_large_conditions {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : 0 < ε) {N : ℕ} {σ : ℤ}
    (hσ : (N : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2])
    (hloss :
      30 * (shelfInitialWidth ε N : ℝ) * (N : ℝ) ≤
        shelfDelta ε / 2 * (N : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hwidth :
      (144 : ℝ) ≤ shelfBeta ε * shelfWidthScale N) :
    ∃ centers : Fin (shelfInitialWidth ε N) → ℤ × ℤ,
      IsParityCapRankedCover 0 N (shelfInitialWidth ε N) σ centers
proof:
:= by
  have hrun :
      HasShelfRun 0 N (shelfInitialWidth ε N) :=
    exists_hasShelfRun_of_large_conditions hε hloss hwidth
  exact hrun.exists_rankedCover (by simpa using hσ)

name: BurningPath.eventually_exists_parityTriangleCover
statement:
theorem eventually_exists_parityTriangleCover {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      ∀ σ : ℤ, (N : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2] →
        ∃ centers : Fin (shelfInitialWidth ε N) → ℤ × ℤ,
          IsParityCapRankedCover 0 N (shelfInitialWidth ε N) σ centers
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_shelf_large_conditions hε.1] with N hlarge
  intro σ hσ
  exact
    exists_parityTriangleCover_of_large_conditions hε.1 hσ
      hlarge.1 hlarge.2

name: BurningPath.exists_parityTriangleCover_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_parityTriangleCover_threshold {ε : ℝ}
    (hε : ε ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ Nε : ℕ, ∀ N ≥ Nε, ∀ σ : ℤ, (N : ℕ) ≡ σ [ZMOD 2] →
      ∃ centers : Fin (shelfInitialWidth ε N) → ℤ × ℤ,
        IsParityCapRankedCover 0 N (shelfInitialWidth ε N) σ centers
proof:
:= by
  exact eventually_atTop.1 (eventually_exists_parityTriangleCover hε)

name: BurningPath.max_abs_add_sub
statement:
theorem max_abs_add_sub (p q : ℤ) :
    max |p + q| |q - p| = |p| + |q|
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total 0 p with hp | hp
  · rcases le_total 0 q with hq | hq
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hp, abs_of_nonneg hq, abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg hp hq),
        max_eq_left_iff, abs_le]
      omega
    · have hqp : q - p ≤ 0 := by omega
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hp, abs_of_nonpos hq, abs_of_nonpos hqp]
      calc
        max |p + q| (-(q - p)) = -(q - p) := max_eq_right (by rw [abs_le]; omega)
        _ = p + -q := by omega
  · rcases le_total 0 q with hq | hq
    · have hqp : 0 ≤ q - p := by omega
      rw [abs_of_nonpos hp, abs_of_nonneg hq, abs_of_nonneg hqp]
      calc
        max |p + q| (q - p) = q - p := max_eq_right (by rw [abs_le]; omega)
        _ = -p + q := by omega
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos hp, abs_of_nonpos hq, abs_of_nonpos (add_nonpos hp hq)]
      calc
        max (-(p + q)) |q - p| = -(p + q) := max_eq_left (by rw [abs_le]; omega)
        _ = -p + -q := by omega

name: BurningPath.max_natAbs_add_sub
statement:
theorem max_natAbs_add_sub (p q : ℤ) :
    max (p + q).natAbs (q - p).natAbs = p.natAbs + q.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  apply Int.ofNat_inj.mp
  simpa only [Nat.cast_max, Int.natCast_natAbs, Nat.cast_add] using max_abs_add_sub p q

name: BurningPath.max_natAbs_sumDiff_sub_sumDiff
statement:
theorem max_natAbs_sumDiff_sub_sumDiff (x y x' y' : ℤ) :
    max ((x + y) - (x' + y')).natAbs ((y - x) - (y' - x')).natAbs =
      (x - x').natAbs + (y - y').natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (x + y) - (x' + y') = (x - x') + (y - y') by omega]
  rw [show (y - x) - (y' - x') = (y - y') - (x - x') by omega]
  exact max_natAbs_add_sub (x - x') (y - y')

name: BurningPath.max_natAbs_sumDiff_translation
statement:
theorem max_natAbs_sumDiff_translation (x y x' y' a b : ℤ) :
    max (((x + a) + (y + b)) - ((x' + a) + (y' + b))).natAbs
        (((y + b) - (x + a)) - ((y' + b) - (x' + a))).natAbs =
      max ((x + y) - (x' + y')).natAbs ((y - x) - (y' - x')).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg₂ max
  · apply congrArg Int.natAbs
    omega
  · apply congrArg Int.natAbs
    omega

name: BurningPath.add_modEq_sub_two
statement:

  · exact fun h ↦ (add_modEq_sub_two x y).symm.trans h
  · exact fun h ↦ (add_modEq_sub_two x y).trans h

name: BurningPath.rankedVolumePolynomial_mono
statement:
theorem rankedVolumePolynomial_mono (k : ℕ) :
    Monotone (rankedVolumePolynomial k)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  unfold rankedVolumePolynomial
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro j hj
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.choose_le_choose (j + 1) hab)

name: BurningPath.rankedVolumePolynomial_le_lower_add_leading
statement:
theorem rankedVolumePolynomial_le_lower_add_leading (k t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    rankedVolumePolynomial k t ≤
      lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k * t ^ k + 2 ^ k * t.choose (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rankedVolumePolynomial lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  simp only [Nat.choose_self, mul_one]
  apply Nat.add_le_add_right
  calc
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, 2 ^ j * k.choose j * t.choose (j + 1) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, (2 ^ j * k.choose j) * t ^ k := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      apply Nat.mul_le_mul_left
      exact (Nat.choose_le_pow t (j + 1)).trans <|
        Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by simpa using Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    _ = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, 2 ^ j * k.choose j) * t ^ k := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]

name: BurningPath.choose_le_rankedVolumePolynomial_pathToken
statement:
theorem choose_le_rankedVolumePolynomial_pathToken {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    n.choose k ≤ rankedVolumePolynomial k (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_eq hk]
  exact (volumeThreshold_spec k (n.choose k)).2.trans <|
    rankedVolumePolynomial_mono k (pathToken_volumeThreshold_lower_of_le hk)

name: BurningPath.tendsto_choose_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_choose_atTop (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ n.choose k) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tendsto_natCast_atTop_iff (R := ℝ)]
  apply (isEquivalent_choose k).symm.tendsto_atTop
  have hpow : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ k) atTop atTop :=
    (tendsto_pow_atTop (α := ℝ) hk.ne').comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  exact hpow.atTop_div_const (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < k.factorial)

name: BurningPath.tendsto_choose_div_pow
statement:
theorem tendsto_choose_div_pow (k : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n.choose k : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ k) atTop
      (𝓝 (1 / (k.factorial : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have heq := (isEquivalent_choose k).div
    (IsEquivalent.refl : (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ k) ~[atTop]
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ k))
  apply heq.symm.tendsto_nhds
  apply tendsto_congr' _ |>.mpr tendsto_const_nhds
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
  change (((n : ℝ) ^ k / k.factorial) / (n : ℝ) ^ k) = 1 / k.factorial
  have hn0 : (n : ℝ) ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by positivity)
  field_simp

name: BurningPath.cast_rankedVolumePolynomial_le
statement:
theorem cast_rankedVolumePolynomial_le (k t : ℕ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    (rankedVolumePolynomial k t : ℝ) ≤
      (lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) ^ k +
        leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient k * (t : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := rankedVolumePolynomial_le_lower_add_leading k t ht
  calc
    (rankedVolumePolynomial k t : ℝ) ≤
        ((lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k * t ^ k +
          2 ^ k * t.choose (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hnat
    _ = (lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) ^ k +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (t.choose (k + 1) : ℝ) := by norm_cast
    _ ≤ (lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) ^ k +
        (2 : ℝ) ^ k * ((t : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) / (k + 1).factorial) := by
      gcongr
      exact Nat.choose_le_pow_div (k + 1) t
    _ = (lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) ^ k +
        leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient k * (t : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
      rw [leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient]
      ring

name: BurningPath.eventually_choose_lower
statement:
theorem eventually_choose_lower (k : ℕ) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) - η) * (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (n.choose k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hratio := (tendsto_choose_div_pow k).eventually
    (Ioi_mem_nhds (sub_lt_self (1 / (k.factorial : ℝ)) hη))
  filter_upwards [hratio, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hnratio hn
  have hpow : 0 < (n : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
  calc
    (1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) - η) * (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤
        ((n.choose k : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ k) * (n : ℝ) ^ k :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnratio.le hpow.le)
    _ = (n.choose k : ℝ) := by field_simp

name: BurningPath.tendsto_pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_atTop
statement:
theorem tendsto_pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_atTop (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    Tendsto (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_atTop.2
  intro M
  filter_upwards [(tendsto_choose_atTop k hk).eventually_gt_atTop
      (rankedVolumePolynomial k M), eventually_ge_atTop k] with n hn hkn
  have hvolume := choose_le_rankedVolumePolynomial_pathToken hkn
  by_contra hM
  have hle : pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n ≤ M := by omega
  have hpoly := rankedVolumePolynomial_mono k hle
  omega

name: BurningPath.eventually_rankedVolumePolynomial_pathToken_upper
statement:
theorem eventually_rankedVolumePolynomial_pathToken_upper (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      (rankedVolumePolynomial k (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n) : ℝ) ≤
        (leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient k + η) *
          (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := tendsto_pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_atTop k hk
  have htCast :
      Tendsto (fun n ↦ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ)) atTop atTop :=
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.comp ht
  filter_upwards [ht.eventually_ge_atTop 1,
      htCast.eventually_ge_atTop ((lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k : ℝ) / η)] with n hn hlarge
  have hcoefficient :
      (lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k : ℝ) ≤
        (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) * η :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hη).mp hlarge
  have habsorb :
      (lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k : ℝ) *
          (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ k ≤
        η * (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
    calc
      (lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k : ℝ) *
          (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ k ≤
          ((pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) * η) *
            (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ k :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoefficient (by positivity)
      _ = η * (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
        ring
  calc
    (rankedVolumePolynomial k (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n) : ℝ) ≤
        (lowerRankedVolumeCoefficient k : ℝ) *
            (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ k +
          leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient k *
            (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) :=
      cast_rankedVolumePolynomial_le k _ hn
    _ ≤ η * (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) +
        leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient k *
          (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) :=
      add_le_add_left habsorb _
    _ = (leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient k + η) *
        (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) := by ring

name: BurningPath.volumeLowerPowerConstant_pos
statement:
theorem volumeLowerPowerConstant_pos (k : ℕ) :
    0 < volumeLowerPowerConstant k
proof:
:= by
  rw [volumeLowerPowerConstant]
  positivity

name: BurningPath.volumeLowerPowerConstant_mul_leading
statement:
theorem volumeLowerPowerConstant_mul_leading (k : ℕ) :
    volumeLowerPowerConstant k * leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient k =
      1 / (k.factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [volumeLowerPowerConstant, leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient, Nat.factorial_succ]
  norm_num
  field_simp

name: BurningPath.eventually_pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_pow_lower
statement:
theorem eventually_pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_pow_lower (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    {d : ℝ} (hd0 : 0 ≤ d) (hd : d < volumeLowerPowerConstant k) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      d * (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤ (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let A := leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient k
  let gap := 1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) - d * A
  let η₁ := gap / 2
  let η₂ := gap / (2 * (d + 1))
  have hA : 0 < A := by
    dsimp [A, leadingRankedVolumeCoefficient]
    positivity
  have hgap : 0 < gap := by
    dsimp [gap, A]
    rw [← volumeLowerPowerConstant_mul_leading k]
    exact sub_pos.mpr (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hd hA)
  have hη₁ : 0 < η₁ := by dsimp [η₁]; positivity
  have hη₂ : 0 < η₂ := by
    dsimp [η₂]
    positivity
  have hcoefficient : d * (A + η₂) ≤ 1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) - η₁ := by
    have hd1 : 0 < d + 1 := by positivity
    have heq :
        (1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) - η₁) - d * (A + η₂) =
          gap / (2 * (d + 1)) := by
      dsimp [η₁, η₂, gap]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hd1]
      ring
    apply sub_nonneg.mp
    rw [heq]
    positivity
  filter_upwards [eventually_choose_lower k hη₁,
      eventually_rankedVolumePolynomial_pathToken_upper k hk hη₂,
      eventually_ge_atTop k] with n hchoose hvolume hnk
  have hexact :
      (n.choose k : ℝ) ≤
        (rankedVolumePolynomial k (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast choose_le_rankedVolumePolynomial_pathToken hnk
  have hchain :
      (1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) - η₁) * (n : ℝ) ^ k ≤
        (A + η₂) * (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) :=
    hchoose.trans (hexact.trans hvolume)
  have hAη : 0 < A + η₂ := by positivity
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left hAη).mp
  calc
    (A + η₂) * (d * (n : ℝ) ^ k) =
        (d * (A + η₂)) * (n : ℝ) ^ k := by ring
    _ ≤ (1 / (k.factorial : ℝ) - η₁) * (n : ℝ) ^ k :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoefficient (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (A + η₂) * (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) :=
      hchain

name: BurningPath.pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pow (k n : ℕ) :
    pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n ^ (k + 1) = (n : ℝ) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pathTokenAsymptoticScale] using
    (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (x := (n : ℝ) ^ k) (n := k + 1)
      (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) k) (by omega))

name: BurningPath.pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow
statement:
theorem pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow (k n : ℕ) :
    pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n = (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pathTokenAsymptoticScale, div_eq_mul_inv, Real.rpow_natCast] using
    (Real.rpow_mul (show 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) by positivity) (k : ℝ) (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹).symm

name: BurningPath.pathTokenAsymptoticScale_nonneg
statement:
theorem pathTokenAsymptoticScale_nonneg (k n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathTokenAsymptoticScale]
  positivity

name: BurningPath.pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos
statement:
theorem pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos {k n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    0 < pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathTokenAsymptoticScale]
  apply Real.rpow_pos_of_pos
  positivity

name: BurningPath.volumeLowerConstant_pos
statement:
theorem volumeLowerConstant_pos (k : ℕ) :
    0 < volumeLowerConstant k
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (volumeLowerPowerConstant_pos k) _

name: BurningPath.volumeLowerConstant_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem volumeLowerConstant_pow (k : ℕ) :
    volumeLowerConstant k ^ (k + 1) = volumeLowerPowerConstant k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [volumeLowerConstant] using
    (Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow (x := volumeLowerPowerConstant k) (n := k + 1)
      (volumeLowerPowerConstant_pos k).le (by omega))

name: BurningPath.pathTokenBurningRatio_nonneg
statement:
theorem pathTokenBurningRatio_nonneg (k n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ pathTokenBurningRatio k n
proof:
:= by
  exact div_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (pathTokenAsymptoticScale_nonneg k n)

name: BurningPath.eventually_constant_le_pathTokenBurningRatio
statement:
theorem eventually_constant_le_pathTokenBurningRatio (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : c < volumeLowerConstant k) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, c ≤ pathTokenBurningRatio k n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc0 : 0 ≤ c
  · have hdpow : c ^ (k + 1) < volumeLowerPowerConstant k := by
      rw [← volumeLowerConstant_pow]
      exact (pow_lt_pow_iff_left₀ hc0 (volumeLowerConstant_pos k).le (by omega)).2 hc
    filter_upwards [
        eventually_pathTokenBurningNumberTotal_pow_lower k hk (pow_nonneg hc0 _) hdpow,
        eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hpower hn
    have hscale : 0 < pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n :=
      pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos hn
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hscale).2
    apply (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ (n := k + 1) (mul_nonneg hc0 hscale.le)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by omega)).mp
    simpa [mul_pow] using hpower
  · have hcneg : c < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hc0
    exact Eventually.of_forall fun n ↦
      hcneg.le.trans (pathTokenBurningRatio_nonneg k n)

name: BurningPath.volumeLowerConstant_le_liminf_pathTokenBurningRatio
statement:
theorem volumeLowerConstant_le_liminf_pathTokenBurningRatio (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (volumeLowerConstant k) ≤
      liminf (pathTokenBurningRatioENNReal k) atTop
proof:
:= by
  apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_nnreal_lt
  intro c hc
  have hcReal : (c : ℝ) < volumeLowerConstant k := by
    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (volumeLowerConstant_pos k)]
    simpa using hc
  apply le_liminf_of_le (by isBoundedDefault)
  exact (eventually_constant_le_pathTokenBurningRatio k hk hcReal).mono fun n hn ↦ by
    simpa [pathTokenBurningRatioENNReal] using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hn

name: BurningPath.generalLowerAsymptotic_liminf
statement:
theorem generalLowerAsymptotic_liminf (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) :
    ENNReal.ofReal
        (((k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
      liminf
        (fun n : ℕ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal
          ((pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ) /
            (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ))))
        atTop
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow]
  change ENNReal.ofReal (volumeLowerConstant k) ≤
    liminf (pathTokenBurningRatioENNReal k) atTop
  exact volumeLowerConstant_le_liminf_pathTokenBurningRatio k (by omega)

name: BurningPath.eventually_generalLowerAsymptotic
statement:
theorem eventually_generalLowerAsymptotic (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
      ((((k + 1 : ℝ) / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ^ (k + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) - ε) *
          (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℝ)) ≤
        (pathTokenBurningNumberTotal k n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have heventually :=
    eventually_constant_le_pathTokenBurningRatio k (by omega)
      (sub_lt_self (volumeLowerConstant k) hε)
  filter_upwards [heventually, eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hnratio hn
  have hscale : 0 < pathTokenAsymptoticScale k n :=
    pathTokenAsymptoticScale_pos hn
  have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ hscale).mp hnratio
  rw [pathTokenAsymptoticScale_eq_rpow] at hmul
  simpa only [volumeLowerConstant, volumeLowerPowerConstant] using hmul

name: BurningPath.shelf_cube_bound_iff_real_upper
statement:
theorem shelf_cube_bound_iff_real_upper (w z : ℕ) :
    3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3 ↔
      (z : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (4 / 3) * (w : ℝ) * Real.sqrt w
proof:
:= by
  let W : ℝ := w
  let Z : ℝ := z
  let B : ℝ := Real.sqrt (4 / 3) * W * Real.sqrt W
  have hcoef : Real.sqrt (4 / 3) ^ 2 = (4 / 3 : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hWsqrt : Real.sqrt W ^ 2 = W := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hBsq : B ^ 2 = (4 / 3) * W ^ 3 := by
    dsimp [B]
    calc
      (Real.sqrt (4 / 3) * W * Real.sqrt W) ^ 2 =
          Real.sqrt (4 / 3) ^ 2 * W ^ 2 * Real.sqrt W ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = (4 / 3) * W ^ 3 := by rw [hcoef, hWsqrt]; ring
  have hZ0 : 0 ≤ Z := by positivity
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := by positivity
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hR : 3 * Z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * W ^ 3 := by
      dsimp [Z, W]
      exact_mod_cast h
    change Z ≤ B
    nlinarith
  · intro h
    change Z ≤ B at h
    have hR : 3 * Z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * W ^ 3 := by nlinarith
    dsimp [Z, W] at hR
    exact_mod_cast hR

name: BurningPath.three_mul_natSqrt_candidate
statement:
theorem three_mul_natSqrt_candidate {w z : ℕ} (hw : 144 ≤ w)
    (hcube : 3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3) :
    ShelfWidthAdmissible w z (3 * Nat.sqrt w) ∧
      4 * (3 * Nat.sqrt w) ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  let s := Nat.sqrt w
  let q := 3 * s
  have hs : 12 ≤ s := by
    rw [Nat.le_sqrt]
    dsimp [s]
    omega
  have hsq : s * s ≤ w := by
    simpa [s] using Nat.sqrt_le w
  have hwlt : w < (s + 1) * (s + 1) := by
    simpa [s] using Nat.lt_succ_sqrt w
  have hq4 : 4 * q ≤ w := by
    dsimp [q]
    nlinarith
  have hzsq_le : z * z ≤ 4 * w ^ 3 := by
    simp only [pow_two] at hcube ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hwcube_lt :
      4 * w ^ 3 < (2 * w * (s + 1)) * (2 * w * (s + 1)) := by
    have hmul :=
      Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hwlt (by positivity : 0 < 4 * w * w)
    simpa [pow_succ, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using hmul
  have hzlt : z < 2 * w * (s + 1) := by
    apply Nat.mul_self_lt_mul_self_iff.mp
    exact hzsq_le.trans_lt hwcube_lt
  have hqw : q ≤ w := by omega
  have hprod : 2 * w * (s + 1) ≤ q * (w - q) := by
    have h11 : 11 * w ≤ s * w := Nat.mul_le_mul_right w (by omega)
    have h9 : 9 * (s * s) ≤ 9 * w := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 9 hsq
    rw [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib]
    apply Nat.le_sub_of_add_le
    dsimp [q]
    nlinarith
  change ShelfWidthAdmissible w z q ∧ 4 * q ≤ w
  exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega, by omega⟩, hq4⟩

name: BurningPath.exists_isLeastShelfWidth
statement:
theorem exists_isLeastShelfWidth {w z : ℕ} (hw : 144 ≤ w)
    (hcube : 3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3) :
    ∃ q, IsLeastShelfWidth w z q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ q, ShelfWidthAdmissible w z q :=
    ⟨3 * Nat.sqrt w, (three_mul_natSqrt_candidate hw hcube).1⟩
  let q := Nat.find hex
  refine ⟨q, Nat.find_spec hex, ?_⟩
  intro m hm
  exact Nat.find_min' hex hm

name: BurningPath.exists_isLeastShelfWidth_of_real_upper
statement:
theorem exists_isLeastShelfWidth_of_real_upper {w z : ℕ} (hw : 144 ≤ w)
    (hupper : (z : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (4 / 3) * (w : ℝ) * Real.sqrt w) :
    ∃ q, IsLeastShelfWidth w z q
proof:
:=
  exists_isLeastShelfWidth hw ((shelf_cube_bound_iff_real_upper w z).2 hupper)

name: BurningPath.IsLeastShelfWidth.bounds
statement:
theorem IsLeastShelfWidth.bounds {w z q : ℕ} (hq : IsLeastShelfWidth w z q)
    (hw : 144 ≤ w) (hcube : 3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3) :
    q ^ 2 ≤ 9 * w ∧ 4 * q ≤ w ∧ 3 * w ≤ 4 * (w - q)
proof:
:= by
  have hcand := three_mul_natSqrt_candidate hw hcube
  have hqq₀ : q ≤ 3 * Nat.sqrt w := hq.2 _ hcand.1
  have hqSq : q ^ 2 ≤ 9 * w := by
    nlinarith [Nat.pow_le_pow_left hqq₀ 2, Nat.sqrt_le w]
  have hq4 : 4 * q ≤ w := by omega
  refine ⟨hqSq, hq4, ?_⟩
  have hqw : q ≤ w := by omega
  omega

name: BurningPath.IsLeastShelfWidth.le_three_mul_sqrt
statement:
theorem IsLeastShelfWidth.le_three_mul_sqrt {w z q : ℕ}
    (hq : IsLeastShelfWidth w z q) (hw : 144 ≤ w)
    (hcube : 3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3) :
    (q : ℝ) ≤ 3 * Real.sqrt w
proof:
:= by
  have hsqR : (q : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * (w : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (hq.bounds hw hcube).1
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (w : ℝ) ^ 2 = (w : ℝ) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsqrt0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (w : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  nlinarith

name: BurningPath.IsLeastShelfWidth.remainder_ge_three_quarters
statement:
theorem IsLeastShelfWidth.remainder_ge_three_quarters {w z q : ℕ}
    (hq : IsLeastShelfWidth w z q) (hw : 144 ≤ w)
    (hcube : 3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3) :
    (3 / 4 : ℝ) * (w : ℝ) ≤ ((w - q : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hq4 := (hq.bounds hw hcube).2.1
  have hqw : q ≤ w := by omega
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hqw]
  have hq4R : 4 * (q : ℝ) ≤ (w : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hq4
  norm_num
  nlinarith

name: BurningPath.IsLeastShelfWidth.minimality_lower
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := hq.1.1
  have hqhalf : 2 * q ≤ w := hq.1.2.1
  have hqw : q ≤ w := by omega
  by_cases hqeq : q = 2
  · subst q
    norm_num
    rw [show w - 2 + 1 = w - 1 by omega]
    exact hz
  · have hqgt : 2 < q := by omega
    by_contra hnot
    have hzle : z ≤ (q - 1) * (w - q + 1) := by omega
    have hsub : w - (q - 1) = w - q + 1 := by omega
    have hadm : ShelfWidthAdmissible w z (q - 1) := by
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      rwa [hsub]
    have := hq.2 (q - 1) hadm
    omega

name: BurningPath.shelfPotential_update_ge_sub_44_of_bounds
statement:
theorem shelfPotential_update_ge_sub_44_of_bounds {w z q : ℕ}
    (hq2 : 2 ≤ q) (hqw : q ≤ w) (hsq : q ^ 2 ≤ 9 * w)
    (hminimal : (q - 1) * (w - q + 1) < z)
    (hnonterminal : 2 * (w - q) < z) :
    shelfPotential ((w - q : ℕ) : ℝ) ((z - 2 * (w - q) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≥
      shelfPotential (w : ℝ) (z : ℝ) - 44 * (w : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let W : ℝ := w
  let Z : ℝ := z
  let Q : ℝ := q
  let A : ℝ := (w - q : ℕ)
  have hAq : A + Q = W := by
    dsimp [A, Q, W]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_add_cancel hqw
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ A := by positivity
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q := by positivity
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := by positivity
  have hQ1 : 1 ≤ Q := by
    change (1 : ℝ) ≤ (q : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ q by omega)
  have hsqR : Q ^ 2 ≤ 9 * W := by
    dsimp [Q, W]
    exact_mod_cast hsq
  have hminimalR : (Q - 1) * (A + 1) < Z := by
    have hmcast : (((q - 1) * (w - q + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) < (z : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hminimal
    simpa only [Q, A, Z, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ q),
      Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hmcast
  have hZmul : 4 * A * ((Q - 1) * (A + 1)) ≤ 4 * A * Z :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hminimalR.le (by positivity)
  have hqError : 4 * A * Q ^ 2 ≤ 36 * A * W := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqR (show 0 ≤ 4 * A by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hqCube : (4 / 3) * Q ^ 3 ≤ 12 * Q * W := by
    have hmul :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsqR (show 0 ≤ (4 / 3 : ℝ) * Q by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have hAW : A ≤ W := by nlinarith
  have henvelope : 36 * A * W + 8 * A ^ 2 + 12 * Q * W ≤ 44 * W ^ 2 := by
    have hfactor : 0 ≤ (W - A) * (4 * W + A) :=
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hAW) (by positivity)
    nlinarith
  have herror :
      4 * A * Q ^ 2 + (4 / 3) * Q ^ 3 + 8 * A ^ 2 ≤ 44 * W ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith
  have hidentity := shelfPotential_update_identity' A Z Q
  have hrealUpdate : ((z - 2 * (w - q) : ℕ) : ℝ) = Z - 2 * A := by
    dsimp [Z, A]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 2 * (w - q) ≤ z)]
    norm_num
  rw [hrealUpdate]
  change shelfPotential A (Z - 2 * A) ≥ shelfPotential W Z - 44 * W ^ 2
  rw [← hAq]
  nlinarith

name: BurningPath.IsLeastShelfWidth.potential_update
statement:
theorem IsLeastShelfWidth.potential_update {w z q : ℕ}
    (hq : IsLeastShelfWidth w z q) (hw : 144 ≤ w) (hz : w - 1 < z)
    (hcube : 3 * z ^ 2 ≤ 4 * w ^ 3) (hnonterminal : 2 * (w - q) < z) :
    shelfPotential ((w - q : ℕ) : ℝ) ((z - 2 * (w - q) : ℕ) : ℝ) ≥
      shelfPotential (w : ℝ) (z : ℝ) - 45 * (w : ℝ) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : 2 ≤ q := hq.1.1
  have hqhalf : 2 * q ≤ w := hq.1.2.1
  have hqw : q ≤ w := by omega
  have hsq := (hq.bounds hw hcube).1
  have hminimal := hq.minimality_lower hz
  have h44 :=
    shelfPotential_update_ge_sub_44_of_bounds hq2 hqw hsq hminimal hnonterminal
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (w : ℝ)]

name: BurningPath.blockIndex_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem blockIndex_val (n s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (x : Fin n) :
    (blockIndex n s hs x).val = x.val / s
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: BurningPath.blockIndex_monotone
statement:
theorem blockIndex_monotone (n s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) :
    Monotone (blockIndex n s hs)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply Fin.mk_le_mk.mpr
  exact Nat.div_le_div_right hxy

name: BurningPath.blockCoordinates_monotone
statement:
theorem blockCoordinates_monotone {n k : ℕ} (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (A : Configuration (Fin n) k) :
    Monotone (blockCoordinates s hs A)
proof:
:=
  (blockIndex_monotone n s hs).comp (coordinate_strictMono A).monotone

name: BurningPath.card_blockSignature
statement:
theorem card_blockSignature (n k s : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (BlockSignature n k s) =
      Nat.choose (blockCount n s + k - 1) k
proof:
:= by
  simpa [BlockSignature] using
    (Sym.card_sym_eq_choose (α := Fin (blockCount n s)) k)

name: BurningPath.blockCoordinates_eq_of_blockSignature_eq
statement:
theorem blockCoordinates_eq_of_blockSignature_eq {n k : ℕ} (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    {A B : Configuration (Fin n) k} (h : blockSignature s hs A = blockSignature s hs B) :
    blockCoordinates s hs A = blockCoordinates s hs B
proof:
:= by
  have hmultiset :=
    congrArg
      (fun q : BlockSignature n k s => (q : Multiset (Fin (blockCount n s)))) h
  change
    (↑(List.ofFn (blockCoordinates s hs A)) : Multiset (Fin (blockCount n s))) =
      ↑(List.ofFn (blockCoordinates s hs B)) at hmultiset
  have hperm :
      (List.ofFn (blockCoordinates s hs A)).Perm
        (List.ofFn (blockCoordinates s hs B)) :=
    Multiset.coe_eq_coe.mp hmultiset
  exact List.ofFn_injective <|
    hperm.eq_of_pairwise'
      (blockCoordinates_monotone s hs A).sortedLE_ofFn.pairwise
      (blockCoordinates_monotone s hs B).sortedLE_ofFn.pairwise

name: BurningPath.natDist_le_pred_of_div_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hspos : 0 < s := Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hs
  have ha_mod := Nat.mod_lt a hspos
  have hb_mod := Nat.mod_lt b hspos
  have ha_decomp := Nat.div_add_mod a s
  have hb_decomp := Nat.div_add_mod b s
  rw [hdiv] at ha_decomp
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · rw [Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le hab]
    omega
  · rw [Nat.dist_eq_sub_of_le_right hba]
    omega

name: BurningPath.pathConfigurationDist_le_of_blockCoordinates_eq
statement:
theorem pathConfigurationDist_le_of_blockCoordinates_eq {n k : ℕ} (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (A B : Configuration (Fin n) k)
    (h : blockCoordinates s hs A = blockCoordinates s hs B) :
    pathConfigurationDist A B ≤ k * (s - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pathConfigurationDist]
  calc
    (∑ i : Fin k, Nat.dist (coordinate A i).val (coordinate B i).val) ≤
        ∑ _i : Fin k, (s - 1) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      apply natDist_le_pred_of_div_eq hs
      have hi := congrFun h i
      exact congrArg Fin.val hi
    _ = k * (s - 1) := by simp

name: BurningPath.pathConfigurationDist_le_of_blockSignature_eq
statement:
theorem pathConfigurationDist_le_of_blockSignature_eq {n k : ℕ} (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (A B : Configuration (Fin n) k)
    (h : blockSignature s hs A = blockSignature s hs B) :
    pathConfigurationDist A B ≤ k * (s - 1)
proof:
:=
  pathConfigurationDist_le_of_blockCoordinates_eq s hs A B
    (blockCoordinates_eq_of_blockSignature_eq s hs h)
